```text
149	// RenderManaged returns the only canonical byte representation of a v1 file.
150	func RenderManaged(definition ManagedDefinition) ([]byte, error) {
151		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154		var body strings.Builder
155		body.WriteString(ManagedHeader)
156		body.WriteByte('\n')
157		body.WriteString("Host ")
158		body.WriteString(definition.Alias)
159		body.WriteByte('\n')
160		writeConfigDirective(&body, "HostName", definition.HostName)
161		writeConfigDirective(&body, "User", definition.User)
162		if definition.Port != 0 {

164		}
165		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ProxyJump", definition.ProxyJump)
166		writeConfigDirective(&body, "IdentityFile", definition.IdentityFile)
167		if definition.IdentitiesOnly != nil {
168			value := "no"
169			if *definition.IdentitiesOnly {
170				value = "yes"
171			}
172			writeConfigDirective(&body, "IdentitiesOnly", value)
173		}
174		return []byte(body.String()), nil
175	}

177	func writeConfigDirective(body *strings.Builder, name, value string) {
178		if value == "" {
179			return
180		}
181		body.WriteString("    ")
182		body.WriteString(name)
183		body.WriteByte(' ')
184		body.WriteString(quoteConfigValue(value))
185		body.WriteByte('\n')
186	}

188	func quoteConfigValue(value string) string {
189		safe := value != ""
190		for _, r := range value {
191			if unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsControl(r) || strings.ContainsRune("#\"'\\", r) {
192				safe = false
193				break
194			}
195		}
196		if safe {
197			return value
198		}
199		value = strings.ReplaceAll(value, `\`, `\\`)
200		value = strings.ReplaceAll(value, `"`, `\"`)
201		return `"` + value + `"`
202	}

204	// ParseManaged accepts only canonical v1 content. A valid-looking block with

206	func ParseManaged(data []byte) (ManagedDefinition, error) {
207		if bytes.ContainsRune(data, 0) || bytes.HasPrefix(data, []byte{0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf}) {
208			return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("managed file has a BOM or NUL: %w", ErrNotManaged)
209		}
210		lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
211		if len(lines) < 3 || lines[0] != ManagedHeader || lines[len(lines)-1] != "" {
212			return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("managed file has no canonical v1 header/ending: %w", ErrNotManaged)
213		}
214		hostDirective, hostArguments, empty, err := parseConfigLine(lines[1])
215		if err != nil || empty || !strings.EqualFold(hostDirective, "Host") || len(hostArguments) != 1 {
216			return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("managed file must contain exactly one Host alias: %w", ErrNotManaged)

219		seen := make(map[string]bool)
220		for index, line := range lines[2 : len(lines)-1] {
221			directive, arguments, empty, err := parseConfigLine(line)
222			if err != nil || empty || len(arguments) != 1 {

229			seen[key] = true

232			case "hostname":
233				definition.HostName = value
234			case "user":

243				definition.ProxyJump = value
244			case "identityfile":
245				definition.IdentityFile = value
246			case "identitiesonly":
247				enabled := false
248				switch strings.ToLower(value) {
249				case "yes":
250					enabled = true
251				case "no":
252				default:
253					return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("managed IdentitiesOnly is invalid: %w", ErrNotManaged)
254				}
255				definition.IdentitiesOnly = &enabled
256			default:
257				return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("managed directive %s is not allowlisted: %w", directive, ErrNotManaged)
258			}
259		}
260		canonical, err := RenderManaged(definition)
261		if err != nil {
262			return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("validate managed file: %w", ErrNotManaged)
263		}
264		if !bytes.Equal(canonical, data) {
265			return ManagedDefinition{}, fmt.Errorf("managed file differs from canonical v1 rendering: %w", ErrNotManaged)
266		}
267		return definition, nil
268	}

270	// InspectManaged validates the concrete filename, file security, and canonical
271	// bytes for alias.
272	func (s *Service) InspectManaged(alias string) (ManagedFile, error) {
273		if err := inspectExistingTree(s.paths); err != nil {
274			return ManagedFile{}, err
275		}
276		path, err := s.paths.ManagedPath(alias)
277		if err != nil {
278			return ManagedFile{}, err
279		}
280		snapshot, err := readSecureFile(path, false)
281		if err != nil {
282			return ManagedFile{}, err
283		}
284		definition, err := ParseManaged(snapshot.data)
285		if err != nil {
286			return ManagedFile{}, err
287		}
288		if definition.Alias != alias {
289			return ManagedFile{}, fmt.Errorf("managed alias %q does not match filename %q: %w", definition.Alias, alias, ErrNotManaged)
290		}
291		return ManagedFile{Path: path, Definition: definition, Digest: snapshot.digest, Mode: snapshot.info.Mode().Perm()}, nil

294	func (s *Service) classifyDiscoveredOwnership(definition AliasDefinition) Ownership {
295		relative, err := filepath.Rel(s.paths.ManagedDir, definition.Source.Path)
296		inside := err == nil && relative != "." && relative != ".." && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
297		if !inside {
298			return OwnershipForeign
299		}
300		if err := ValidateManagedAlias(definition.Alias); err != nil {
301			return OwnershipConflict
302		}
303		expected, err := s.paths.ManagedPath(definition.Alias)
304		if err != nil || !samePath(expected, definition.Source.Path) {
305			return OwnershipConflict
306		}
307		managed, err := s.InspectManaged(definition.Alias)
308		if err != nil || !samePath(managed.Path, definition.Source.Path) {
309			return OwnershipConflict
310		}
311		return OwnershipManaged
312	}

314	// PlanManaged performs static collision and concrete ownership checks without
315	// creating directories, lock files, or staging files.
316	func (s *Service) PlanManaged(ctx context.Context, request ManagedRequest) (ManagedPlan, error) {
317		if ctx == nil {
318			ctx = context.Background()
319		}
320		operation := request.Operation
321		if operation == "" {
322			operation = ManagedUpsert
323		}
324		if operation != ManagedUpsert && operation != ManagedRemove {
325			return ManagedPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown managed operation %q", operation)
326		}
327		alias := request.Definition.Alias
328		if err := ValidateManagedAlias(alias); err != nil {
329			return ManagedPlan{}, err
330		}
331		var desired []byte
332		var err error
333		if operation == ManagedUpsert {
334			desired, err = RenderManaged(request.Definition)
335			if err != nil {
336				return ManagedPlan{}, err
337			}
338		}
339		path, err := s.paths.ManagedPath(alias)
340		if err != nil {
341			return ManagedPlan{}, err
342		}
343		plan := ManagedPlan{
344			Operation: operation, Alias: alias, Path: path, Mode: 0o600,
345			AfterDigest: digestBytes(desired),
346		}
347		if operation == ManagedRemove {
348			plan.AfterDigest = ""
349		} else {
350			copy := cloneManagedDefinition(request.Definition)
351			plan.Definition = &copy
352		}
353		block := func(code, message string) (ManagedPlan, error) {
354			plan.Action = ActionBlocked
355			plan.Diagnostics = append(plan.Diagnostics, Diagnostic{
356				Code: code, Message: message, Path: path, BlocksMutation: true,
357			})
358			return plan, nil
359		}
360		if err := inspectExistingTree(s.paths); err != nil {
361			return block("unsafe_tree", err.Error())
362		}
363		if diagnostics := s.inspectManagedNamespace(); len(diagnostics) > 0 {
364			plan.Diagnostics = append(plan.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
365			plan.Action = ActionBlocked
366			return plan, nil
367		}
368		source, err := readSecureFileIfExists(path, false)
369		if err != nil {
370			return block("unsafe_managed_target", err.Error())
371		}
372		plan.BeforeDigest = source.digest
373		if source.exists {
374			definition, parseErr := ParseManaged(source.data)
375			if parseErr != nil || definition.Alias != alias {
376				return block("managed_drift", "target is not the expected canonical dev-owned fragment")
377			}
378		}
379		if operation == ManagedRemove {
380			if !source.exists {
381				plan.Action = ActionNoop
382			} else {
383				plan.Action = ActionRemove
384			}
385			plan.state = &managedPlanState{
386				serviceID: s.id, operation: operation, action: plan.Action, alias: alias, path: path, source: source,
387			}
388			return plan, nil
389		}
390	
391		inventory, err := s.Discover(ctx)
392		if err != nil {
393			return ManagedPlan{}, err
394		}
395		if !inventory.ManagedIncludeActive {
396			return block("managed_include_inactive", "the exact top-level "+rootIncludeLine()+" is not active")
397		}
398		collisions := s.managedCollisionDiagnostics(alias, path, inventory)
399		if len(collisions) > 0 {
400			plan.Diagnostics = append(plan.Diagnostics, collisions...)
401			plan.Action = ActionBlocked
402			return plan, nil
403		}
404		switch {
405		case !source.exists:
406			plan.Action = ActionCreate
407		case bytes.Equal(source.data, desired):
408			plan.Action = ActionNoop
409		default:
410			plan.Action = ActionUpdate
411		}
412		plan.state = &managedPlanState{
413			serviceID: s.id, operation: operation, action: plan.Action, alias: alias, path: path,
414			definition: cloneManagedDefinition(request.Definition), source: source, desired: append([]byte(nil), desired...),
415		}
416		return plan, nil
417	}

429	// ApplyManaged applies only a ready plan produced by this Service. Reapplying a
430	// converged plan is a no-op; any other source divergence is rejected.
431	func (s *Service) ApplyManaged(ctx context.Context, plan ManagedPlan) (ManagedResult, error) {
432		result := ManagedResult{Action: plan.Action, Alias: plan.Alias, Path: plan.Path}
433		if plan.Action == ActionBlocked || plan.state == nil {
434			return result, ErrBlocked
435		}
436		if plan.state.serviceID != s.id || plan.Path != plan.state.path || plan.Alias != plan.state.alias ||
437			plan.Operation != plan.state.operation || plan.Action != plan.state.action {
438			return result, errors.New("managed plan was not produced by this service or its public fields were modified")
439		}
440		if plan.Action == ActionNoop {
441			current, err := snapshotStillCurrent(plan.state.source)
442			if err != nil && plan.Operation == ManagedUpsert {
443				if converged, ok := bytesAlreadyDesired(plan.Path, plan.state.desired); ok {
444					current, err = converged, nil
445				}
446			}
447			if err != nil {
448				return result, fmt.Errorf("apply managed no-op: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
449			}
450			result.Action = ActionNoop
451			result.Digest = current.digest
452			if plan.Operation == ManagedUpsert {
453				if err := s.revalidateManagedInventory(ctx, plan.state.alias, plan.state.path); err != nil {
454					return result, err
455				}
456				if err := s.verifyManagedSnapshot(ctx, plan.state.definition, current); err != nil {
457					return result, err
458				}
459				result.Verified = true
460			}
461			return result, nil
462		}
463		if err := ensureMutationTree(s.paths); err != nil {
464			return result, err
465		}
466		err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.paths.ManagedDir, "SSH host config", func() error {
467			if diagnostics := s.inspectManagedNamespace(); len(diagnostics) > 0 {
468				return fmt.Errorf("managed namespace changed: %s: %w", diagnostics[0].Message, ErrSourceChanged)
469			}
470			if plan.Operation == ManagedUpsert {
471				if err := s.revalidateManagedInventory(ctx, plan.state.alias, plan.state.path); err != nil {
472					return err
473				}
474				if converged, ok := bytesAlreadyDesired(plan.Path, plan.state.desired); ok {
475					result.Action = ActionNoop
476					result.Digest = converged.digest
477					if err := s.verifyManagedSnapshot(ctx, plan.state.definition, converged); err != nil {
478						return err
479					}
480					result.Verified = true
481					return nil
482				}
483			}
484			if plan.Operation == ManagedRemove {
485				current, err := readSecureFileIfExists(plan.state.path, false)
486				if err != nil {
487					return err
488				}
489				if !current.exists {
490					result.Action = ActionNoop
491					return nil
492				}
493				if _, err := compareFileSnapshot(plan.state.source, current); err != nil {
494					return fmt.Errorf("revalidate managed removal: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
495				}
496				if s.beforeManagedCommit != nil {
497					s.beforeManagedCommit()
498				}
499				if err := removeSecureFile(plan.state.source); err != nil {
500					return err
501				}
502				result.Action = ActionRemove
503				result.Changed = true
504				return nil
505			}
506	
507			if _, err := snapshotStillCurrent(plan.state.source); err != nil {
508				return fmt.Errorf("revalidate managed source: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
509			}
510			staged, err := createStagedFile(s.paths.ManagedDir, plan.state.desired, nil)
511			if err != nil {
512				return err
513			}
514			defer staged.discard()
515			if s.beforeManagedCommit != nil {
516				s.beforeManagedCommit()
517			}
518			if err := s.revalidateManagedInventory(ctx, plan.state.alias, plan.state.path); err != nil {
519				return err
520			}
521			if _, err := snapshotStillCurrent(plan.state.source); err != nil {
522				return fmt.Errorf("source changed before managed publication: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
523			}
524			if plan.Action == ActionCreate {
525				err = commitNoReplace(staged, plan.state.path, plan.state.source)
526			} else {
527				err = commitReplace(staged, plan.state.path, plan.state.source)
528			}
529			if err != nil {
530				return err
531			}
532			if s.afterManagedCommit != nil {
533				s.afterManagedCommit()
534			}
535			written, err := readSecureFile(plan.Path, false)
536			if err != nil {
537				return fmt.Errorf("verify managed publication: %w", err)
538			}
539			if !bytes.Equal(written.data, plan.state.desired) {
540				return errors.New("managed publication did not retain desired bytes")
541			}
542			result.Action = plan.Action
543			result.Changed = true
544			result.Digest = written.digest
545			verifyOrRollback := func(verifyErr error) error {
546				rollbackErr := s.rollbackManagedPublication(plan, written)
547				if rollbackErr == nil {
548					result.Changed = false
549					result.RolledBack = true
550					result.Digest = plan.BeforeDigest
551					return fmt.Errorf("verify managed SSH config (publication rolled back): %w", verifyErr)
552				}
553				return errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("verify managed SSH config: %w", verifyErr), fmt.Errorf("rollback managed publication: %w", rollbackErr))
554			}
555			if err := s.revalidateManagedInventory(ctx, plan.state.alias, plan.state.path); err != nil {
556				return verifyOrRollback(err)
557			}
558			if err := s.verifyManagedSnapshot(ctx, plan.state.definition, written); err != nil {
559				return verifyOrRollback(err)
560			}
561			result.Verified = true
562			return nil
563		})
564		return result, err
565	}

567	func (s *Service) revalidateManagedInventory(ctx context.Context, alias, path string) error {
568		inventory, err := s.Discover(ctx)
569		if err != nil {
570			return err
571		}
572		if !inventory.Complete {
573			return fmt.Errorf("SSH config closure became incomplete: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
574		}
575		if !inventory.ManagedIncludeActive {
576			return fmt.Errorf("managed Include became inactive: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
577		}
578		if diagnostics := s.managedCollisionDiagnostics(alias, path, inventory); len(diagnostics) > 0 {
579			return fmt.Errorf("SSH collision appeared after planning: %s: %w", diagnostics[0].Message, ErrSourceChanged)
580		}
581		return nil
582	}
583	
584	func (s *Service) verifyManagedSnapshot(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition, expected fileSnapshot) error {
585		if err := s.verifyManagedEffective(ctx, definition); err != nil {
586			return err
587		}
588		// ssh -G is effectful: Match exec and other configured helpers may mutate the
589		// active closure. Re-prove completeness and collision freedom only after that
590		// subprocess returns, then confirm the published identity is still ours.
591		if err := s.revalidateManagedInventory(ctx, definition.Alias, expected.path); err != nil {
592			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate managed SSH config after ssh -G: %w", err)
593		}
594		if _, err := snapshotStillCurrent(expected); err != nil {
595			return fmt.Errorf("managed file changed during ssh -G verification: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
596		}
597		return nil
598	}
599	
600	func (s *Service) rollbackManagedPublication(plan ManagedPlan, written fileSnapshot) error {
601		if _, err := snapshotStillCurrent(written); err != nil {
602			return fmt.Errorf("published managed identity is no longer owned: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
603		}
604		switch plan.state.action {
605		case ActionCreate:
606			if err := removeSecureFile(written); err != nil {
607				return err
608			}
609			current, err := readSecureFileIfExists(plan.state.path, false)
610			if err != nil {
611				return err
612			}
613			if current.exists {
614				return fmt.Errorf("created managed file remains after rollback: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
615			}
616			return nil
617		case ActionUpdate:
618			staged, err := createStagedFile(s.paths.ManagedDir, plan.state.source.data, nil)
619			if err != nil {
620				return err
621			}
622			defer staged.discard()
623			if err := commitReplace(staged, plan.state.path, written); err != nil {
624				return err
625			}
626			restored, err := readSecureFile(plan.state.path, false)
627			if err != nil {
628				return err
629			}
630			if !bytes.Equal(restored.data, plan.state.source.data) || restored.digest != plan.state.source.digest {
631				return fmt.Errorf("managed bytes differ after rollback: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
632			}
633			return nil
634		default:
635			return fmt.Errorf("managed action %q cannot be rolled back", plan.state.action)
636		}
637	}

639	func (s *Service) managedCollisionDiagnostics(alias, target string, inventory Inventory) []Diagnostic {
640		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
641		incompleteBlocked := false
642		for _, diagnostic := range inventory.Diagnostics {
643			if diagnostic.BlocksMutation {
644				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic)
645				incompleteBlocked = incompleteBlocked || diagnostic.Incomplete
646			}
647		}
648		if !inventory.Complete && !incompleteBlocked {
649			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
650				Code: "discovery_incomplete", Message: "the active SSH config closure could not be proven complete",
651				Path: inventory.Root, Incomplete: true, BlocksMutation: true,
652			})
653		}
654		for _, declaration := range inventory.Declarations {
655			if samePath(declaration.Source.Path, target) {
656				continue
657			}
658			guards := []Guard(nil)
659			if len(declaration.Provenance) > 0 {
660				guards = declaration.Provenance[len(declaration.Provenance)-1].Guards
661			}
662			reachability := evaluateReachability(alias, guards)
663			if reachability == Unreachable || !patternListMatches(alias, declaration.Patterns) {
664				continue
665			}
666			code := "foreign_wildcard_collision"
667			message := fmt.Sprintf("foreign Host pattern at %s:%d may match %q", declaration.Source.Path, declaration.Source.Line, alias)
668			for _, exact := range declaration.ExactAliases {
669				if equalAlias(exact, alias) {
670					code = "foreign_exact_collision"
671					message = fmt.Sprintf("foreign exact Host %q already exists at %s:%d", exact, declaration.Source.Path, declaration.Source.Line)
672					break
673				}
674			}
675			location := declaration.Source
676			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
677				Code: code, Message: message, Path: declaration.Source.Path, Source: &location, BlocksMutation: true,
678				Incomplete: reachability == Unknown,
679			})
680		}
681		return diagnostics
682	}
683	
684	func (s *Service) inspectManagedNamespace() []Diagnostic {
685		info, err := os.Lstat(s.paths.ManagedDir)
686		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
687			return nil
688		}
689		block := func(code, message, path string) []Diagnostic {
690			return []Diagnostic{{Code: code, Message: message, Path: path, BlocksMutation: true}}
691		}
692		if err != nil {
693			return block("managed_namespace_unreadable", err.Error(), s.paths.ManagedDir)
694		}
695		if err := validatePrivateDirectory(s.paths.ManagedDir, info); err != nil {
696			return block("managed_namespace_unsafe", err.Error(), s.paths.ManagedDir)
697		}
698		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.paths.ManagedDir)
699		if err != nil {
700			return block("managed_namespace_unreadable", err.Error(), s.paths.ManagedDir)
701		}
702		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
703		folded := make(map[string]string)
704		for _, entry := range entries {
705			name := entry.Name()
706			path := filepath.Join(s.paths.ManagedDir, name)
707			if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".conf") {
708				return block("managed_namespace_foreign_entry", fmt.Sprintf("unexpected entry %q in managed namespace", name), path)
709			}
710			alias := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".conf")
711			if err := ValidateManagedAlias(alias); err != nil {
712				return block("managed_namespace_invalid_name", err.Error(), path)
713			}
714			key := foldAlias(name)
715			if previous, ok := folded[key]; ok && previous != name {
716				return block("managed_namespace_casefold_collision", fmt.Sprintf("%q and %q collide case-insensitively", previous, name), path)
717			}
718			folded[key] = name
719			snapshot, err := readSecureFile(path, false)
720			if err != nil {
721				return block("managed_namespace_unsafe_entry", err.Error(), path)
722			}
723			definition, err := ParseManaged(snapshot.data)
724			if err != nil || definition.Alias != alias {
725				return block("managed_namespace_drift", fmt.Sprintf("%q is not a canonical fragment matching its filename", name), path)
726			}
727		}
728		return nil
729	}
730	
731	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
732		left, right = filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right)
733		if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
734			return strings.EqualFold(left, right)
735		}
736		return left == right
737	}
738
```

```text
34	func (s *Service) evaluateSSHConfig(ctx context.Context, alias string, args []string, display, errorContext string, stderrOnExit bool) (EffectiveConfig, error) {

37		}

39			Name: "ssh", Args: args, Env: []string{"LC_ALL=C"}, Display: display,
40		})
41		if err != nil {
42			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", errorContext, err)
43		}
44		if result.ExitCode != 0 {
45			message := ""
46			if stderrOnExit {
47				message = strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
48			}
49			if message == "" {

57	// VerifyManaged evaluates the ordinary user+system SSH configuration with
58	// plain ssh -G and checks that every scalar emitted by the managed fragment is
59	// effective. IdentityFile is additive, so managed expectations must appear in
60	// order but unrelated system/default identities may also be present.
61	func (s *Service) VerifyManaged(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
62		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
63			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
64		}
65		effective, err := s.Effective(ctx, definition.Alias)
66		if err != nil {
67			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
68		}
69		if err := VerifyManagedEffective(definition, effective); err != nil {
70			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
71		}
72		return effective, nil
73	}

75	// VerifyManagedEffective compares a managed definition with parsed ssh -G
76	// output. Error text names mismatched fields without echoing configuration
77	// values that may contain command-like user input.
78	func VerifyManagedEffective(definition ManagedDefinition, effective EffectiveConfig) error {
79		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
80			return err
81		}
82		var mismatches []string
83		if !equalAlias(definition.Alias, effective.Alias) {
84			mismatches = append(mismatches, "Alias")
85		}
86		if definition.HostName != effective.HostName {
87			mismatches = append(mismatches, "HostName")
88		}
89		if definition.User != "" && definition.User != effective.User {
90			mismatches = append(mismatches, "User")
91		}
92		if definition.Port != 0 && definition.Port != effective.Port {
93			mismatches = append(mismatches, "Port")
94		}
95		if definition.ProxyJump != "" && definition.ProxyJump != effective.ProxyJump {
96			mismatches = append(mismatches, "ProxyJump")
97		}
98		if definition.IdentitiesOnly != nil && (effective.IdentitiesOnly == nil || *definition.IdentitiesOnly != *effective.IdentitiesOnly) {
99			mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentitiesOnly")
100		}
101		if definition.IdentityFile != "" && !containsOrderedValues(effective.IdentityFiles, []string{definition.IdentityFile}) {
102			mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentityFile")
103		}
104		if len(mismatches) > 0 {
105			return fmt.Errorf("managed SSH config does not control effective fields: %s", strings.Join(mismatches, ", "))
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func (s *Service) verifyManagedEffective(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition) error {
111		_, err := s.VerifyManaged(ctx, definition)
112		return err
113	}
114	
115	func firstEffectiveValue(effective EffectiveConfig, key string) string {
116		if values := effective.Values[key]; len(values) > 0 {
117			return values[0]
118		}
119		return ""
120	}
121	
122	func containsOrderedValues(actual, expected []string) bool {
123		next := 0
124		for _, value := range actual {
125			if next < len(expected) && value == expected[next] {
126				next++
127			}
128		}
129		return next == len(expected)
130	}
131	
132	// ValidateLookupAlias prevents option injection while retaining foreign exact
133	// aliases outside the narrower managed grammar.
134	func ValidateLookupAlias(alias string) error {
135		if alias == "" || len(alias) > 255 || !utf8.ValidString(alias) {
136			return fmt.Errorf("invalid SSH alias %q", alias)
137		}
138		if strings.HasPrefix(alias, "-") || strings.ContainsAny(alias, "*?[]!") {
139			return fmt.Errorf("invalid exact SSH alias %q", alias)
140		}
141		for _, r := range alias {
142			if unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsControl(r) {
143				return fmt.Errorf("invalid exact SSH alias %q", alias)
144			}
145		}
146		return nil
147	}
148	
149	// ParseEffective parses ssh -G's stable key/value output. Unknown keys remain
150	// in Values for future domain consumers without becoming a public CLI schema.
151	func ParseEffective(alias string, output []byte) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
152		config := EffectiveConfig{Alias: alias, Values: make(map[string][]string)}
153		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(output))
154		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4096), 2<<20)
155		for scanner.Scan() {
156			line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
157			if line == "" {
158				continue
159			}
160			separator := strings.IndexFunc(line, unicode.IsSpace)
161			if separator < 1 {
162				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: malformed line %q", line)
163			}
164			key := strings.ToLower(line[:separator])
165			value := strings.TrimSpace(line[separator:])
166			if value == "" {
167				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: %s has no value", key)
168			}
169			config.Values[key] = append(config.Values[key], value)
170		}
171		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
172			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: %w", err)
173		}
174		config.HostName = firstEffectiveValue(config, "hostname")
175		config.User = firstEffectiveValue(config, "user")
176		config.ProxyJump = firstEffectiveValue(config, "proxyjump")
177		config.IdentityFiles = append([]string(nil), config.Values["identityfile"]...)
178		if value := firstEffectiveValue(config, "port"); value != "" {
179			port, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
180			if err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 {
181				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: invalid port %q", value)
182			}
183			config.Port = port
184		}
185		if value := firstEffectiveValue(config, "identitiesonly"); value != "" {
186			var enabled bool
187			switch strings.ToLower(value) {
188			case "yes", "true":
189				enabled = true
190			case "no", "false":
191				enabled = false
192			default:
193				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: invalid identitiesonly %q", value)
194			}
195			config.IdentitiesOnly = &enabled
196		}
197		return config, nil
198	}
```

```text
76	// ParsePublicKey parses and fingerprints one bounded OpenSSH public-key record
77	// without returning the record or decoded wire bytes.
78	func ParsePublicKey(data []byte) (KeyMetadata, error) {
79		record, err := parsePublicKeyRecord(data)
80		if err != nil {
81			return KeyMetadata{}, err
82		}
83		return record.metadata, nil

86	func parsePublicKeyRecord(data []byte) (publicKeyRecord, error) {
87		if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > MaxPublicKeyLineBytes {
88			return publicKeyRecord{}, fmt.Errorf("OpenSSH public record must be 1-%d bytes", MaxPublicKeyLineBytes)
89		}
90		line := append([]byte(nil), data...)
91		if line[len(line)-1] == '\n' {
92			line = line[:len(line)-1]
93			if len(line) > 0 && line[len(line)-1] == '\r' {
94				line = line[:len(line)-1]
95			}
96		}
97		if len(line) == 0 || bytes.IndexAny(line, "\r\n\x00") >= 0 || !utf8.Valid(line) {
98			return publicKeyRecord{}, errors.New("OpenSSH public record is not one valid UTF-8 line")
99		}
100		text := strings.TrimSpace(string(line))
101		algorithm, rest, ok := cutPublicField(text)
102		if !ok || !validPublicAlgorithm(algorithm) {
103			return publicKeyRecord{}, errors.New("OpenSSH public record has an invalid algorithm")
104		}
105		encoded, comment, ok := cutPublicField(rest)
106		if !ok || encoded == "" {
107			return publicKeyRecord{}, errors.New("OpenSSH public record has no key blob")
108		}
109		comment = strings.TrimSpace(comment)
110		if len(comment) > maxKeyCommentBytes || !validUTF8NoControl(comment) {
111			return publicKeyRecord{}, errors.New("OpenSSH public record has an invalid comment")
112		}
113		blob, err := decodePublicBlob(encoded)
114		if err != nil {
115			return publicKeyRecord{}, errors.New("OpenSSH public record has an invalid base64 blob")
116		}
117		if len(blob) == 0 || len(blob) > MaxPublicKeyBlobBytes {
118			return publicKeyRecord{}, fmt.Errorf("OpenSSH public blob must be 1-%d bytes", MaxPublicKeyBlobBytes)
119		}
120		if err := validatePublicWireBlob(algorithm, blob); err != nil {
121			return publicKeyRecord{}, fmt.Errorf("validate OpenSSH public blob: %w", err)
122		}
123		sum := sha256.Sum256(blob)
124		metadata := KeyMetadata{
125			Algorithm:   algorithm,
126			Comment:     comment,
127			Fingerprint: "SHA256:" + base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(sum[:]),
128		}
129		normalized := algorithm + " " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(blob)
130		if comment != "" {
131			normalized += " " + comment
132		}
133		return publicKeyRecord{metadata: metadata, normalized: []byte(normalized), blob: append([]byte(nil), blob...)}, nil
134	}
135	
136	func cutPublicField(value string) (field, rest string, ok bool) {
137		value = strings.TrimLeftFunc(value, unicode.IsSpace)
138		if value == "" {
139			return "", "", false
140		}
```

```text
644		if err != nil {
645			if ctx.Err() != nil {
646				return nil, nil, ctx.Err()
647			}
648			return nil, []string{"agent_unavailable"}, nil
649		}
650		if result.ExitCode == 1 {
651			return nil, nil, nil
652		}
653		if result.ExitCode != 0 {
654			return nil, []string{"agent_unavailable"}, nil
655		}
656		if result.StdoutTruncated || len(result.Stdout) > maxAgentCatalogBytes {
657			return nil, []string{"agent_output_limit_exceeded"}, nil
658		}
659		lines := bytes.Split(result.Stdout, []byte{'\n'})
660		var diagnostics []string
661		if len(lines) > maxCatalogFiles+1 {
662			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, "agent_key_limit_exceeded")
663			lines = lines[:maxCatalogFiles]
664		}
665		var records []publicKeyRecord

670			}

672			if err != nil {

674				continue
675			}
676			records = append(records, record)
677		}
678		if invalid {
679			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, "agent_key_invalid")
680		}

682			if records[i].metadata.Fingerprint == records[j].metadata.Fingerprint {
683				return records[i].metadata.Comment < records[j].metadata.Comment
684			}
685			return records[i].metadata.Fingerprint < records[j].metadata.Fingerprint
686		})
687		return records, diagnostics, nil

705			return "Invalid OpenSSH public key: " + reason + ". Check the .pub file format or manually recreate its public companion from the matching private key."

829	func (s *Service) resolveIdentityAgent(value string) (path string, enabled bool, err error) {
830		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
831		switch {
832		case value == "", strings.EqualFold(value, "SSH_AUTH_SOCK"):
833			return "", true, nil
834		case strings.EqualFold(value, "none"):
835			return "", false, nil
836		}
837		resolved := value
838		switch {

868	func mergeCatalogEntry(entry *catalogEntry, candidate KeyCandidate) {

873			entry.safe.PublicPath = candidate.PublicPath

887		entry.safe.Provenance.Private = entry.safe.Provenance.Private || candidate.Provenance.Private
888		entry.safe.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub = entry.safe.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub || candidate.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub
889		entry.safe.Provenance.Agent = entry.safe.Provenance.Agent || candidate.Provenance.Agent

894			entry.safe.IdentityFile = candidate.IdentityFile
895		}
896		if candidate.Provenance.Effective && !wasEffective {
```

```text
1200			return KeyResult{Action: plan.Action, Operation: plan.Operation}, ErrBlocked
1201		}
1202		state := plan.state
1203		if state.serviceID != s.id || !equalKeyPlans(plan, state.public) {
1204			return KeyResult{}, errors.New("key plan was not produced by this service or its public fields were modified")
1205		}
1206		switch plan.Operation {
1207		case KeyUse:
1208			if state.material == nil {
1209				return KeyResult{}, errors.New("selected key plan has no material state")
1210			}
1211			verification, err := s.verifyKeyPair(ctx, state.material, state.request.Interactive)
1212			if err != nil {
1213				return KeyResult{}, err
1214			}
1215			candidate := s.bindVerifiedKeyMaterial(state.material.safe, state.material.publicLine, verification)
1216			if state.material.agent != nil {
1217				copy := *state.material.agent
1218				candidate.state.agent = &copy
1219			}
1220			return KeyResult{Action: ActionNoop, Operation: KeyUse, Candidate: candidate}, nil
1221		case KeyDerive:
1222			return s.applyDerivedKey(ctx, plan)
1223		case KeyGenerate:
1224			return s.applyGeneratedKey(ctx, plan)
1225		default:
1226			return KeyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported key plan operation %q", plan.Operation)
1227		}

1230	// RevalidateKeySelection checks a reviewed selection before any configuration
1231	// effect. It does not decrypt, derive, generate, write, or repair key material.
1232	// Agent selections query only their captured agent's public inventory.
1233	func (s *Service) RevalidateKeySelection(ctx context.Context, plan KeyPlan) error {
1234		if ctx == nil {
1235			ctx = context.Background()
1236		}
1237		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1238			return err
1239		}
1240		if plan.Action == ActionBlocked || plan.state == nil {
1241			return ErrBlocked
1242		}
1243		state := plan.state
1244		if state.serviceID != s.id || !equalKeyPlans(plan, state.public) {
1245			return errors.New("key plan was not produced by this service or its public fields were modified")
1246		}
1247		switch plan.Operation {
1248		case KeyUse:
1249			if state.material == nil {
1250				return errors.New("selected key plan has no material state")
1251			}
1252			return s.revalidateSelectedKeySources(ctx, state.material)
1253		case KeyDerive:
1254			if err := s.revalidateSelectedKeyIdentity(state.identity); err != nil {
1255				return err
1256			}
1257			current, err := s.inspectPublicDestination(plan.PublicPath)
1258			if err != nil {
1259				return err
1260			}
1261			if current.exists != state.expectedPublic.exists {
1262				return ErrKeyCollision
1263			}
1264			return nil
1265		case KeyGenerate:
1266			parent := filepath.Dir(plan.IdentityFile)
1267			if err := s.validateKeyParent(parent); err != nil {
1268				_, statErr := os.Lstat(parent)
1269				missingAllowed := samePath(parent, s.paths.SSHDir) || plan.CreateParent != "" && samePath(parent, plan.CreateParent)
1270				if !missingAllowed || !errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
1271					return err
1272				}
1273				if err := validateHomeDirectory(s.paths.Home); err != nil {
1274					return err
1275				}
1276				if info, err := os.Lstat(s.paths.SSHDir); err == nil {
1277					if err := validatePrivateDirectory(s.paths.SSHDir, info); err != nil {
1278						return err
1279					}
1280				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
1281					return err
1282				}
1283			}
1284			for _, path := range []string{plan.IdentityFile, plan.PublicPath} {
1285				if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
1286					return ErrKeyCollision
1287				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
1288					return err
1289				}
1290			}
1291			return nil
1292		default:
1293			return errors.New("unsupported key selection operation")
1294		}
1295	}

1297	func equalKeyPlans(left, right KeyPlan) bool {
1298		left.state = nil
1299		right.state = nil
1300		return reflect.DeepEqual(left, right)
1301	}

1333			return nil, errors.New("selected public companion changed")
1334		}
1335		if previous := material.pairVerification; previous != nil {
1336			if previous.publicPath != safe.PublicPath || previous.fingerprint != companion.metadata.Fingerprint ||
1337				previous.identity.path != identity.path || !sameSelectedKeyIdentity(previous.identity, identity) {
1338				return nil, fmt.Errorf("selected key pair changed after verification: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
1339			}
1340			return cloneKeyPairVerification(previous), nil

1342

1344			Name: "ssh-keygen", Args: []string{"-y", "-f", identity.path},
1345			Interactive: interactive, CaptureStdout: true, Display: "ssh-keygen verify public companion",
1346		}
1347		if !interactive {
1348			request.Env = noninteractiveKeygenEnv()
1349		}
1350		result, err := s.runner.Run(ctx, request)

1357		if result.ExitCode != 0 {

1360			}

1370		}

1373		}

1380		}
1381		return &keyPairVerification{
1382			identity: identity, publicPath: safe.PublicPath, fingerprint: companion.metadata.Fingerprint,
1383		}, nil
```

```text
		var planned sshhost.KeyPlan
		var planErr error
		if options.keyPlan != nil {
			// A picker-prepared plan is revalidated rather than planned (and confirmed) twice.
			planned, planErr = *options.keyPlan, service.RevalidateKeySelection(ctx, *options.keyPlan)
		} else {
			planned, planErr = planSSHSetupKey(ctx, app, service, options, interactiveMode)
		}
		keyPlan = &planned
		document.KeyPlan = keyPlan
		if planErr != nil {
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(planErr)
			return finish(document, planErr)
		}
		if ownsDefinition && !options.identityFileChanged && planned.IdentityFile != "" {
			definition.IdentityFile = planned.IdentityFile
		}
	}

	var plannedRoute *sshhost.Route
	if ownsDefinition && (definition.ProxyJump != "" || options.proxyJumpChanged) {
		route, e := planSSHLocalRoute(ctx, service, alias, []sshhost.ManagedDefinition{definition}, options.dryRun)
		if e != nil {
			return finish(document, e)
		}
		plannedRoute = &route
	}
	if ownsDefinition {
		document.Definition = cloneSSHManagedDefinition(definition)
		managedPlan, planErr := service.PlanUpsert(ctx, definition)
		document.ManagedPlan = &managedPlan
		if planErr != nil {
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(planErr)
			return finish(document, planErr)
		}
		renderSSHDiagnostics(app, managedPlan.Diagnostics)
		if !managedPlan.Ready() || managedPlan.Action == sshhost.ActionBlocked {
			err := fmt.Errorf("managed SSH plan is blocked: %w", sshhost.ErrBlocked)
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = "managed_plan_blocked"
			return finish(document, err)
		}
	}
	if keyPlan != nil {
		renderSSHDiagnostics(app, keyPlan.Diagnostics)
		if !keyPlan.Ready() || keyPlan.Action == sshhost.ActionBlocked {
			err := fmt.Errorf("SSH key plan is blocked: %w", sshhost.ErrBlocked)
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = "key_plan_blocked"
			return finish(document, err)
		}
	}

	targetOS, _ := parseSSHRemoteOS(options.targetOS)
	overrides, _ := parseSSHOSOverrides(options.hopOS)
	if options.fleet {
		if targetOS == sshhost.RemoteOSUnknown {
			err := errors.New("--fleet requires --target-os posix or windows")
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = "target_os_required"
			return finish(document, err)
		}
		change, facts, fleetErr := planSSHFleetRegistration(app, alias, options.fleetName, targetOS)
		document.Fleet = change
		document.FleetMembership = facts
		if fleetErr != nil {
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(fleetErr)
			return finish(document, fleetErr)
		}
	} else if cfg, fleetErr := loadFleetConfig(app); fleetErr == nil {
		document.FleetMembership = indexFleetFacts(cfg)[foldFleetAlias(alias)]
	} else {
		app.warnf("SSH setup could not load fleet membership: %v", fleetErr)
	}

	if options.dryRun {
		bootstrapPlan, planErr := service.PlanBootstrap(sshhost.BootstrapRequest{
			Alias: alias, TargetRemoteOS: targetOS, OSOverrides: overrides,
			InstallOnWorkingJump:            options.installOnWorkingJump,
			AllowWindowsAdminAuthorizedKeys: options.windowsAdminAuthorizedKeys,
		})
		document.BootstrapPlan = &bootstrapPlan
		if planErr != nil {
			document.Status = "blocked"
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(planErr)
			return finish(document, planErr)
		}
		document.Status = "planned"
		return finish(document, nil)
	}

	localApply := keyPlan != nil || document.ManagedPlan != nil
	if localApply && !options.yes {
		if !interactiveMode {
			document.Status = "confirmation_required"
			document.ErrorCode = "confirmation_required"
			return finish(document, errors.New("--yes is required to apply SSH setup without an interactive terminal"))
		}
		renderSSHSetupPlan(app, document)
		confirmed, promptErr := newPrompter(app).confirm("Apply this local SSH setup plan?", false)
		if promptErr != nil {
			return promptErr
		}
		if !confirmed {
			return errPromptCanceled
		}
	}

	if plannedRoute != nil {
		fresh, e := planSSHLocalRoute(ctx, service, alias, []sshhost.ManagedDefinition{definition}, false)
		if e != nil {
			return finish(document, e)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(plannedRoute.Hops, fresh.Hops) {
			return finish(document, sshhost.ErrSourceChanged)
		}
	}
	if e := sourceGuard.Check(ctx); e != nil {
		return finish(document, e)
	}
	var keyResult sshhost.KeyResult
	if keyPlan != nil {
		app.warnf("applying SSH key plan for %s", alias)
		applied, applyErr := service.ApplyKey(ctx, *keyPlan)
		document.KeyResult = &applied
		if applyErr != nil {
			document.Status = "failed"
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(applyErr)
			return finish(document, applyErr)
		}
		keyResult = applied
	}
	if document.ManagedPlan != nil {
		if e := sourceGuard.Check(ctx); e != nil {
			return finish(document, e)
		}
		app.warnf("applying managed SSH config for %s", alias)
		applied, applyErr := service.ApplyManaged(ctx, *document.ManagedPlan)
		document.ManagedResult = &applied
		if applyErr != nil {
			document.Status = setupFailureStatus(document)
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(applyErr)
			return finish(document, applyErr)
		}
	}
	if options.configOnly {
		if aliasClass == "foreign" {
			app.warnf("config-only verification runs plain ssh -G; configured Match exec and resolver behavior may run")
			effective, effectiveErr := service.Effective(ctx, alias)
			if effectiveErr != nil {
				document.Status = "failed"
				document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(effectiveErr)
				return finish(document, effectiveErr)
			}
			document.Effective = &effective
		}
		document.Status = "ready"
		return finish(document, nil)
	}

	app.warnf("resolving SSH route for %s with plain ssh -G", alias)
	route, routeErr := service.ResolveRoute(ctx, sshhost.RouteRequest{Alias: alias, TargetRemoteOS: targetOS, OSOverrides: overrides})
	if routeErr != nil {
		document.Status = setupFailureStatus(document)
		document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(routeErr)
		return finish(document, routeErr)
	}
	route, overrides, routeErr = completeSSHRouteOS(ctx, app, service, route, alias, targetOS, overrides, interactiveMode)
	if routeErr != nil {
		document.Status = setupFailureStatus(document)
		document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(routeErr)
		return finish(document, routeErr)
	}

	var authentication *sshhost.AuthenticationOperation
	if interactiveMode {
		authentication, err = prepareSSHAuthentication(ctx, app, service, alias, options.passwordStore, false)
		if err != nil {
			return finish(document, err)
		}
		defer authentication.Close()
		if !authentication.UsesPassword() {
			_ = authentication.Close()
			authentication = nil
		}
	}
	app.warnf("bootstrapping public-key authentication for %s", alias)
	bootstrap, bootstrapErr := service.Bootstrap(ctx, sshhost.BootstrapRequest{
		Alias:                           alias,
		Route:                           route,
		Key:                             keyResult,
		Authentication:                  authentication,
		TargetRemoteOS:                  targetOS,
		OSOverrides:                     overrides,
		Interactive:                     interactiveMode,
		InstallOnWorkingJump:            options.installOnWorkingJump,
		AllowWindowsAdminAuthorizedKeys: options.windowsAdminAuthorizedKeys,
	})
	document.BootstrapResult = &bootstrap
	if bootstrapErr != nil {
		document.Status = setupFailureStatus(document)
		document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(bootstrapErr)
		return finish(document, bootstrapErr)
	}
	if !bootstrap.Ready || !bootstrap.FleetReady {
		document.Status = "partial"
		document.ErrorCode = "bootstrap_partial"
		return finish(document, errors.New("SSH bootstrap is partial; rerun setup after resolving the reported hop"))
	}
	if options.fleet {
		app.warnf("registering verified SSH alias %s in dev fleet", alias)
		_, fleetErr := fleet.WriteManagedFragment(ctx, fleetConfigPath(app), fleet.ManagedHost{
			Name: document.Fleet.Name, SSHAlias: alias, RemoteOS: string(bootstrap.TargetRemoteOS),
		}, nil)
		if fleetErr != nil {
			document.Status = "partial"
			document.Fleet.Action = "failed"
			document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(fleetErr)
			return finish(document, fleetErr)
		}
		document.Fleet.Action = "registered"
	}
	document.Status = "ready"
	return finish(document, nil)
}
```

```text
type keySelector struct {
	identity    string
	certificate string
	agent       *keyAgentContext
	fingerprint string
}

func (s *Service) prepareKeySelector(material *keyMaterialState) (keySelector, func(), error) {
	emptyCleanup := func() {}
	if material == nil {
		return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, errors.New("selected key has no material state")
	}
	safe := material.safe
	record, err := parsePublicKeyRecord(material.publicLine)
	if err != nil || record.metadata.Fingerprint != safe.Fingerprint {
		return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, errors.New("selected public key material changed")
	}
	certificate := strings.HasSuffix(record.metadata.Algorithm, "-cert-v01@openssh.com")
	backedByIdentity := (safe.Provenance.Private || safe.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub) && safe.IdentityFile != ""
	if backedByIdentity {
		identity, inspectErr := s.inspectSelectedKeyIdentity(safe.IdentityFile)
		if inspectErr != nil {
			return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, fmt.Errorf("validate selected identity: %w", inspectErr)
		}
		if material.pairVerification == nil || material.pairVerification.identity.path != identity.path ||
			!sameSelectedKeyIdentity(material.pairVerification.identity, identity) {
			return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, fmt.Errorf("selected identity changed after key-pair proof: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
		}
		if safe.PublicPath != "" {
			companion, readErr := s.readPublicKeyFile(safe.PublicPath)
			if readErr != nil || companion.metadata.Fingerprint != safe.Fingerprint || !publicLinesEqual(companion.normalized, material.publicLine) {
				return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, errors.New("selected public companion changed")
			}
		}
		selector := keySelector{identity: safe.IdentityFile}
		if certificate {
			selector.certificate = safe.PublicPath
			if selector.certificate == "" {
				return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, errors.New("selected certificate has no validated certificate file")
			}
		}
		return selector, emptyCleanup, nil
	}

	var stagedFiles []*stagedFile
	cleanup := func() {
		for index := len(stagedFiles) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
			_ = stagedFiles[index].discard()
		}
	}
	stage := func(line []byte) (string, error) {
		if err := ensurePrivateChild(s.paths.Home, ".ssh", false); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		staged, stageErr := createStagedFile(s.paths.SSHDir, append(append([]byte(nil), line...), '\n'), nil)
		if stageErr != nil {
			return "", stageErr
		}
		stagedFiles = append(stagedFiles, staged)
		return filepath.Join(staged.dir, staged.name), nil
	}

	if certificate {
		base, baseErr := basePublicKeyRecord(record)
		if baseErr != nil {
			return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, baseErr
		}
		identity, stageErr := stage(base.normalized)
		if stageErr != nil {
			cleanup()
			return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, stageErr
		}
		certificatePath := safe.PublicPath
		if certificatePath != "" {
			current, readErr := s.readPublicKeyFile(certificatePath)
			if readErr != nil || current.metadata.Fingerprint != safe.Fingerprint || !publicLinesEqual(current.normalized, material.publicLine) {
				cleanup()
				return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, errors.New("selected certificate changed")
			}
		} else {
			certificatePath, stageErr = stage(record.normalized)
			if stageErr != nil {
				cleanup()
				return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, stageErr
			}
		}
		return keySelector{identity: identity, certificate: certificatePath, agent: material.agent, fingerprint: safe.Fingerprint}, cleanup, nil
	}

	if safe.PublicPath != "" {
		current, readErr := s.readPublicKeyFile(safe.PublicPath)
		if readErr != nil || current.metadata.Fingerprint != safe.Fingerprint || !publicLinesEqual(current.normalized, material.publicLine) {
			return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, errors.New("selected public key changed")
		}
		return keySelector{identity: safe.PublicPath, agent: material.agent, fingerprint: safe.Fingerprint}, emptyCleanup, nil
	}
	identity, err := stage(record.normalized)
	if err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return keySelector{}, emptyCleanup, err
	}
	return keySelector{identity: identity, agent: material.agent, fingerprint: safe.Fingerprint}, cleanup, nil
}

const (
	sshConnectTimeout        = "15"
	sshServerAliveInterval   = "30"
	sshServerAliveCountMax   = "3"
	exactProofConfigPreamble = "# private dev-cli exact-key proof configuration\n"

func appendFreshSSHOptions(args []string, batch bool) []string {
	args = append(args,
		"-S", "none",
		"-o", "ConnectTimeout="+sshConnectTimeout,
		"-o", "ServerAliveInterval="+sshServerAliveInterval,
		"-o", "ServerAliveCountMax="+sshServerAliveCountMax,
	)
	if batch {
		args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes")
	}
	return args
}

func (s *Service) runSSHProof(ctx context.Context, hop routeHopState, selector keySelector, exact bool) (bool, error) {
	if !exact {
		result, err := s.runHopSSH(ctx, hop, true, "exit 0", nil, false, "ssh authentication proof")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		return result.ExitCode == 0, nil
	}
	if selector.identity == "" {
		return false, errors.New("exact SSH proof requires an identity selector")
	}
	if selector.agent != nil {
		value := firstEffectiveValue(hop.effective, "identityagent")
		configured, enabled, err := s.resolveIdentityAgent(value)
		if err != nil || !enabled || configured != "" && configured != selector.agent.socket {
			return false, errors.Join(ErrUnprovenAuthentication, ErrAgentPolicyMismatch)
		}
		if err := s.revalidateAgentKey(ctx, selector.agent, selector.fingerprint); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	configPath, destination, cleanup, err := s.prepareExactProofConfig(hop, selector)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer cleanup()
	log, err := createStagedFile(s.paths.SSHDir, nil, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("prepare private authentication proof: %w", err)
	}
	defer log.discard()
	logPath := filepath.Join(log.dir, log.name)
	// -E confines the client authentication evidence to this process. Unlike
	// -v, LogLevel does not propagate verbosity into implicit ProxyJump clients.
	args := appendFreshSSHOptions([]string{"-F", configPath, "-E", logPath, "-o", "LogLevel=DEBUG1"}, true)
	args = append(args, destination, "exit 0")
	// A captured socket is scoped to the target stanza. ProxyJump children must
	// retain the ambient agent selected by their own ordinary configuration.
	result, err := s.runner.Run(ctx, RunRequest{
		Name: "ssh", Args: args, Env: []string{"LC_ALL=C"}, Display: "ssh selected-key-only authentication proof",
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	snapshot, err := readSecureFileAt(log.root, log.name, logPath, false)
	if err != nil || !snapshot.exists || !os.SameFile(log.snapshot.info, snapshot.info) {
		return false, ErrUnprovenAuthentication
	}
	return selectedKeyAuthentication(snapshot.data, result.ExitCode)
}

func (s *Service) prepareExactProofConfig(hop routeHopState, selector keySelector) (string, string, func(), error) {
	route := append([]proofRouteHop(nil), hop.proofRoute...)
	if len(route) == 0 {
		hostName := hop.safe.HostName
		if hostName == "" {
			hostName = hop.destination
		}
		route = []proofRouteHop{{
			alias: hop.destination, reference: hop.safe.Reference, hostName: hostName,
			user: hop.safe.User, port: hop.safe.Port, effective: cloneEffective(hop.effective),
		}}
	}

			return nil, fmt.Errorf("relative or whitespace-containing known-hosts paths cannot be copied safely: %w", ErrUnsupportedRoute)
		}
	}
	return paths, nil
}

func writeSelectedAuthentication(body *strings.Builder, effective EffectiveConfig, selector keySelector, interactive ...bool) error {
	if !validUTF8NoControl(selector.identity) || !filepath.IsAbs(selector.identity) ||
		selector.certificate != "" && (!validUTF8NoControl(selector.certificate) || !filepath.IsAbs(selector.certificate)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("selected identity path is unsafe: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	writeConfigDirective(body, "IdentityFile", "none")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "CertificateFile", "none")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "IdentityFile", selector.identity)
	if selector.certificate != "" {
		writeConfigDirective(body, "CertificateFile", selector.certificate)
	}
	writeConfigDirective(body, "IdentitiesOnly", "yes")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "PubkeyAuthentication", "yes")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "PreferredAuthentications", "publickey")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "PasswordAuthentication", "no")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "KbdInteractiveAuthentication", "no")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "ChallengeResponseAuthentication", "no")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "GSSAPIAuthentication", "no")
	writeConfigDirective(body, "HostbasedAuthentication", "no")
	prompts := "0"
	if len(interactive) > 0 && interactive[0] {
		prompts = firstEffectiveValue(effective, "numberofpasswordprompts")
		if prompts == "" {
			prompts = "3"
		}
	}
	writeConfigDirective(body, "NumberOfPasswordPrompts", prompts)
	if selector.agent != nil && selector.agent.socket != "" {
		writeConfigDirective(body, "IdentityAgent", selector.agent.socket)
	}
	for _, option := range []struct {
		key       string
		directive string
	}{
		{key: "identityagent", directive: "IdentityAgent"},
		{key: "securitykeyprovider", directive: "SecurityKeyProvider"},
		{key: "pkcs11provider", directive: "PKCS11Provider"},
		{key: "pubkeyacceptedalgorithms", directive: "PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms"},
		{key: "pubkeyacceptedkeytypes", directive: "PubkeyAcceptedKeyTypes"},
	} {
		if option.key == "identityagent" && selector.agent != nil {
			continue
		}
		if value := firstEffectiveValue(effective, option.key); value != "" {
			connectionPath := option.key == "identityagent" || option.key == "securitykeyprovider" || option.key == "pkcs11provider"
			if !validUTF8NoControl(value) || connectionPath && strings.Contains(value, "%") {
				return ErrUnsupportedRoute
			}
			writeConfigDirective(body, option.directive, value)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func writeOrdinaryProxyAuthentication(body *strings.Builder, effective EffectiveConfig) error {
	writeConfigDirective(body, "IdentityFile", "none")
	for _, identity := range effective.IdentityFiles {
		if !validUTF8NoControl(identity) || strings.Contains(identity, "%") {
			return fmt.Errorf("IdentityFile has unresolved tokens in a reconstructed SSH route; use native ssh: %w", ErrUnsupportedRoute)
		}
		writeConfigDirective(body, "IdentityFile", identity)
	}
	writeConfigDirective(body, "CertificateFile", "none")
	for _, certificate := range effective.Values["certificatefile"] {
		if !validUTF8NoControl(certificate) || strings.Contains(certificate, "%") {
			return fmt.Errorf("CertificateFile has unresolved tokens in a reconstructed SSH route; use native ssh: %w", ErrUnsupportedRoute)
		}
		writeConfigDirective(body, "CertificateFile", certificate)
	}
	for _, option := range []struct {
		key       string
		directive string
	}{
		{key: "identitiesonly", directive: "IdentitiesOnly"},
		{key: "identityagent", directive: "IdentityAgent"},
		{key: "securitykeyprovider", directive: "SecurityKeyProvider"},
		{key: "pkcs11provider", directive: "PKCS11Provider"},

		{key: "passwordauthentication", directive: "PasswordAuthentication"},

	} {
		if value := firstEffectiveValue(effective, option.key); value != "" {
			if !validUTF8NoControl(value) {
				return ErrUnsupportedRoute
			}
			if (option.key == "identityagent" || option.key == "securitykeyprovider" || option.key == "pkcs11provider") && strings.Contains(value, "%") {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s has unresolved tokens in a reconstructed SSH route; use native ssh: %w", option.directive, ErrUnsupportedRoute)
			}
			writeConfigDirective(body, option.directive, value)
		}
	}
	return nil
```
```text
}

// normalizeSSHKeyPromptPath places a bare prompted key name under the SSH
// directory; explicit paths and flags keep their exact meaning.
func normalizeSSHKeyPromptPath(sshDir, value string) string {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if value == "" || value == "." || value == ".." || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\%$`) || strings.HasPrefix(value, "~") {
		return value
	}
	return filepath.Join(sshDir, value)
}

// sshKeyPlanBlockedError names the first blocking reason of a key plan.
func sshKeyPlanBlockedError(plan sshhost.KeyPlan) error {
	for _, diagnostic := range plan.Diagnostics {
		reason := diagnostic.Message
		if reason == "" {
			reason = strings.ReplaceAll(diagnostic.Code, "_", " ")
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("SSH key plan is blocked: %s: %w", reason, sshhost.ErrBlocked)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("SSH key plan is blocked: %w", sshhost.ErrBlocked)
}

func prepareSSHWizardKey(ctx context.Context, app *App, service *sshhost.Service, options *sshSetupOptions) error {
	if options.keyPlan != nil {
		return nil
	}
	path := options.key
	if options.generateKey {
		path = options.keyPath
	} else if options.keyCandidate != nil {
		path = options.keyCandidate.IdentityFile
		if path == "" {
			path = options.keyCandidate.PublicPath
		}
	}
	if path != "" {
		if err := preflightSSHWizardPermissions(ctx, app, service, path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if candidate := options.keyCandidate; candidate != nil {
		if candidate.NeedsPermissionRepair {
			catalog, err := localSSHKeyCatalog(ctx, service)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			options.keyCandidate = nil
			for _, key := range catalog.Candidates {
				if key.Fingerprint == candidate.Fingerprint && key.IdentityFile == candidate.IdentityFile && key.PublicPath == candidate.PublicPath {
					options.keyCandidate = &key
					break
				}
			}
			if options.keyCandidate == nil {
				return errors.New("selected key changed during permission repair")
			}
			candidate = options.keyCandidate
		}
		if !candidate.Provenance.Private && !candidate.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub && !candidate.Provenance.Agent {
			return errors.New("only the public key was found; load its signer into the SSH agent or choose a private key")
		}
	}
	plan, err := planSSHSetupKey(ctx, app, service, *options, true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !plan.Ready() {
		renderSSHKeyDiagnostics(app, plan.Diagnostics)
		return errors.New("selected key is not ready")
	}
	options.keyPlan = &plan
	return nil
}
```

```text
func sshDoctorChecks(app *App) []check {
	checks := make([]check, 0, 5)
	for _, binary := range []struct {
		name    string
		purpose string
	}{
		{name: "ssh", purpose: "SSH host evaluation and login unavailable"},
		{name: "ssh-keygen", purpose: "SSH key generation and derivation unavailable"},
		{name: "tailscale", purpose: "optional Tailscale peer discovery unavailable; ordinary SSH and LAN discovery remain available"},
	} {
		if path, err := exec.LookPath(binary.name); err == nil {
			checks = append(checks, check{binary.name, checkOK, path})
		} else {
			checks = append(checks, check{binary.name, checkWarn, "not found — " + binary.purpose})
		}
	}

	service, err := app.sshHosts()
	if err != nil {
		checks = append(checks, check{"ssh config", checkWarn, "cannot derive ~/.ssh paths: " + err.Error()})
		return checks
	}
	inventory, discoverErr := service.Discover(ctxOf())
	if discoverErr != nil {
		checks = append(checks, check{"ssh config", checkWarn, "static discovery failed: " + discoverErr.Error()})
	} else {
		status := checkOK
		detail := fmt.Sprintf("%d exact alias(es); static Include closure complete", len(inventory.Aliases))
		switch {
		case inventory.RootMissing:
			status = checkWarn
			detail = config.Contract(inventory.Root) + " is absent; run dev ssh init --apply before managing aliases"
		case !inventory.Complete:
			status = checkWarn
			detail = fmt.Sprintf("%d exact alias(es); Include closure incomplete", len(inventory.Aliases))
		}
		checks = append(checks, check{"ssh config", status, detail})
		if inventory.ManagedIncludeActive {
			checks = append(checks, check{"ssh managed", checkOK, "Include " + sshhost.ManagedInclude + " is statically active"})
		} else {
			checks = append(checks, check{"ssh managed", checkWarn, "managed Include is inactive; dev ssh init reports the exact change"})
		}
	}
	if plan, planErr := service.PlanInit(ctxOf()); planErr != nil {
		checks = append(checks, check{"ssh security", checkWarn, "read-only security check failed: " + planErr.Error()})
	} else if plan.Action == sshhost.ActionBlocked {
		detail := "SSH root or managed namespace needs manual security remediation"
		if len(plan.Diagnostics) > 0 {
			detail += " (" + plan.Diagnostics[0].Code + ")"
		}
		checks = append(checks, check{"ssh security", checkWarn, detail})
	} else {
		checks = append(checks, check{"ssh security", checkOK, "root and managed namespace pass read-only ownership/permission checks"})
	}
```

```text
package sshhost

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type keyCatalogRunnerFunc func(context.Context, RunRequest) (RunResult, error)

func (f keyCatalogRunnerFunc) Run(ctx context.Context, r RunRequest) (RunResult, error) {
	return f(ctx, r)
}

func TestLocalKeyCatalogNoAgentIsStaticDeterministicAndRedacted(t *testing.T) {
	paths := fixturePaths(t)
	first, second := testPublicLine(0x84, "first"), testPublicLine(0x85, "second")
	writeFixture(t, filepath.Join(paths.SSHDir, "b.pub"), string(first)+"\n")
	writeFixture(t, filepath.Join(paths.SSHDir, "a.pub"), string(second)+"\n")
	writeFixture(t, filepath.Join(paths.SSHDir, "duplicate.pub"), string(first)+"\n")
	writeFixture(t, filepath.Join(paths.SSHDir, "broken.pub"), "SECRET INVALID PUBLIC RECORD")
	writeFixture(t, paths.RootConfig, "Match exec \"MUST_NOT_RUN\"\n IdentityFile ~/.ssh/a\n")
	s := newFixtureService(t, paths, DiscoverOptions{})
	catalog, err := s.Catalog(t.Context(), KeyCatalogRequest{LocalOnly: true, NoAgent: true})
	if err != nil || len(catalog.Candidates) != 2 || catalog.Complete || !hasDiagnostic(catalog.Diagnostics, "public_key_unreadable") {
		t.Fatalf("catalog=%+v error=%v", catalog, err)
	}
	if catalog.Candidates[0].Fingerprint > catalog.Candidates[1].Fingerprint {
		t.Fatal("candidate order is not deterministic")
	}
	for _, c := range catalog.Candidates {
		if c.Provenance.Effective || c.Provenance.Agent || c.NeedsPermissionRepair {
			t.Fatalf("invented source state: %+v", c)
		}
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(catalog)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, secret := range []string{"SECRET INVALID", "MUST_NOT_RUN", strings.Fields(string(first))[1], strings.Fields(string(second))[1]} {
		if bytes.Contains(encoded, []byte(secret)) {
			t.Fatalf("catalog leaked material: %s", encoded)
		}
	}
	again, err := s.Catalog(t.Context(), KeyCatalogRequest{LocalOnly: true, NoAgent: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encodedAgain, _ := json.Marshal(again)
	if !bytes.Equal(encoded, encodedAgain) {
		t.Fatal("repeated static catalog changed output")
	}
}

func TestLocalKeyCatalogRejectsConflictingInputsAndAllowsMissingSSHDir(t *testing.T) {
	paths := fixturePaths(t)
	s := newFixtureService(t, paths, DiscoverOptions{})
	for _, request := range []KeyCatalogRequest{{LocalOnly: true, Alias: "box"}, {LocalOnly: true, Effective: &EffectiveConfig{Alias: "box"}}} {
		if _, err := s.Catalog(t.Context(), request); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("conflicting catalog source accepted")
		}
	}
	if err := os.Remove(paths.SSHDir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	catalog, err := s.Catalog(t.Context(), KeyCatalogRequest{LocalOnly: true, NoAgent: true})
	if err != nil || !catalog.Complete || len(catalog.Candidates) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("missing directory catalog=%+v error=%v", catalog, err)
	}
}
```

```text
func (d *sshDialog) applyKeyChoice(path string, generate bool) {
	d.onboarding.KeyPath, d.onboarding.GenerateKey = path, generate
	if !generate {
		d.onboarding.KeyComment = ""
	}
	d.setField("key", sshKeyDisplay(path, generate))
	d.setField("auth", "key")
	d.err = nil
}

// openSSHKeyForm installs a key for an existing profile without editable
// connection fields, starting with the key picker.
func (m Model) openSSHKeyForm(profile sshflow.ConnectionProfile) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	m.pauseSSHBackground()
	p := profile
	request := sshflow.OnboardRequest{Profile: &p, Alias: p.Alias, HostName: p.HostName, User: p.User, Port: p.Port, Auth: "key", RemoteOS: "posix"}
	d := sshDialog{kind: "onboard", title: fmt.Sprintf("Install SSH key for %s (%s)", p.Alias, sshProfileEndpoint(p)), onboarding: request}
	d.addField("key", "Key", "")
	d.addField("os", "Remote OS", request.RemoteOS)
	d.addField("fleet", "Fleet", "no")
	d.addField("herdr", "Herdr", "no")
	m.sshUI.dialog = d
	if m.actions.SSH.ListKeys == nil {
		return m, m.focusSSHField(0)
	}
	return m.openSSHKeyPicker()
}

func (m Model) openSSHKeyPicker() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	parent := m.sshUI.dialog
	alias := parent.value("alias")
	if parent.onboarding.Profile != nil {
		alias = parent.onboarding.Profile.Alias
	}
	if alias == "" {
		alias = "host"
	}
	m.sshUI.generation++
	generation := m.sshUI.generation
	m.sshUI.dialog = sshDialog{kind: "keys-loading", title: "Choose SSH key for " + alias, body: "Reading local SSH keys…", parent: &parent}
	return m, func() tea.Msg {
		keys, err := m.actions.SSH.ListKeys(m.baseContext(), alias)
		return sshEventMsg{generation: generation, kind: "keys", keys: keys, err: err}
	}
}

func (m Model) chooseSSHKey(index int) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	d := m.sshUI.dialog
	if d.parent == nil {
		return m, nil
	}
	parent := *d.parent
	if index < len(d.keys) {
		choice := d.keys[index]
		if choice.Generate {
			path := choice.Path
			if parent.onboarding.GenerateKey && parent.onboarding.KeyPath != "" {
				path = parent.onboarding.KeyPath
			}
			form := sshDialog{kind: "keygen", title: "Name the new SSH key", parent: &parent}
			form.addField("path", "New key path", path)
			form.addField("comment", "Comment", parent.onboarding.KeyComment)
			m.sshUI.dialog = form
			return m, m.focusSSHField(0)
		}
		parent.applyKeyChoice(choice.Path, false)
		m.sshUI.dialog = parent
		return m, m.focusSSHField(parent.index)
	}
	form := sshDialog{kind: "keypath", title: d.title, parent: &parent}
	path := ""
	if !parent.onboarding.GenerateKey {

	parent.applyKeyChoice(path, true)
	parent.onboarding.KeyComment = strings.TrimSpace(d.value("comment"))
	m.sshUI.dialog = parent
	return m, m.focusSSHField(parent.index)
}

	d := m.sshUI.dialog
	if d.parent == nil {

	}

	if path == "" {
		m.sshUI.dialog.err = errors.New("Enter a key path, or Esc to return to the form")
		return m, nil
	}
	parent := *d.parent
	parent.applyKeyChoice(path, false)
	m.sshUI.dialog = parent
	return m, m.focusSSHField(parent.index)
}

// listSSHTUIKeys offers file-backed local keys plus a generated destination.
// Agent-only identities remain available through the terminal setup picker.
func listSSHTUIKeys(ctx context.Context, app *App, alias string) ([]tui.SSHKeyChoice, error) {
	service, err := app.sshHosts()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	catalog, err := localSSHKeyCatalog(ctx, service)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	home := service.Paths().Home
	choices := make([]tui.SSHKeyChoice, 0, len(catalog.Candidates)+1)
	for _, key := range catalog.Candidates {
		path := key.IdentityFile
		if path == "" {
			path = key.PublicPath
		}
		if path == "" {
			continue
		}
		choices = append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: sshKeyLabel(home, key), Description: key.Algorithm + " · " + sshKeySigner(key), Path: path})
	}
	if sshhost.ValidateLookupAlias(alias) != nil {
		alias = "host"
	}
	destination := filepath.Join(service.Paths().SSHDir, "id_ed25519_dev_"+alias)
	return append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: "+ Generate a new key", Description: "Ed25519 at " + sshKeyLabel(home, sshhost.KeyCandidate{IdentityFile: destination}), Path: destination, Generate: true}), nil
}

func (w *sshTUIWorkflow) applyOnboarding() error {
	plan, ok := w.request.Onboarding.(*sshTUIOnboardingPlan)
	if !ok || plan == nil || plan.prepared == nil {
		return errors.New("prepare and review an SSH onboarding plan first")
	}
	if plan.used.Swap(true) {
		return errors.New("this SSH setup plan was already attempted; refresh and review a new plan")
	}
	if w.app.machineStore().Path != plan.registryPath || fleetConfigPath(&w.app) != plan.fleetPath {
		return errors.New("SSH setup configuration changed; review a new plan")
	}
	service, err := w.app.sshHosts()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if service.Paths() != plan.prepared.service.Paths() {
		return errors.New("SSH configuration root changed; review a new plan")
	}
	result, err := applySSHOnboardPlan(w.ctx, &w.app, plan.prepared, false)
	w.result.Onboarding = &result
	w.result.Status = "SSH setup: " + result.Status
	for _, registration := range result.Registrations {
		for _, outcome := range registration.Outcomes {
			if outcome.Status == "applied" || outcome.Status == "unknown" {
				w.result.MembershipChanged = true
			}
		}
	}
	return err
}
```

```text
	}

func platformValidateHome(path string, info fs.FileInfo) error {
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s has no Unix ownership metadata", path)
	}
	if int(stat.Uid) != os.Geteuid() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is not owned by the current user: %w", path, ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	if info.Mode().Perm()&0o022 != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is group/world writable: %w", path, ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	return nil
}

	}
	if info.Mode().Perm() != 0o700 {
		return fmt.Errorf("mode is %04o, want 0700: %w", info.Mode().Perm(), ErrUnsafePath)
	}
```

```go
package sshhost

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// AgentProviderID names an SSH agent application whose socket dev can locate
// without executing it.
type AgentProviderID string

const (
	AgentProviderBitwarden AgentProviderID = "bitwarden"
	AgentProvider1Password AgentProviderID = "1password"
	AgentProviderSecretive AgentProviderID = "secretive"
	AgentProviderCustom    AgentProviderID = "custom"
	// AgentProviderWindowsPipe is the shared Windows OpenSSH agent pipe. Any
	// vendor agent may own it, so it is never attributed to one.
	AgentProviderWindowsPipe AgentProviderID = "windows-openssh-pipe"
)

const windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe = `\\.\pipe\openssh-ssh-agent`

// ErrAgentProviderUnavailable means a named agent's socket was not found or
// failed the socket safety checks.
var ErrAgentProviderUnavailable = errors.New("SSH agent provider socket is unavailable")

// AgentSocketRef selects one explicit agent socket. It is a path, never key
// material.
type AgentSocketRef struct {
	Provider AgentProviderID `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	Socket   string          `json:"socket"`
}

// AgentProviderObservation is a stat-only view of an agent provider. It never
// executes the provider or queries its agent.
type AgentProviderObservation struct {
	Provider      AgentProviderID `json:"provider"`
	Label         string          `json:"label"`
	Socket        string          `json:"socket"`
	SocketPresent bool            `json:"socket_present"`
	AppDetected   bool            `json:"app_detected"`
}

type agentProviderSpec struct {
	id     AgentProviderID
	label  string
	enable string
	// sockets are home-relative; apps starting with "~/" are home-relative and
	// all others are system paths.
	sockets map[string][]string
	apps    map[string][]string
}

var agentProviderSpecs = []agentProviderSpec{
	{
		id: AgentProviderBitwarden, label: "Bitwarden", enable: "open Bitwarden → Settings and enable the SSH agent",
		sockets: map[string][]string{
			"darwin": {"Library/Containers/com.bitwarden.desktop/Data/.bitwarden-ssh-agent.sock", ".bitwarden-ssh-agent.sock"},
			"linux":  {".bitwarden-ssh-agent.sock", "snap/bitwarden/current/.bitwarden-ssh-agent.sock", ".var/app/com.bitwarden.desktop/data/.bitwarden-ssh-agent.sock"},
		},
		apps: map[string][]string{
			"darwin": {"/Applications/Bitwarden.app", "~/Applications/Bitwarden.app"},
			"linux":  {"/snap/bitwarden", "/var/lib/flatpak/app/com.bitwarden.desktop", "~/.local/share/flatpak/app/com.bitwarden.desktop", "/opt/Bitwarden"},
		},
	},
	{
		id: AgentProvider1Password, label: "1Password", enable: "open 1Password → Settings → Developer and use the SSH agent",
		sockets: map[string][]string{
			"darwin": {"Library/Group Containers/2BUA8C4S2C.com.1password/t/agent.sock", ".1password/agent.sock"},
			"linux":  {".1password/agent.sock"},
		},
		apps: map[string][]string{
			"darwin": {"/Applications/1Password.app", "~/Applications/1Password.app"},
			"linux":  {"/opt/1Password"},
		},
	},
	{
		id: AgentProviderSecretive, label: "Secretive", enable: "open Secretive and finish its agent setup",
		sockets: map[string][]string{"darwin": {"Library/Containers/com.maxgoedjen.Secretive.SecretAgent/Data/socket.ssh"}},
		apps:    map[string][]string{"darwin": {"/Applications/Secretive.app", "~/Applications/Secretive.app"}},
	},
}

// AgentProviderLabel returns a display name for a provider.
func AgentProviderLabel(id AgentProviderID) string {
	for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
		if spec.id == id {
			return spec.label
		}
	}
	switch id {
	case AgentProviderWindowsPipe:
		return "Windows OpenSSH agent pipe"
	case AgentProviderCustom:
		return "custom agent"
	}
	return string(id)
}

// AgentProviderEnableHint names the native step that exposes a provider's socket.
func AgentProviderEnableHint(id AgentProviderID) string {
	for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
		if spec.id == id {
			return spec.enable
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// ObserveAgentProviders reports providers whose application or agent socket is
// present for goos. It only stats paths: sockets must be real sockets owned by
// the current user below directories that are not symlinks.
func (s *Service) ObserveAgentProviders(goos string) []AgentProviderObservation {
	if goos == "windows" {
		if _, err := os.Stat(windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe); err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		return []AgentProviderObservation{{
			Provider: AgentProviderWindowsPipe, Label: AgentProviderLabel(AgentProviderWindowsPipe),
			Socket: windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe, SocketPresent: true,
		}}
	}
	var observations []AgentProviderObservation
	for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
		sockets := spec.sockets[goos]
		if len(sockets) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		observation := AgentProviderObservation{
			Provider: spec.id, Label: spec.label,
			Socket: filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(sockets[0])),
		}
		for _, relative := range sockets {
			path := filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
			if s.homeAgentSocketUsable(path) == nil {
				observation.Socket, observation.SocketPresent = path, true
				break
			}
		}
		for _, app := range spec.apps[goos] {
			if s.agentAppExists(app) {
				observation.AppDetected = true
				break
			}
		}
		if observation.SocketPresent || observation.AppDetected {
			observations = append(observations, observation)
		}
	}
	return observations
}

// ResolveAgentSocket maps a provider name or an absolute socket path to an
// agent reference. Provider names require a present socket.
func (s *Service) ResolveAgentSocket(goos, value string) (AgentSocketRef, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
		if !strings.EqualFold(value, string(spec.id)) {
			continue
		}
		for _, observation := range s.ObserveAgentProviders(goos) {
			if observation.Provider == spec.id && observation.SocketPresent {
				return AgentSocketRef{Provider: spec.id, Socket: observation.Socket}, nil
			}
		}
		return AgentSocketRef{}, fmt.Errorf("%s SSH agent socket was not found; %s: %w", spec.label, spec.enable, ErrAgentProviderUnavailable)
	}
	if err := ValidateAgentSocketPath(value); err != nil {
		return AgentSocketRef{}, err
	}
	if err := s.agentSocketUsable(value); err != nil {
		return AgentSocketRef{}, fmt.Errorf("SSH agent socket %s: %w: %w", value, err, ErrAgentProviderUnavailable)
	}
	return AgentSocketRef{Provider: AgentProviderCustom, Socket: value}, nil
}

// ValidateAgentSocketPath accepts only an absolute, clean, token-free path so
// the same value can be written to SSH configuration and compared with ssh -G.
func ValidateAgentSocketPath(value string) error {
	if value == "" || !validUTF8NoControl(value) || !filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.Clean(value) != value || strings.ContainsAny(value, "%$~") {
		return fmt.Errorf("SSH agent socket must be an absolute path without ~, %% or $ tokens: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *Service) homeAgentSocketUsable(path string) error {
	for dir := filepath.Dir(path); dir != s.paths.Home && dir != filepath.Dir(dir); dir = filepath.Dir(dir) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(dir)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s is a symlink: %w", dir, ErrUnsafePath)
		}
	}
	return s.agentSocketUsable(path)
}

func (s *Service) agentSocketUsable(path string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	check := s.agentSocketCheck
	if check == nil {
		check = platformAgentSocket
	}
	return check(path, info)
}

func (s *Service) agentAppExists(app string) bool {
	path := app
	if strings.HasPrefix(app, "~/") {
		path = filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(app[2:]))
	} else if s.agentSystemRoot != "" {
		path = filepath.Join(s.agentSystemRoot, filepath.FromSlash(app))
	}
	_, err := os.Stat(path)
	return err == nil
}

func cloneAgentRef(ref *AgentSocketRef) *AgentSocketRef {
	if ref == nil {
		return nil
	}
	copy := *ref
	return &copy
}

func agentSocketMode(info fs.FileInfo) bool { return info.Mode().Type() == fs.ModeSocket }
```
