456	func sshCandidateAddressMatches(host string, c sshdiscovery.Candidate) bool {
457		normalize := func(s string) string {
458			if ip, e := netip.ParseAddr(s); e == nil {
459				return ip.Unmap().String()
460			}
461			return strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(s), ".")
462		}
463		if host == "" {
464			return false
465		}
466		key := normalize(host)
467		for _, value := range append(append([]string{}, c.Addresses...), c.DNSName) {
468			if value != "" && normalize(value) == key {
469				return true
470			}
471		}
472		return false
473	}
474	
475	func preferredSSHAddress(c sshdiscovery.Candidate) string {
476		for _, text := range c.Addresses {
477			if ip, e := netip.ParseAddr(text); e == nil && ip.Is4() {
478				return ip.String()
479			}
480		}
481		if len(c.Addresses) > 0 {
482			return c.Addresses[0]
483		}
484		return strings.TrimSuffix(c.DNSName, ".")
485	}
486	func suggestSSHAlias(c sshdiscovery.Candidate) string {
487		value := strings.SplitN(c.DNSName, ".", 2)[0]
488		if value == "" {
489			value = c.Name
490		}
491		var out strings.Builder
492		for _, r := range strings.ToLower(value) {
493			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
494				out.WriteRune(r)
495			} else {
496				out.WriteByte('-')
497			}
498		}
499		alias := strings.Trim(out.String(), "-")
500		if len(alias) > 100 {
501			alias = strings.Trim(alias[:100], "-")
502		}
503		if sshhost.ValidateManagedAlias(alias) != nil {
504			return "host"
505		}
506		return alias
507	}

531				return nil, errors.New(guidance)

534		} else if sources[0].Value == "cached" {
535			reports, e := sshdiscovery.ReadCache(ctx, sshDiscoveryCacheDir(), nowSSH())
536			if e != nil {
537				return nil, e
538			}
539			for _, r := range reports {
540				stale := r.Stale
541				if r.Source == "lan" {

543					stale = stale || e != nil || !current
544				}
545				for _, c := range r.Candidates {
546					if stale {
547						c.State = "stale_observation"
548					}
549					candidates = append(candidates, c)
550				}
551			}
552		} else {
553			s, e := app.sshHosts()
554			if e != nil {
555				return nil, e
556			}
557			hints, e := s.ConnectionHints(ctx)
558			if e != nil {
559				return nil, e
560			}
561			for _, h := range hints {
562				candidates = append(candidates, sshdiscovery.Candidate{ID: "ssh:" + h.Alias, Source: "ssh", NativeID: h.Alias, Name: h.Alias, DNSName: h.Alias, Addresses: []string{h.HostName}, Port: h.Port})
563			}
564		}
565		choices := []picker.Item{}
566		for i, c := range candidates {
567			status := c.State
568			if c.Online != nil {
569				if *c.Online {
570					status += " online"
571				} else {
572					status += " offline"

574			}

578			choices = append(choices, picker.Item{Value: strconv.Itoa(i), Label: c.Name, Description: strings.Join(c.Addresses, ",") + " " + c.OS + " " + status})
579		}

316	func normalizeSSHKeyPromptPath(sshDir, value string) string {
317		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)

319			return value
320		}
321		return filepath.Join(sshDir, value)

325	func sshKeyPlanBlockedError(plan sshhost.KeyPlan) error {
326		for _, diagnostic := range plan.Diagnostics {

328			if reason == "" {
329				reason = strings.ReplaceAll(diagnostic.Code, "_", " ")
330			}
331			return fmt.Errorf("SSH key plan is blocked: %s: %w", reason, sshhost.ErrBlocked)
332		}

```text
SSH-KEYCHAIN(8) 	    System Manager's Manual	       SSH-KEYCHAIN(8)

NAME
     ssh-keychain.dylib – smartcard/token support library

DESCRIPTION
     The ssh-keychain.dylib library is used as a PKCS#11 and Secure Key module
     replacement for the family of ssh tools.  It provides identities from
     CryptoTokenKit tokens (SmartCards and persistent tokens) to the tools.

OVERVIEW
     By default, all valid (RSA for PKCS#11 and ecdsa256 for Secure Key
     module) identities from all SmartCards and persistent tokens currently
     available in the system are provided.  Manual configuration of
     ssh-keychain.dylib is required if there is a need to limit which token
     identities are provided.  The public key hash is used to select which
     identities should be provided.  This hash is usually in hexadecimal
     string form, without the leading 0x.  To determine the hash for identity
     use the sc_auth list-ctk-identities and sc_auth identities commands or
     pkhh attribute from security export-smartcard output.

ENVIRONMENT
     Configuration passed through the environment always takes precedence over
     the configuration file.  The variable KEYCHAIN_CERTIFICATES is used to
     specify hashes.  It should contain a semicolon-separated list of public
     key hashes of certificates which will be provided to the ssh tools.

CONFIG FILE
     If no enviroment variable configuration is provided, ssh-keychain.dylib
     looks for a configuration file located at ~/.ssh/sshkeychain.plist.  This
     file is a standard property-list with a dictionary root object.  It
     should contain the key KeychainCertificates with a value that is either a
     string or an array of strings.  If a string, then the expected value is
     semicolon-separated list of public key hashes like the environment
     variable.	If the value is an array, then each hash is an array entry.

FILES
     ~/.ssh/sshkeychain.plist

EXAMPLES
     Environment:
	     KEYCHAIN_CERTIFICATES="[REDACTED:generic-api-key];168D2C4CDDFCDADD465BAF3E6BCFE8193D8D42D1"
	     ssh -o PKCS11Provider=/usr/lib/ssh-keychain.dylib machine

     Configuration plist:
	     {
		 "KeychainCertificates" => [
		     0 => "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]"
		     1 => "168D2C4CDDFCDADD465BAF3E6BCFE8193D8D42D1"
		 ]
	     }

SEE ALSO
     security(1), ssh-add(1), ssh_config(5), sc_auth(8)

682-     FIDO authenticators generally require the user to explicitly authorise

684-     a key handle part stored in the private key file on disk, and a per-
685-     device private key that is unique to each FIDO authenticator and that
686-     cannot be exported from the authenticator hardware.  These are combined
687-     by the hardware at authentication time to derive the real key that is
688-     used to sign authentication challenges.  Supported key types are ecdsa-sk
689-     and ed25519-sk.

704-

711-	     will refuse such signatures by default, unless overridden via an

716-	     authenticator itself.  This makes it easier to use the
717-	     authenticator on multiple computers.  Resident keys may be
718-	     supported on FIDO2 authenticators and typically require that a
719-	     PIN be set on the authenticator prior to generation.  Resident
720-	     keys may be loaded off the authenticator using ssh-add(1).

725:     user    A username to be associated with a resident key, overriding the

728-

451		if _, err := snapshotStillCurrentAt(staged.root, name, expected); err != nil {
452			return fmt.Errorf("destination changed before replacement: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
453		}

461			return fmt.Errorf("destination parent changed during replacement: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
462		}

466	func commitNoReplace(staged *stagedFile, destination string, expected fileSnapshot) error {
467		name, err := staged.destinationName(destination)
468		if err != nil {
469			return err
470		}
471		if err := staged.revalidate(); err != nil {
472			return err
473		}
474		if _, err := snapshotStillCurrentAt(staged.root, name, expected); err != nil {
475			return fmt.Errorf("destination appeared before creation: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
476		}
477		if err := verifyHeldDirectory(staged.dir, staged.held, true); err != nil {
478			return fmt.Errorf("destination parent changed before creation: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
479		}
480		moved, err := platformfs.PublishNoReplace(staged.root, staged.name, name)
481		if err != nil {

483		}
484		if !moved {
485			if err := staged.root.Remove(staged.name); err != nil {
486				cleanupErr := staged.root.Remove(name)
487				return errors.Join(err, cleanupErr)
488			}
489		}
490		if err := verifyHeldDirectory(staged.dir, staged.held, true); err != nil {
491			return fmt.Errorf("destination parent changed during creation: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
492		}
493		return platformSyncDirectory(staged.dir)
494	}
495	
496	func removeSecureFile(expected fileSnapshot) error {
497		if !expected.exists || expected.path == "" {
498			return fmt.Errorf("removal requires an existing source snapshot: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
499		}
500		parentPath := filepath.Dir(expected.path)
501		root, held, err := openHeldDirectory(parentPath, true)
502		if err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		defer root.Close()
506		name := filepath.Base(expected.path)
507		if _, err := snapshotStillCurrentAt(root, name, expected); err != nil {
508			return fmt.Errorf("file changed before removal: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
509		}
510		if err := verifyHeldDirectory(parentPath, held, true); err != nil {
511			return fmt.Errorf("parent changed before removal: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
512		}
513		if err := root.Remove(name); err != nil {
514			return err
515		}
516		if err := verifyHeldDirectory(parentPath, held, true); err != nil {
517			return fmt.Errorf("parent changed during removal: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
518		}
519		return platformSyncDirectory(parentPath)

89	// AgentProviderLabel returns a display name for a provider.

115	// ObserveAgentProviders reports providers whose application or agent socket is
116	// present for goos. It only stats paths: sockets must be real sockets owned by
117	// the current user below directories that are not symlinks.
118	func (s *Service) ObserveAgentProviders(goos string) []AgentProviderObservation {
119		if goos == "windows" {
120			if _, err := os.Stat(windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe); err != nil {
121				return nil
122			}
123			return []AgentProviderObservation{{
124				Provider: AgentProviderWindowsPipe, Label: AgentProviderLabel(AgentProviderWindowsPipe),
125				Socket: windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe, SocketPresent: true,
126			}}
127		}
128		var observations []AgentProviderObservation
129		for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
130			sockets := spec.sockets[goos]
131			if len(sockets) == 0 {
132				continue
133			}
134			observation := AgentProviderObservation{
135				Provider: spec.id, Label: spec.label,
136				Socket: filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(sockets[0])),
137			}
138			for _, relative := range sockets {
139				path := filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
140				if s.homeAgentSocketUsable(path) == nil {
141					observation.Socket, observation.SocketPresent = path, true
142					break
143				}
144			}
145			for _, app := range spec.apps[goos] {
146				if s.agentAppExists(app) {
147					observation.AppDetected = true
148					break
149				}
150			}
151			if observation.SocketPresent || observation.AppDetected {
152				observations = append(observations, observation)
153			}
154		}
155		return observations
156	}

158	// ResolveAgentSocket maps a provider name or an absolute socket path to an
159	// agent reference. Provider names require a present socket.
160	func (s *Service) ResolveAgentSocket(goos, value string) (AgentSocketRef, error) {
161		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
162		for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
163			if !strings.EqualFold(value, string(spec.id)) {
164				continue
165			}
166			for _, observation := range s.ObserveAgentProviders(goos) {
167				if observation.Provider == spec.id && observation.SocketPresent {
168					return AgentSocketRef{Provider: spec.id, Socket: observation.Socket}, nil
169				}
170			}
171			return AgentSocketRef{}, fmt.Errorf("%s SSH agent socket was not found; %s: %w", spec.label, spec.enable, ErrAgentProviderUnavailable)
172		}
173		if err := ValidateAgentSocketPath(value); err != nil {
174			return AgentSocketRef{}, err
175		}
176		if err := s.agentSocketUsable(value); err != nil {
177			return AgentSocketRef{}, fmt.Errorf("SSH agent socket %s: %w: %w", value, err, ErrAgentProviderUnavailable)
178		}
179		return AgentSocketRef{Provider: AgentProviderCustom, Socket: value}, nil
180	}
181	
182	// ValidateAgentSocketPath accepts only an absolute, clean, token-free path so
183	// the same value can be written to SSH configuration and compared with ssh -G.
184	func ValidateAgentSocketPath(value string) error {
185		if value == "" || !validUTF8NoControl(value) || !filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.Clean(value) != value || strings.ContainsAny(value, "%$~") {
186			return fmt.Errorf("SSH agent socket must be an absolute path without ~, %% or $ tokens: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
187		}
188		return nil
189	}

191	func (s *Service) homeAgentSocketUsable(path string) error {
192		for dir := filepath.Dir(path); dir != s.paths.Home && dir != filepath.Dir(dir); dir = filepath.Dir(dir) {
193			info, err := os.Lstat(dir)
194			if err != nil {
195				return err
196			}
197			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
198				return fmt.Errorf("%s is a symlink: %w", dir, ErrUnsafePath)
199			}
200		}
201		return s.agentSocketUsable(path)
202	}
203	
204	func (s *Service) agentSocketUsable(path string) error {
205		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
206		if err != nil {
207			return err
208		}
209		check := s.agentSocketCheck
210		if check == nil {
211			check = platformAgentSocket
212		}
213		return check(path, info)
214	}
215	
216	func (s *Service) agentAppExists(app string) bool {
217		path := app
218		if strings.HasPrefix(app, "~/") {
219			path = filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(app[2:]))
220		} else if s.agentSystemRoot != "" {
221			path = filepath.Join(s.agentSystemRoot, filepath.FromSlash(app))
222		}
223		_, err := os.Stat(path)
224		return err == nil
225	}

## SSH-key generation

`item create` documents:

```text
--ssh-generate-key
```

The supported values are:

```text
ed25519
rsa
rsa2048
rsa3072
rsa4096
```

Ed25519 is the default. Examples:

```sh
op item create --ssh-generate-key
op item create --ssh-generate-key=ed25519 --vault "Vault name"
op item create --ssh-generate-key=rsa4096 --vault "Vault name"
```

`--reveal` is also documented for `item create` and `item get`:

```text
--reveal    Don't conceal sensitive fields.
```

The supplied content does not identify the generated public-key field or document a `--fields` selector specifically for it.

## JSON output

`--format json` is used in the documented examples, but it is not listed in the displayed `item create` or `item get` flag tables:

```sh
op item get Netflix --fields label=username,label=password --format json
```

The documentation does not state whether JSON output includes private fields without `--reveal`. Therefore, that behavior is unknown from the supplied content. To explicitly request unrevealed-sensitive-field handling, use:

```sh
op item get <itemID> --vault "Vault name" --format=json --reveal
```

## Field selection

`item get` documents:

```text
--fields strings
```

It supports selectors using `label=` or `type=`:

```sh
op item get Netflix --fields label=username,label=password --format json
op item get Netflix --fields type=concealed
```

No public-key label or field type is documented in the supplied content.

## Account and vault identifiers

`item get` accepts an item name, item ID, sharing link, or `-`:

```sh
op item get <itemID> --vault "Ops Secrets" --share-link
```

Vault-related flags are:

```text
--vault vault
--current-vault string
--destination-vault string
```

The documentation shows vault names such as `Private`, `Shared`, `Test`, and `Ops Secrets`; it does not specify whether vault IDs are accepted or how they are formatted.

The examples also use `--account`:

```sh
op item create --account work -
op item get --format json --account agilebits -
```

However, `--account` is not described in the displayed `item create` or `item get` flag tables, so its accepted identifier format and semantics are not documented in the supplied content.

```text
1	# SSH key provider helpers
2	
3	Status: deferred; current SSH route, registration and password-save work does not authorize vault migration or hardware provisioning.
4	
5	Research updated: 2026-09-12.
6	
7	The existing chezmoi `ssh-to-bitwarden` helper already imports SSH key items and
8	its shell configuration selects Bitwarden's agent. Reuse a native handoff before
9	building another vault writer. A future implementation must show key fingerprints
10	and provider state without logging key bytes, vault unlock data or credentials.
11	Audit the existing helper's name-based duplicate detection and Secure Note fallback
12	before treating it as a dev-supported credential transfer protocol.
13	
14	YubiKey is a separate design: FIDO2-generated hardware credentials, PIV imports
15	and OpenPGP agent integration have different lifecycle and recovery semantics.
16	Do not present them as equivalent destinations for uploading an existing key.
17	Public key installation can reuse sshhost once a provider exposes a supported
18	public identity and ordinary OpenSSH authentication works.
19	
20	Suggested first increment: agent/socket diagnostics, public fingerprint listing,
21	provider-specific prerequisites and an explicit native-tool handoff. Vault import,
22	hardware provisioning and credential revocation need their own reviewable plans.
23	No new provider execution belongs in passive SSH or fleet inventory.
24	
25	Sources: [Bitwarden SSH agent](https://bitwarden.com/help/ssh-agent/),
26	[Yubico SSH approaches](https://developers.yubico.com/SSH/).
27	
28	Herdr integration also has an upstream opportunity: metadata-only registration
29	and structured dry-run/apply outcomes would avoid native preparation during add.
30	The implemented adapter uses the current native CLI; it does not edit Herdr's
31	private endpoint catalog or silently answer server-replacement approvals.
32	
33	
34	## Distinct future workflows
35	
36	The user requested these as later helpers, not additions to the current SSH
37	password-save feature. Default to explicit native-tool handoff and metadata
38	preview. An approved transfer may process private material in memory, but normal
39	setup/discovery must retain its no-private-key-transfer contract. Keep names,
40	public fingerprints, destination identity and verification results reviewable;
41	never log key bytes, passphrases, vault sessions or exported account passwords.
42	
43	### Existing SSH private key to Bitwarden
44	
45	Bitwarden accepts OpenSSH and PKCS#8 private-key import; its documented agent
46	supports Ed25519 and RSA SHA-256/SHA-512, and PuTTY input is unsupported. The SDK
47	can decrypt supported encrypted input with an explicit passphrase and normalize
48	it to OpenSSH; vault representation is encrypted. A future helper must detect
49	format/algorithm support rather than promise arbitrary PEM conversion.
50	
51	The CLI documents SSH item type 5, but its current template switch has no SSH-key
52	case. Do not assume `bw get template item.sshkey` exists, or fall back silently to
53	Secure Note after template failure. Audit the existing chezmoi helper, pin the
54	supported CLI schema, use stdin rather than secret argv/clipboard where possible,
55	and retain the exact returned item ID and public fingerprint. Duplicate names
56	are not identity. Verify provider agent signing before offering separate local
57	key-file cleanup; import never implies source deletion or remote revocation.
58	
59	Sources: [Bitwarden About SSH](https://bitwarden.com/help/about-ssh/),
60	[SDK import](https://sdk-api-docs.bitwarden.com/bitwarden_wasm_internal/ssh/fn.import_ssh_key.html),
61	[CLI schema](https://bitwarden.com/help/cli/),
62	[CLI template source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitwarden/clients/main/apps/cli/src/commands/get.command.ts).
63	
64	### YubiKey: generate versus import
65	
66	FIDO2 SSH creates a new `ed25519-sk` or `ecdsa-sk` credential and a local handle;
67	it is not a route for uploading the same ordinary OpenSSH private key. PIV can
68	import supported asymmetric private keys into selected slots, while OpenPGP uses
69	its own existing-PGP-key import flow. Supported algorithms depend on firmware
70	and application. Occupied PIV slots can irrecoverably replace an existing key,
71	so device/firmware/slot inventory, explicit replacement scope and recovery need
72	their own reviewed plan. Do not label all three paths “move this SSH key”.
73	
74	Sources: [Yubico FIDO2 SSH](https://developers.yubico.com/SSH/Securing_SSH_with_FIDO2.html),
75	[PIV compatibility](https://docs.yubico.com/hardware/yubikey/yk-tech-manual/yk5-apps-piv.html),
76	[PIV import/replacement](https://docs.yubico.com/yesdk/users-manual/application-piv/commands.html),
77	[OpenPGP import](https://developers.yubico.com/PGP/Importing_keys.html).
78	
79	### Apple Passwords to Bitwarden
80	
81	On Mac, use Passwords' native selected/all-password CSV export and Bitwarden's
82	Safari/macOS importer. CSV is unencrypted and has export exclusions (including
83	Wi-Fi, some shared-group credentials and Sign in with Apple); it is not an SSH-key
84	or passkey archive. Bitwarden imports do not deduplicate repeated imports.
85	A helper should show selected scope, record completion/uncertainty and guide
86	explicit cleanup of the export artifact, without claiming secure erasure.
87	
88	Bitwarden separately documents app-to-app Credential Exchange from Apple
89	Passwords on iOS 26+, including passwords and passkeys. This research did not
90	establish macOS CXP support: detect native capability at implementation time,
91	otherwise describe the supported CSV route. Never substitute a Keychain dump or
92	scripted vault read for the user's native export authorization. Website passkeys,
93	account passwords and SSH private keys are different data types and migration
94	contracts.
95	
96	Sources: [Apple Mac export](https://support.apple.com/guide/passwords/export-passwords-to-a-file-mchl35b12625/mac),
97	[Bitwarden macOS migration](https://bitwarden.com/help/import-from-safari/),
98	[Credential Exchange import](https://bitwarden.com/help/import-data/).
99
```
</details></tool-use>

1227	func planSSHSetupKey(ctx context.Context, app *App, service *sshhost.Service, options sshSetupOptions, interactiveMode bool) (sshhost.KeyPlan, error) {
1228		if options.keyCandidate != nil && (options.key != "" || options.generateKey) {
1229			return sshhost.KeyPlan{}, errors.New("choose one existing key or key generation")
1230		}
1231		request := sshhost.KeyRequest{
1232			Interactive:  interactiveMode && !options.noPassphrase,
1233			AllowDerive:  options.yes,
1234			NoPassphrase: options.noPassphrase,
1235		}
1236		if options.generateKey {
1237			request.Operation = sshhost.KeyGenerate
1238			request.DestinationIdentity = options.keyPath
1239			request.Comment = options.comment
1240		} else {
1241			request.Operation = sshhost.KeyUse
1242			if options.keyCandidate != nil {
1243				request.Candidate = *options.keyCandidate
1244			} else {
1245				request.Path = options.key
1246			}
1247		}
1248		plan, err := service.PlanKey(ctx, request)
1249		if err != nil {
1250			return plan, err
1251		}
1252		if plan.Action == sshhost.ActionBlocked && hasSSHDiagnostic(plan.Diagnostics, "derive_confirmation_required") && interactiveMode && !options.dryRun {
1253			confirmed, promptErr := newPrompter(app).confirm("Derive and save the missing public key companion?", false)
1254			if promptErr != nil {
1255				return plan, promptErr
1256			}
1257			if !confirmed {
1258				return plan, errPromptCanceled
1259			}
1260			request.AllowDerive = true
1261			return service.PlanKey(ctx, request)
1262		}
1263		return plan, nil
1264	}

1279		case fleet.RemoteOSPOSIX:
1280			return sshhost.RemoteOSPOSIX, nil
1281		case fleet.RemoteOSWindows:

1283		default:

1288	func parseSSHOSOverrides(values []string) ([]sshhost.RemoteOSOverride, error) {
1289		overrides := make([]sshhost.RemoteOSOverride, 0, len(values))
1290		seen := make(map[string]bool)
1291		for _, value := range values {
1292			alias, rawOS, ok := strings.Cut(value, "=")
1293			if !ok || alias == "" || rawOS == "" {
1294				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--hop-os %q must be alias=posix|windows", value)
1295			}
1296			if err := sshhost.ValidateLookupAlias(alias); err != nil {
1297				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--hop-os %q: %w", value, err)
1298			}
1299			key := strings.ToLower(alias)
1300			if seen[key] {
1301				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate --hop-os override for %q", alias)
1302			}
1303			seen[key] = true
1304			remoteOS, err := parseSSHRemoteOS(rawOS)
1305			if err != nil || remoteOS == sshhost.RemoteOSUnknown {
1306				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--hop-os %q must be alias=posix|windows", value)
1307			}
1308			overrides = append(overrides, sshhost.RemoteOSOverride{Alias: alias, RemoteOS: remoteOS})
1309		}
1310		return overrides, nil
1311	}

75	// ValidateManagedAlias enforces the portable lowercase v1 filename grammar.
76	func ValidateManagedAlias(alias string) error {
77		if len(alias) == 0 || len(alias) > maxManagedAliasBytes || !validUTF8NoControl(alias) {
78			return fmt.Errorf("alias %q must be 1-%d printable bytes: %w", alias, maxManagedAliasBytes, ErrInvalidAlias)
79		}
80		if alias != strings.ToLower(alias) {
81			return fmt.Errorf("alias %q must be lowercase: %w", alias, ErrInvalidAlias)
82		}
83		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(alias); err != nil {
84			return fmt.Errorf("alias %q: %w", alias, ErrInvalidAlias)
85		}
86		for index, r := range alias {
87			allowed := r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || index > 0 && (r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-')
88			if !allowed {
89				return fmt.Errorf("alias %q contains non-portable character %q: %w", alias, r, ErrInvalidAlias)
90			}
91		}
92		last := alias[len(alias)-1]
93		if !asciiAlphaNumeric(last) {
94			return fmt.Errorf("alias %q must end in a letter or digit: %w", alias, ErrInvalidAlias)
95		}
96		base := strings.ToLower(strings.SplitN(alias, ".", 2)[0])
97		if windowsReservedBase(base) {
98			return fmt.Errorf("alias %q is a reserved Windows filename: %w", alias, ErrInvalidAlias)
99		}
100		return nil
101	}
102	
103	func asciiAlphaNumeric(value byte) bool {
104		return value >= 'a' && value <= 'z' || value >= '0' && value <= '9'
105	}
106	
107	func windowsReservedBase(base string) bool {
108		switch base {
109		case "con", "prn", "aux", "nul", "clock$":
110			return true
111		}
112		if len(base) == 4 && (strings.HasPrefix(base, "com") || strings.HasPrefix(base, "lpt")) && base[3] >= '1' && base[3] <= '9' {
113			return true
114		}
115		return false
116	}

159	// RenderManaged returns the only canonical byte representation of a fragment:
160	// v1 unless a v2 directive is present, so existing files never drift.
161	func RenderManaged(definition ManagedDefinition) ([]byte, error) {

190		writeConfigDirective(&body, "SecurityKeyProvider", definition.SecurityKeyProvider)
191		return []byte(body.String()), nil

194	func writeConfigDirective(body *strings.Builder, name, value string) {
195		if value == "" {

197		}
198		body.WriteString("    ")

200		body.WriteByte(' ')
201		body.WriteString(quoteConfigValue(value))
202		body.WriteByte('\n')
203	}

205	func quoteConfigValue(value string) string {
206		safe := value != ""
207		for _, r := range value {
208			if unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsControl(r) || strings.ContainsRune("#\"'\\", r) {
209				safe = false
210				break
211			}
212		}
213		if safe {
214			return value
215		}
216		value = strings.ReplaceAll(value, `\`, `\\`)
217		value = strings.ReplaceAll(value, `"`, `\"`)
218		return `"` + value + `"`
219	}

30			"evaluate SSH config",
31			true,
32		)

35	func (s *Service) evaluateSSHConfig(ctx context.Context, alias string, args []string, display, errorContext string, stderrOnExit bool) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
36		if ctx == nil {
37			ctx = context.Background()
38		}
39		result, err := s.runner.Run(ctx, RunRequest{
40			Name: "ssh", Args: args, Env: []string{"LC_ALL=C"}, Display: display,
41		})
42		if err != nil {
43			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", errorContext, err)
44		}
45		if result.ExitCode != 0 {
46			message := ""
47			if stderrOnExit {
48				message = strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
49			}
50			if message == "" {
51				message = fmt.Sprintf("exit status %d", result.ExitCode)
52			}
53			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", errorContext, message)
54		}
55		return ParseEffective(alias, result.Stdout)
56	}
57	
58	// VerifyManaged evaluates the ordinary user+system SSH configuration with
59	// plain ssh -G and checks that every scalar emitted by the managed fragment is
60	// effective. IdentityFile is additive, so managed expectations must appear in
61	// order but unrelated system/default identities may also be present.
62	func (s *Service) VerifyManaged(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
63		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
64			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
65		}
66		effective, err := s.Effective(ctx, definition.Alias)
67		if err != nil {
68			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
69		}
70		if err := VerifyManagedEffective(definition, effective); err != nil {
71			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
72		}
73		return effective, nil
74	}
75	
76	// VerifyManagedEffective compares a managed definition with parsed ssh -G
77	// output. Error text names mismatched fields without echoing configuration
78	// values that may contain command-like user input.
79	func VerifyManagedEffective(definition ManagedDefinition, effective EffectiveConfig) error {
80		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
81			return err
82		}
83		var mismatches []string
84		if !equalAlias(definition.Alias, effective.Alias) {
85			mismatches = append(mismatches, "Alias")
86		}
87		if definition.HostName != effective.HostName {
88			mismatches = append(mismatches, "HostName")
89		}
90		if definition.User != "" && definition.User != effective.User {
91			mismatches = append(mismatches, "User")
92		}
93		if definition.Port != 0 && definition.Port != effective.Port {
94			mismatches = append(mismatches, "Port")
95		}
96		if definition.ProxyJump != "" && definition.ProxyJump != effective.ProxyJump {
97			mismatches = append(mismatches, "ProxyJump")
98		}
99		if definition.IdentitiesOnly != nil && (effective.IdentitiesOnly == nil || *definition.IdentitiesOnly != *effective.IdentitiesOnly) {
100			mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentitiesOnly")
101		}
102		if definition.IdentityFile != "" && !containsOrderedValues(effective.IdentityFiles, []string{definition.IdentityFile}) {
103			mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentityFile")
104		}
105		if definition.IdentityAgent != "" {
106			if value := firstEffectiveValue(effective, "identityagent"); value == "" || filepath.Clean(value) != definition.IdentityAgent {
107				mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentityAgent")
108			}
109		}
110		if definition.SecurityKeyProvider != "" && firstEffectiveValue(effective, "securitykeyprovider") != definition.SecurityKeyProvider {
111			mismatches = append(mismatches, "SecurityKeyProvider")
112		}
113		if len(mismatches) > 0 {
114			return fmt.Errorf("managed SSH config does not control effective fields: %s", strings.Join(mismatches, ", "))
115		}
116		return nil
117	}
118	
119	func (s *Service) verifyManagedEffective(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition) error {
120		_, err := s.VerifyManaged(ctx, definition)
121		return err
122	}

124	func firstEffectiveValue(effective EffectiveConfig, key string) string {
125		if values := effective.Values[key]; len(values) > 0 {
126			return values[0]
127		}
128		return ""
129	}

131	func containsOrderedValues(actual, expected []string) bool {
132		next := 0
133		for _, value := range actual {
134			if next < len(expected) && value == expected[next] {
135				next++
136			}
137		}
138		return next == len(expected)
139	}

141	// ValidateLookupAlias prevents option injection while retaining foreign exact

143	func ValidateLookupAlias(alias string) error {
144		if alias == "" || len(alias) > 255 || !utf8.ValidString(alias) {
145			return fmt.Errorf("invalid SSH alias %q", alias)
146		}
147		if strings.HasPrefix(alias, "-") || strings.ContainsAny(alias, "*?[]!") {

150		for _, r := range alias {
151			if unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsControl(r) {
152				return fmt.Errorf("invalid exact SSH alias %q", alias)
153			}
154		}
155		return nil
156	}

35		}
36		rest := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, volume)
37		current := volume
38		if strings.HasPrefix(rest, `\`) || strings.HasPrefix(rest, `/`) {
39			current += string(filepath.Separator)
40			rest = strings.TrimLeft(rest, `\/`)
41		}
42		components := strings.FieldsFunc(rest, func(r rune) bool { return r == '\\' || r == '/' })
43		for index, component := range components {
44			current = filepath.Join(current, component)
45			pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(current)
46			if err != nil {
47				return err
48			}
49			attributes, err := windows.GetFileAttributes(pointer)
50			if allowMissingFinal && index == len(components)-1 && errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {

24	func (s *Service) resolveSSHKeyPath(value string) (string, error) {
25		if value == "" || strings.IndexByte(value, 0) >= 0 {
26			return "", fmt.Errorf("SSH key path is empty or contains NUL: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
27		}
28		resolved := value
29		switch {
30		case value == "~":
31			resolved = s.paths.Home
32		case strings.HasPrefix(value, "~/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, `~\`):
33			resolved = filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(value[2:]))
34		case value == "%d":
35			resolved = s.paths.Home
36		case strings.HasPrefix(value, "%d/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, `%d\`):
37			resolved = filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(value[3:]))
38		case value == "${HOME}":
39			resolved = s.paths.Home
40		case strings.HasPrefix(value, "${HOME}/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, `${HOME}\`):
41			resolved = filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(value[len("${HOME}/"):]))
42		case strings.HasPrefix(value, "~") || strings.ContainsAny(value, "%$"):
43			return "", fmt.Errorf("SSH key path uses unsupported expansion: %w: %w", ErrUnsafePath, errKeyPathExpansion)

45		if !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) {
46			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(resolved)

49			}

Read-only P2 CLI/TUI verification found these concrete integration defects. No files changed; no tests or real provider operations run.

1. **Agent selection is lost as soon as the key has a local public copy.**
   - `internal/cli/ssh.go:891` and `internal/cli/ssh_onboard.go:422` only configure `IdentityAgent` when `planned.IdentityFile == ""`.
   - Catalog assigns a public-only file to `IdentityFile` (`internal/sshhost/keys.go:516–520`). Therefore, after first setup publishes `dev_agent_<provider>_<alias>.pub`, choosing the same agent key for another alias skips agent configuration entirely. An existing incompatible agent produces `ErrAgentPolicyMismatch`; a default/ambient agent does not give later ordinary logins the selected provider.
   - Independently, `internal/cli/ssh_tui_onboard.go:199–213` drops fingerprint/socket whenever any file path exists. The TUI then plans by `.pub` path without agent authority (`:121–136`).
   - **Minimal fix:** distinguish agent-only signing from “no public file.” Preserve agent selection for public-only candidates even with `IdentityFile/PublicPath`; configure the selected socket and public selector. TUI choices must preserve fingerprint/socket when the signer is agent-only.
   - **Regression tests:** setup agent key on host A, refresh catalog, use it on host B through both CLI and actual TUI adapter with a different ambient agent. Also cover a preexisting `.pub` and a duplicate local private key, ensuring explicit provider selection does not silently select the local signer.

2. **Source-aware setup bypasses the new flag conflict and can generate a plaintext local private key despite `--identity-agent`.**
   - `internal/cli/ssh.go:662–665` routes `--from`, `--to`, `--auth`, etc. to onboarding before `validateSSHSetupFlags`.
   - New mutual exclusion lives only at `ssh.go:720–721`; `internal/cli/ssh_onboard.go:73–95` never checks it.
   - Example: `ssh setup lab --to fleet --identity-agent bitwarden --generate-key --key-path … --no-passphrase --target-os posix --yes`. With the socket available, onboarding resolves it, then still calls the ordinary local generation path.
   - `--auth existing --identity-agent …` and configuration-only/source-aware combinations can silently ignore the agent flag.
   - **Minimal fix:** validate agent authentication compatibility before command dispatch, or add a shared validation routine called by both routes. Reject unsupported combinations before source/provider reads or mutations.

3. **Fleet import advertises named-agent choices but discards their publication/configuration plans.**
   - Anchor: the new `AgentPublicPlan` integration at `internal/cli/ssh_onboard.go:984` is bypassed by the earlier import branch at `:964–971`.
   - `internal/cli/ssh_fleet_import.go:102–126` replaces the planned public selector with `item.KeyPlan.IdentityFile` (empty for a new agent-only key), then `:130–133` replaces the definition with an import definition that never receives `IdentityAgent`.

   - **Minimal fix:** carry controller-selected public publication and agent directives into guarded import plans/apply, including appropriate ownership fingerprints; alternatively explicitly reject/hide named-agent selections in import paths until supported. Do not copy provider settings from the remote source.

164	func (runner *sshCLIRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, request sshhost.RunRequest) (sshhost.RunResult, error) {
165		runner.mu.Lock()
166		runner.calls = append(runner.calls, request)
167		_, hasDeadline := ctx.Deadline()
168		runner.deadlines = append(runner.deadlines, hasDeadline)
169		block := runner.blockDisplay == request.Display
170		runner.mu.Unlock()
171		if block {
172			<-ctx.Done()
173			return sshhost.RunResult{}, ctx.Err()
174		}
175	
176		switch request.Name {
177		case "ssh-keygen":
178			if hasSSHArg(request.Args, "-y") {
179				return sshhost.RunResult{Stdout: append(append([]byte(nil), runner.publicLine...), '\n')}, nil
180			}
181			path := sshArgValue(request.Args, "-f")
182			if path == "" {
183				return sshhost.RunResult{}, errors.New("fake ssh-keygen has no -f")
184			}
185			if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("PRIVATE-KEY-BYTES-MUST-NOT-LEAK\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
186				return sshhost.RunResult{}, err
187			}
188			if err := os.WriteFile(path+".pub", append(append([]byte(nil), runner.publicLine...), '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
189				return sshhost.RunResult{}, err
190			}
191			return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
192		case "ssh":
193			if hasSSHArg(request.Args, "-G") {
194				if runner.effectiveExit != 0 {
195					return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: runner.effectiveExit, Stderr: []byte(runner.effectiveErr)}, nil
196				}
197				alias := sshArgValue(request.Args, "-G")
198				return sshhost.RunResult{Stdout: runner.effective(alias)}, nil
199			}
200			switch request.Display {
201			case "SSH per-hop authentication operation":
202				if path := sshArgValue(request.Args, "-E"); path != "" {
203					if e := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("Authenticated to target using \"publickey\".\n"), 0600); e != nil {
204						return sshhost.RunResult{}, e
205					}
206				}
207				return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
208			case "ssh selected-key-only authentication proof":
209				if path := sshArgValue(request.Args, "-E"); path != "" {
210					if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("Authenticated to target using \"publickey\".\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
211						return sshhost.RunResult{}, err
212					}
213				}
214				return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
215			case "ssh Windows administrator probe":
216				return sshhost.RunResult{Stdout: []byte("standard\n")}, nil
217			case "ssh public-key installer":
218				return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: runner.installerExit}, nil
219			case "ssh authentication proof":
220				if hasSSHArg(request.Args, "-i") {
221					if runner.exactReady {
222						return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
223					}
224					return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: 1}, nil
225				}
226				if runner.ordinaryReady {
227					return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
228				}
229				return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: 1}, nil
230			case "ssh fresh authentication probe":
231				if runner.ordinaryReady {
232					return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
233				}
234				return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: 255}, nil
235			default:
236				return sshhost.RunResult{}, nil
237			}
238		default:
239			return sshhost.RunResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unexpected runner command %q", request.Name)
240		}
241	}

31	// FleetImportPlan contains portable local definitions and explicit origin
32	// intent. Remote keys, agent paths and host-key stores never enter definitions.
33	// The calling coordinator binds/rechecks this plan with remote and local guards.
34	type FleetImportPlan struct {
35		OriginID          string                      `json:"origin_id"`
36		ProfileID         string                      `json:"profile_id"`
37		FleetHost         string                      `json:"fleet_host"`
38		SourceFingerprint string                      `json:"source_fingerprint"`

40		Definitions       []sshhost.ManagedDefinition `json:"definitions"`
41		Imports           []machineregistry.SSHImport `json:"imports"`
42		Route             []sshhost.RouteHop          `json:"route"`
43	}

45	func DefinitionFingerprint(value sshhost.ManagedDefinition) string { return importDigest(value) }
46	func importDigest(value any) string {
47		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
48		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
49		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
50	}
51	
52	func ImportedHopAlias(host, origin, profile string, hop sshhost.RouteHop, prefix []string, identity string) string {
53		label := strings.ToLower(host + "-" + hop.Alias)
54		var safe strings.Builder
55		for _, r := range label {
56			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
57				safe.WriteRune(r)
58			} else {
59				safe.WriteByte('-')
60			}
61		}
62		label = strings.Trim(safe.String(), "-")
63		if len(label) > 64 {
64			label = label[:64]
65		}
66		if label == "" {
67			label = "hop"
68		}
69		return "via-" + label + "-" + importDigest([]any{origin, profile, hop.HostName, hop.User, hop.Port, prefix, identity})[:10]
70	}

72	func importedDefinition(request FleetImportRequest, index int, refs []string) (sshhost.ManagedDefinition, string) {
73		remote := request.Source.RouteProfiles[index]
74		hop := remote.Hop
75		alias, identity := request.Alias, request.IdentityFile
76		if index != len(request.Source.RouteProfiles)-1 {
77			alias = ImportedHopAlias(request.Host.Name, request.Source.Origin.ID, remote.ProfileID, hop, refs, identity)
78		}
79		if selected, ok := request.HopIdentityFiles[alias]; ok {
80			identity = selected
81		}
82		definition := sshhost.ManagedDefinition{Alias: alias, HostName: hop.HostName, User: hop.User, Port: hop.Port, ProxyJump: strings.Join(refs, ","), IdentityFile: identity}
83		return definition, importDigest([]any{request.Source.Origin.ID, remote.ProfileID, hop.HostName, hop.User, hop.Port, refs})
84	}

86	func PlanFleetImport(request FleetImportRequest) (FleetImportPlan, error) {
87		source := request.Source
88		plan := FleetImportPlan{OriginID: source.Origin.ID, ProfileID: source.Profile.ID, FleetHost: request.Host.Name, SourceFingerprint: source.Profile.Fingerprint}
89		if err := sshhost.ValidateManagedAlias(request.Alias); err != nil {
90			return plan, err
91		}
92		if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
93			return plan, err
94		}
95		if !source.Importable {
96			return plan, errors.New("remote profile has nonportable settings; configure an explicit local profile instead")
97		}
98		if len(request.Gateway.Hops) == 0 {
99			return plan, errors.New("fleet source has no reviewed local route")
100		}
101		if len(source.Route.Hops)+len(request.Gateway.Hops) > 16 {
102			return plan, errors.New("imported route exceeds 16 hops")
103		}
104		refs := []string{}
105		usedNames := map[string]bool{}
106		endpoints := map[string]string{}
107		for _, hop := range request.Gateway.Hops {
108			if sshhost.ValidateLookupAlias(hop.Alias) != nil || hop.HostName == "" || hop.User == "" || hop.Port < 1 || hop.Port > 65535 {
109				return plan, errors.New("fleet source contains an invalid reviewed gateway hop")
110			}
111			if hop.Reference == "" {
112				hop.Reference = hop.Alias
113			}
114			refs = append(refs, hop.Reference)
115			hop.Target = false
116			plan.Route = append(plan.Route, hop)
117			usedNames[strings.ToLower(hop.Alias)] = true
118			endpoints[importEndpoint(hop.HostName, hop.Port)] = "local"
119		}
120		if request.GatewayDefinition != nil {
121			definition := request.GatewayDefinition
122			if err := sshhost.ValidateManagedDefinition(*definition); err != nil {
123				return plan, err
124			}
125			last := request.Gateway.Hops[len(request.Gateway.Hops)-1]
126			if !strings.EqualFold(definition.Alias, last.Alias) || importEndpoint(definition.HostName, definition.Port) != importEndpoint(last.HostName, last.Port) || definition.User != "" && definition.User != last.User || definition.ProxyJump != "" && definition.ProxyJump != strings.Join(refs[:len(refs)-1], ",") {
127				return plan, errors.New("gateway definition does not match its reviewed route")
128			}
129			if previous, found := request.Registry.LookupImport(definition.Alias); found && (previous.OriginID != source.Origin.ID || previous.ProfileID != "gateway:"+source.Origin.ID) {
130				return plan, fmt.Errorf("gateway alias %q belongs to a different import origin", definition.Alias)
131			}
132			for _, existing := range request.Existing {
133				if strings.EqualFold(existing.Alias, request.GatewayDefinition.Alias) {
134					previous, found := request.Registry.LookupImport(existing.Alias)
135					if !found || previous.OriginID != source.Origin.ID || previous.ProfileID != "gateway:"+source.Origin.ID || previous.DefinitionFingerprint != DefinitionFingerprint(existing) || DefinitionFingerprint(existing) != DefinitionFingerprint(*request.GatewayDefinition) {
136						return plan, fmt.Errorf("gateway alias %q is not the unchanged owned import", existing.Alias)
137					}
138				}
139			}
140			plan.Definitions = append(plan.Definitions, *request.GatewayDefinition)
141			plan.Imports = append(plan.Imports, machineregistry.SSHImport{LocalAlias: request.GatewayDefinition.Alias, OriginID: source.Origin.ID, ProfileID: "gateway:" + source.Origin.ID, FleetHost: request.Host.Name, RemoteAlias: "@gateway", SourceFingerprint: source.Profile.Fingerprint, RouteFingerprint: importDigest(request.Gateway.Hops), DefinitionFingerprint: DefinitionFingerprint(*request.GatewayDefinition)})
142		}
143		// Resolve the whole planned set before checking existing alternatives: an
144		// unchanged second invocation of this same route is not a foreign profile.
145		type plannedInvocation struct{ profile, route string }
146		planned := map[string]plannedInvocation{}
147		plannedRefs := append([]string{}, refs...)
148		for i, remote := range source.RouteProfiles {
149			definition, fingerprint := importedDefinition(request, i, plannedRefs)
150			planned[strings.ToLower(definition.Alias)] = plannedInvocation{remote.ProfileID, fingerprint}
151			plannedRefs = append(plannedRefs, definition.Alias)
152		}
153		for i, remote := range source.RouteProfiles {
154			hop := remote.Hop
155			endpoint := importEndpoint(hop.HostName, hop.Port)
156			if prior, exists := endpoints[endpoint]; exists && prior != "remote:"+source.Origin.ID {
157				return plan, fmt.Errorf("endpoint %s occurs in different route scopes; reuse an explicitly configured local profile", endpoint)
158			}
159			endpoints[endpoint] = "remote:" + source.Origin.ID
160			definition, prefixFingerprint := importedDefinition(request, i, refs)
161			alias := definition.Alias
162			if usedNames[strings.ToLower(alias)] {
163				return plan, fmt.Errorf("generated alias %q repeats a reviewed route profile", alias)
164			}
165			usedNames[strings.ToLower(alias)] = true
166			if err := sshhost.ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
167				return plan, err
168			}
169			for _, existing := range request.Existing {
170				if strings.EqualFold(existing.Alias, alias) {
171					continue
172				}
173				if importEndpoint(existing.HostName, existing.Port) != endpoint {
174					continue
175				}
176				previous, known := request.Registry.LookupImport(existing.Alias)
177				if invocation, partOfPlan := planned[strings.ToLower(existing.Alias)]; partOfPlan && known && previous.OriginID == source.Origin.ID && previous.ProfileID == invocation.profile && previous.RouteFingerprint == invocation.route && previous.DefinitionFingerprint == DefinitionFingerprint(existing) {
178					continue
179				}
180				if !known || previous.OriginID != source.Origin.ID || previous.ProfileID != remote.ProfileID || previous.RouteFingerprint != prefixFingerprint || previous.DefinitionFingerprint != DefinitionFingerprint(existing) {
181					return plan, fmt.Errorf("endpoint %s already belongs to a different or unscoped local profile %q; review its host-key namespace manually", endpoint, existing.Alias)
182				}
183			}
184			if previous, found := request.Registry.LookupImport(alias); found && (previous.OriginID != source.Origin.ID || previous.ProfileID != remote.ProfileID) {
185				return plan, fmt.Errorf("alias %q has a different import origin; choose a new alias", alias)
186			}
187			for _, existing := range request.Existing {
188				if !strings.EqualFold(existing.Alias, alias) {
189					continue
190				}
191				previous, found := request.Registry.LookupImport(alias)
192				if !found || previous.DefinitionFingerprint != DefinitionFingerprint(existing) {
193					return plan, fmt.Errorf("existing alias %q is not an unchanged profile owned by this import", alias)
194				}
195				// Shared bastions are immutable from another target's import. A key
196				// override needs a separately named profile, never a shared rewrite.
197				if i < len(source.RouteProfiles)-1 && DefinitionFingerprint(existing) != DefinitionFingerprint(definition) {
198					return plan, fmt.Errorf("shared jump profile %q has different settings; select a separate local profile", alias)
199				}
200			}
201			plan.Definitions = append(plan.Definitions, definition)
202			plan.Imports = append(plan.Imports, machineregistry.SSHImport{LocalAlias: alias, OriginID: source.Origin.ID, ProfileID: remote.ProfileID, FleetHost: request.Host.Name, RemoteAlias: hop.Alias, SourceFingerprint: source.Profile.Fingerprint, RouteFingerprint: prefixFingerprint, DefinitionFingerprint: DefinitionFingerprint(definition)})
203			hop.Alias, hop.Reference, hop.Target = alias, alias, i == len(source.RouteProfiles)-1
204			plan.Route = append(plan.Route, hop)
205			refs = append(refs, alias)
206		}
207		for alias := range request.HopIdentityFiles {

210			}
211		}
212		plan.RouteFingerprint = importDigest(plan.Route)
213		return plan, nil
214	}

216	func importEndpoint(host string, port int) string {
217		if port == 0 {

222			host = ip.Unmap().String()
223		}
224		return host + "|" + strconv.Itoa(port)
225	}

34	func (r *sshFleetFixtureRunner) RunWithOptions(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, options fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result {

19	func (o sshSetupOptions) hasExistingKey() bool { return o.key != "" || o.keyCandidate != nil }
20	
21	type sshKeyListDocument struct {
22		SchemaVersion int    `json:"schema_version"`
23		Kind          string `json:"kind"`
24		Status        string `json:"status"`
25		Alias         string `json:"alias,omitempty"`
26		sshhost.KeyCatalog
27		ErrorCode string `json:"error_code,omitempty"`
28	}
29	
30	func newSSHKeyCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
31		cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "key", Short: "Inspect local SSH keys and agent identities (install one with dev ssh setup)", Args: cobra.NoArgs}
32		var jsonOut, noAgent bool
33		var alias, on string
34		var agentValues []string
35		list := &cobra.Command{
36			Use: "list", Short: "List local public keys and SSH agent identities",
37			Long: `List public-key metadata under ~/.ssh and identities from the current SSH agent.
38	Keys are deduplicated by fingerprint. No private key contents are read or printed.
39	For local listings, only --alias evaluates ssh -G and the alias's configured agent.
40	Local listing never repairs permissions, generates keys, or authenticates remotely.
41	--on fleet:HOST explicitly contacts that source for metadata from its own keys and agent.
42	--agent also lists a named agent (bitwarden, 1password, secretive) or an absolute socket.`,
43			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
44			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
45				if on != "" && len(agentValues) > 0 {
46					return asUsageError(errors.New("--agent lists local agents and cannot be combined with --on"))
47				}
48				if on != "" {
49					return runSSHRemoteKeys(cmd.Context(), app, on, alias, noAgent, jsonOut)
50				}
51				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(cmd.Context(), sshShowTimeout)
52				defer cancel()
53				service, err := app.sshHosts()
54				document := sshKeyListDocument{SchemaVersion: sshCLISchemaVersion, Kind: "ssh_key_list", Status: "ready", Alias: alias}
55				if err == nil {
56					var agents []sshhost.AgentSocketRef
57					if agents, err = resolveSSHAgentRefs(service, agentValues); err == nil {
58						document.KeyCatalog, err = service.Catalog(ctx, sshhost.KeyCatalogRequest{LocalOnly: alias == "", Alias: alias, NoAgent: noAgent, Agents: agents})
59					}
60				}
61				if err != nil {
62					document.Status = "failed"
63					document.ErrorCode = sshErrorCode(err)
64				} else if !document.Complete {
65					document.Status = "partial"
66				}
67				if jsonOut {
68					if encodeErr := writeSSHJSON(app, document); encodeErr != nil {
69						return encodeErr
70					}
71				} else if service != nil {
72					renderSSHKeyCatalog(app, service.Paths().Home, document.KeyCatalog)
73				}
74				return err
75			},
76		}
77		list.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "Print key metadata and source diagnostics as JSON")
78		list.Flags().BoolVar(&noAgent, "no-agent", false, "Skip SSH agent enumeration")
79		list.Flags().StringVar(&alias, "alias", "", "Evaluate this alias's OpenSSH identity and agent settings")
80		list.Flags().StringVar(&on, "on", "", "Run key inventory on the selected fleet:HOST using its local key context")
81		list.Flags().StringArrayVar(&agentValues, "agent", nil, "Also list a named SSH agent: bitwarden, 1password, secretive or an absolute socket path (repeatable)")
82		registerFlagCompletion(list, "agent", fixedCompletions(string(sshhost.AgentProviderBitwarden), string(sshhost.AgentProvider1Password), string(sshhost.AgentProviderSecretive)))
83		cmd.AddCommand(list)
84		cmd.AddCommand(newSSHKeyDoctorCmd(app))
85		cmd.AddCommand(newSSHKeyDeriveCmd(app))
86		return cmd
87	}

89	func renderSSHKeyCatalog(app *App, home string, catalog sshhost.KeyCatalog) {
90		if len(catalog.Candidates) == 0 {
91			if catalog.Complete {
92				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No local SSH keys found. Use a key path or generate a key in dev ssh setup.")
93			} else {
94				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No key candidates available; some sources could not be inspected. See diagnostics below.")
95			}
96		} else {
97			w := tabwriter.NewWriter(app.Out, 0, 4, 2, ' ', 0)
98			fmt.Fprintln(w, "KEY\tALGORITHM\tSIGNER\tSOURCE\tFINGERPRINT\tCOMMENT")
99			for _, key := range catalog.Candidates {
100				fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", sshKeyLabel(home, key), key.Algorithm, sshKeySigner(key), sshKeySources(key), key.Fingerprint, key.Comment)
101			}
102			_ = w.Flush()
103		}
104		renderSSHKeyDiagnostics(app, catalog.Diagnostics)
105	}
106	
107	func renderSSHKeyDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []sshhost.Diagnostic) {
108		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
109			message := diagnostic.Message
110			if message == "" {
111				message = strings.ReplaceAll(diagnostic.Code, "_", " ")
112			}
113			if diagnostic.Path != "" && !strings.Contains(message, diagnostic.Path) {
114				message += " (" + diagnostic.Path + ")"
115			}
116			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "dev: SSH keys: %s\n", message)
117		}
118	}
119	
120	func sshKeyLabel(home string, key sshhost.KeyCandidate) string {
121		path := key.IdentityFile
122		if path == "" {
123			path = key.PublicPath
124		}
125		if path == "" {
126			if key.Agent != nil {
127				return sshhost.AgentProviderLabel(key.Agent.Provider) + " agent"
128			}
129			return "SSH agent"
130		}
131		if rel, err := filepath.Rel(home, path); err == nil && rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
132			return "~/" + filepath.ToSlash(rel)
133		}
134		return path
135	}
136	
137	func sshKeySources(key sshhost.KeyCandidate) string {
138		var sources []string
139		for _, source := range key.Sources {
140			sources = append(sources, string(source))
141		}
142		if len(sources) == 0 {
143			sources = append(sources, string(key.Source))
144		}
145		return strings.Join(sources, "+")
146	}
147	
148	func sshKeySigner(key sshhost.KeyCandidate) string {
149		if key.NeedsPermissionRepair {
150			return "permission repair needed"
151		}
152		var signers []string
153		if key.Provenance.Private {
154			signers = append(signers, "private file")
155		}
156		if key.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub {
157			signers = append(signers, "security key")
158		}
159		if key.Provenance.Agent {
160			signers = append(signers, "agent")
161		}
162		if len(signers) == 0 {
163			return "public only; no signer found"
164		}
165		return strings.Join(signers, " + ")
166	}
167	
168	func localSSHKeyCatalog(ctx context.Context, service *sshhost.Service, agents ...sshhost.AgentSocketRef) (sshhost.KeyCatalog, error) {
169		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, sshShowTimeout)
170		defer cancel()
171		return service.Catalog(ctx, sshhost.KeyCatalogRequest{LocalOnly: true, Agents: agents})
172	}
173	
174	func resolveSSHAgentRefs(service *sshhost.Service, values []string) ([]sshhost.AgentSocketRef, error) {
175		refs := make([]sshhost.AgentSocketRef, 0, len(values))
176		for _, value := range values {
177			ref, err := service.ResolveAgentSocket(runtime.GOOS, value)
178			if err != nil {
179				return nil, err
180			}
181			refs = append(refs, ref)
182		}
183		return refs, nil
184	}
185	
186	// sshPickerAgents returns the explicit agent sockets a key picker lists: the
187	// flag-selected agent, or every provider whose socket is present. Installed
188	// providers without a socket get a hint on app.Err when app is non-nil.
189	func sshPickerAgents(app *App, service *sshhost.Service, options sshSetupOptions) []sshhost.AgentSocketRef {
190		if options.agentRef != nil {
191			return []sshhost.AgentSocketRef{*options.agentRef}
192		}
193		var agents []sshhost.AgentSocketRef
194		for _, observation := range service.ObserveAgentProviders(runtime.GOOS) {
195			switch {
196			case observation.Provider == sshhost.AgentProviderWindowsPipe:
197			case observation.SocketPresent:
198				agents = append(agents, sshhost.AgentSocketRef{Provider: observation.Provider, Socket: observation.Socket})
199			case observation.AppDetected && app != nil:
200				fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "dev: %s is installed but its SSH agent socket was not found; %s to list its keys.\n", observation.Label, sshhost.AgentProviderEnableHint(observation.Provider))
201			}
202		}
203		return agents
204	}
205	
206	// selectSSHAgentKey finds key, a SHA256 fingerprint or a .pub path, in one agent.
207	func selectSSHAgentKey(ctx context.Context, service *sshhost.Service, ref sshhost.AgentSocketRef, key string) (sshhost.KeyCandidate, error) {
208		fingerprint := key
209		if !strings.HasPrefix(key, "SHA256:") {
210			file, err := os.Open(expandSSHFile(key))
211			if err != nil {
212				return sshhost.KeyCandidate{}, fmt.Errorf("read public key for --identity-agent: %w", err)
213			}
214			data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, sshhost.MaxPublicKeyLineBytes+1))
215			file.Close()
216			if err != nil {
217				return sshhost.KeyCandidate{}, err
218			}
219			metadata, err := sshhost.ParsePublicKey(data)
220			if err != nil {
221				return sshhost.KeyCandidate{}, fmt.Errorf("--key with --identity-agent must be a SHA256 fingerprint or a .pub file: %w", err)
222			}
223			fingerprint = metadata.Fingerprint
224		}
225		catalog, err := localSSHKeyCatalog(ctx, service, ref)
226		if err != nil {
227			return sshhost.KeyCandidate{}, err
228		}
229		for _, candidate := range catalog.Candidates {
230			if candidate.Agent != nil && candidate.Agent.Socket == ref.Socket && candidate.Fingerprint == fingerprint {
231				return candidate, nil
232			}
233		}
234		return sshhost.KeyCandidate{}, fmt.Errorf("key %s is not offered by the %s agent", fingerprint, sshKeyAgentName(ref.Provider))
235	}
236	
237	func sshKeyAgentName(provider sshhost.AgentProviderID) string {
238		return sshhost.AgentProviderLabel(provider) + " SSH"
239	}
240	
241	// sshAgentManualError explains the lines a user adds to a foreign alias that
242	// dev must not rewrite.
243	func sshAgentManualError(alias string, ref sshhost.AgentSocketRef, publicPath string) error {
244		return fmt.Errorf("%s is a foreign SSH alias, so dev will not edit it. To use this %s agent key, save its public line to %s and add to that Host block:\n    IdentityAgent %q\n    IdentityFile %q\n    IdentitiesOnly yes\n%w",
245			alias, sshhost.AgentProviderLabel(ref.Provider), publicPath, ref.Socket, publicPath, sshhost.ErrManualRemediation)
246	}

249	// path in one picker, then prepares the selected key plan.

15	// Effective asks the system OpenSSH client for evaluated user+system config.
16	// It intentionally supplies no -F override. Static discovery never calls this
17	// method; callers choose when user-authored Match exec/resolver behavior may run.
18	func (s *Service) Effective(ctx context.Context, alias string) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
19		if ctx == nil {
20			ctx = context.Background()
21		}
22		if err := ValidateLookupAlias(alias); err != nil {
23			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
24		}
25		return s.evaluateSSHConfig(
26			ctx,
27			alias,
28			[]string{"-G", alias},
29			"ssh -G <alias>",
30			"evaluate SSH config",
31			true,
32		)
33	}

35	func (s *Service) evaluateSSHConfig(ctx context.Context, alias string, args []string, display, errorContext string, stderrOnExit bool) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
36		if ctx == nil {
37			ctx = context.Background()
38		}
39		result, err := s.runner.Run(ctx, RunRequest{
40			Name: "ssh", Args: args, Env: []string{"LC_ALL=C"}, Display: display,
41		})
42		if err != nil {
43			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", errorContext, err)
44		}
45		if result.ExitCode != 0 {
46			message := ""
47			if stderrOnExit {
48				message = strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
49			}
50			if message == "" {
51				message = fmt.Sprintf("exit status %d", result.ExitCode)
52			}
53			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", errorContext, message)
54		}
55		return ParseEffective(alias, result.Stdout)
56	}
57	
58	// VerifyManaged evaluates the ordinary user+system SSH configuration with
59	// plain ssh -G and checks that every scalar emitted by the managed fragment is
60	// effective. IdentityFile is additive, so managed expectations must appear in
61	// order but unrelated system/default identities may also be present.
62	func (s *Service) VerifyManaged(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
63		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
64			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
65		}
66		effective, err := s.Effective(ctx, definition.Alias)
67		if err != nil {
68			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
69		}
70		if err := VerifyManagedEffective(definition, effective); err != nil {
71			return EffectiveConfig{}, err
72		}
73		return effective, nil
74	}
75	
76	// VerifyManagedEffective compares a managed definition with parsed ssh -G
77	// output. Error text names mismatched fields without echoing configuration
78	// values that may contain command-like user input.
79	func VerifyManagedEffective(definition ManagedDefinition, effective EffectiveConfig) error {
80		if err := ValidateManagedDefinition(definition); err != nil {
81			return err
82		}
83		var mismatches []string
84		if !equalAlias(definition.Alias, effective.Alias) {
85			mismatches = append(mismatches, "Alias")
86		}
87		if definition.HostName != effective.HostName {
88			mismatches = append(mismatches, "HostName")
89		}
90		if definition.User != "" && definition.User != effective.User {
91			mismatches = append(mismatches, "User")
92		}
93		if definition.Port != 0 && definition.Port != effective.Port {
94			mismatches = append(mismatches, "Port")
95		}
96		if definition.ProxyJump != "" && definition.ProxyJump != effective.ProxyJump {
97			mismatches = append(mismatches, "ProxyJump")
98		}
99		if definition.IdentitiesOnly != nil && (effective.IdentitiesOnly == nil || *definition.IdentitiesOnly != *effective.IdentitiesOnly) {
100			mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentitiesOnly")
101		}
102		if definition.IdentityFile != "" && !containsOrderedValues(effective.IdentityFiles, []string{definition.IdentityFile}) {
103			mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentityFile")
104		}
105		if definition.IdentityAgent != "" {
106			if value := firstEffectiveValue(effective, "identityagent"); value == "" || filepath.Clean(value) != definition.IdentityAgent {
107				mismatches = append(mismatches, "IdentityAgent")
108			}
109		}
110		if definition.SecurityKeyProvider != "" && firstEffectiveValue(effective, "securitykeyprovider") != definition.SecurityKeyProvider {
111			mismatches = append(mismatches, "SecurityKeyProvider")
112		}
113		if len(mismatches) > 0 {
114			return fmt.Errorf("managed SSH config does not control effective fields: %s", strings.Join(mismatches, ", "))
115		}
116		return nil
117	}
118	
119	func (s *Service) verifyManagedEffective(ctx context.Context, definition ManagedDefinition) error {
120		_, err := s.VerifyManaged(ctx, definition)
121		return err
122	}
123	
124	func firstEffectiveValue(effective EffectiveConfig, key string) string {
125		if values := effective.Values[key]; len(values) > 0 {
126			return values[0]
127		}
128		return ""
129	}
130	
131	func containsOrderedValues(actual, expected []string) bool {
132		next := 0
133		for _, value := range actual {
134			if next < len(expected) && value == expected[next] {
135				next++
136			}
137		}
138		return next == len(expected)
139	}
140	
141	// ValidateLookupAlias prevents option injection while retaining foreign exact
142	// aliases outside the narrower managed grammar.
143	func ValidateLookupAlias(alias string) error {
144		if alias == "" || len(alias) > 255 || !utf8.ValidString(alias) {
145			return fmt.Errorf("invalid SSH alias %q", alias)
146		}
147		if strings.HasPrefix(alias, "-") || strings.ContainsAny(alias, "*?[]!") {
148			return fmt.Errorf("invalid exact SSH alias %q", alias)
149		}
150		for _, r := range alias {
151			if unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsControl(r) {
152				return fmt.Errorf("invalid exact SSH alias %q", alias)
153			}
154		}
155		return nil
156	}
157	
158	// ParseEffective parses ssh -G's stable key/value output. Unknown keys remain
159	// in Values for future domain consumers without becoming a public CLI schema.
160	func ParseEffective(alias string, output []byte) (EffectiveConfig, error) {
161		config := EffectiveConfig{Alias: alias, Values: make(map[string][]string)}
162		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(output))
163		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4096), 2<<20)
164		for scanner.Scan() {
165			line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
166			if line == "" {
167				continue
168			}
169			separator := strings.IndexFunc(line, unicode.IsSpace)
170			if separator < 1 {
171				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: malformed line %q", line)
172			}
173			key := strings.ToLower(line[:separator])
174			value := strings.TrimSpace(line[separator:])
175			if value == "" {
176				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: %s has no value", key)
177			}
178			config.Values[key] = append(config.Values[key], value)
179		}
180		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
181			return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: %w", err)
182		}
183		config.HostName = firstEffectiveValue(config, "hostname")
184		config.User = firstEffectiveValue(config, "user")
185		config.ProxyJump = firstEffectiveValue(config, "proxyjump")
186		config.IdentityFiles = append([]string(nil), config.Values["identityfile"]...)
187		if value := firstEffectiveValue(config, "port"); value != "" {
188			port, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
189			if err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 {
190				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: invalid port %q", value)
191			}
192			config.Port = port
193		}
194		if value := firstEffectiveValue(config, "identitiesonly"); value != "" {
195			var enabled bool
196			switch strings.ToLower(value) {
197			case "yes", "true":
198				enabled = true
199			case "no", "false":
200				enabled = false
201			default:
202				return EffectiveConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("parse ssh -G output: invalid identitiesonly %q", value)
203			}
204			config.IdentitiesOnly = &enabled
205		}
206		return config, nil
207	}

999		if candidate.state == nil || candidate.state.serviceID != s.id {
1000			return nil, errors.New("key candidate was not produced by this service")
1001		}
1002		public := candidate
1003		public.state = nil
1004		if !reflect.DeepEqual(public, candidate.state.safe) {
1005			return nil, errors.New("key candidate public fields were modified")
1006		}
1007		if len(candidate.state.publicLine) == 0 {
1008			return nil, errors.New("key candidate has no private material state")
1009		}
1010		return candidate.state, nil
1011	}

1013	// PlanKey performs only local bounded reads. It never invokes ssh, ssh-add, or
1014	// ssh-keygen and never creates a file.
1015	func (s *Service) PlanKey(ctx context.Context, request KeyRequest) (KeyPlan, error) {
1016		if ctx == nil {
1017			ctx = context.Background()
1018		}
1019		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1020			return KeyPlan{}, err
1021		}
1022		operation := request.Operation
1023		if operation == "" {
1024			operation = KeyUse
1025		}
1026		if operation != KeyUse && operation != KeyGenerate && operation != KeyPublishAgent {
1027			return KeyPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported key operation %q", operation)
1028		}
1029		request.Operation = operation
1030		if operation == KeyGenerate {
1031			return s.planGeneratedKey(request)
1032		}
1033		if operation == KeyPublishAgent {
1034			return s.planAgentPublication(request)
1035		}
1036		if request.Candidate.state != nil {
1037			if request.Path != "" {
1038				return KeyPlan{}, errors.New("key request cannot select both candidate and path")
1039			}
1040			material, err := s.validateKeyCandidate(request.Candidate)
1041			if err != nil {
1042				return KeyPlan{}, err
1043			}
1044			if material.safe.NeedsPermissionRepair {

1046			}
1047			if err := s.revalidateSelectedLocalSources(material); err != nil {
1048				return KeyPlan{}, err
1049			}
1050			plan := keyPlanForMaterial(ActionNoop, KeyUse, material.safe)

91		for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
92			if spec.id == id {
93				return spec.label
94			}
95		}
96		switch id {
97		case AgentProviderWindowsPipe:
98			return "Windows OpenSSH agent pipe"
99		case AgentProviderCustom:
100			return "custom agent"
101		}
102		return string(id)
103	}
104	
105	// AgentProviderEnableHint names the native step that exposes a provider's socket.
106	func AgentProviderEnableHint(id AgentProviderID) string {
107		for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
108			if spec.id == id {
109				return spec.enable
110			}
111		}
112		return ""
113	}
114	
115	// ObserveAgentProviders reports providers whose application or agent socket is
116	// present for goos. It only stats paths: sockets must be real sockets owned by
117	// the current user below directories that are not symlinks.
118	func (s *Service) ObserveAgentProviders(goos string) []AgentProviderObservation {
119		if goos == "windows" {
120			if _, err := os.Stat(windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe); err != nil {
121				return nil
122			}
123			return []AgentProviderObservation{{
124				Provider: AgentProviderWindowsPipe, Label: AgentProviderLabel(AgentProviderWindowsPipe),
125				Socket: windowsOpenSSHAgentPipe, SocketPresent: true,
126			}}
127		}
128		var observations []AgentProviderObservation
129		for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
130			sockets := spec.sockets[goos]
131			if len(sockets) == 0 {
132				continue
133			}
134			observation := AgentProviderObservation{
135				Provider: spec.id, Label: spec.label,
136				Socket: filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(sockets[0])),
137			}
138			for _, relative := range sockets {
139				path := filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
140				if s.homeAgentSocketUsable(path) == nil {
141					observation.Socket, observation.SocketPresent = path, true
142					break
143				}
144			}
145			for _, app := range spec.apps[goos] {
146				if s.agentAppExists(app) {
147					observation.AppDetected = true
148					break
149				}
150			}
151			if observation.SocketPresent || observation.AppDetected {
152				observations = append(observations, observation)
153			}
154		}
155		return observations
156	}
157	
158	// ResolveAgentSocket maps a provider name or an absolute socket path to an
159	// agent reference. Provider names require a present socket.
160	func (s *Service) ResolveAgentSocket(goos, value string) (AgentSocketRef, error) {
161		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
162		for _, spec := range agentProviderSpecs {
163			if !strings.EqualFold(value, string(spec.id)) {
164				continue
165			}
166			for _, observation := range s.ObserveAgentProviders(goos) {
167				if observation.Provider == spec.id && observation.SocketPresent {
168					return AgentSocketRef{Provider: spec.id, Socket: observation.Socket}, nil
169				}
170			}
171			return AgentSocketRef{}, fmt.Errorf("%s SSH agent socket was not found; %s: %w", spec.label, spec.enable, ErrAgentProviderUnavailable)
172		}
173		if err := ValidateAgentSocketPath(value); err != nil {
174			return AgentSocketRef{}, err
175		}
176		if err := s.agentSocketUsable(value); err != nil {
177			return AgentSocketRef{}, fmt.Errorf("SSH agent socket %s: %w: %w", value, err, ErrAgentProviderUnavailable)
178		}
179		return AgentSocketRef{Provider: AgentProviderCustom, Socket: value}, nil
180	}
181	
182	// ValidateAgentSocketPath accepts only an absolute, clean, token-free path so
183	// the same value can be written to SSH configuration and compared with ssh -G.
184	func ValidateAgentSocketPath(value string) error {
185		if value == "" || !validUTF8NoControl(value) || !filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.Clean(value) != value || strings.ContainsAny(value, "%$~") {
186			return fmt.Errorf("SSH agent socket must be an absolute path without ~, %% or $ tokens: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
187		}
188		return nil
189	}
190	
191	func (s *Service) homeAgentSocketUsable(path string) error {
192		for dir := filepath.Dir(path); dir != s.paths.Home && dir != filepath.Dir(dir); dir = filepath.Dir(dir) {
193			info, err := os.Lstat(dir)
194			if err != nil {
195				return err
196			}
197			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
198				return fmt.Errorf("%s is a symlink: %w", dir, ErrUnsafePath)
199			}
200		}
201		return s.agentSocketUsable(path)
202	}
203	
204	func (s *Service) agentSocketUsable(path string) error {
205		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
206		if err != nil {
207			return err
208		}
209		check := s.agentSocketCheck
210		if check == nil {
211			check = platformAgentSocket
212		}
213		return check(path, info)
214	}
215	
216	func (s *Service) agentAppExists(app string) bool {
217		path := app
218		if strings.HasPrefix(app, "~/") {
219			path = filepath.Join(s.paths.Home, filepath.FromSlash(app[2:]))
220		} else if s.agentSystemRoot != "" {
221			path = filepath.Join(s.agentSystemRoot, filepath.FromSlash(app))
222		}
223		_, err := os.Stat(path)
224		return err == nil
225	}
226	
227	func cloneAgentRef(ref *AgentSocketRef) *AgentSocketRef {
228		if ref == nil {
229			return nil
230		}
231		copy := *ref
232		return &copy
233	}
234	
235	func agentSocketMode(info fs.FileInfo) bool { return info.Mode().Type() == fs.ModeSocket }
