183	// selectSSHTUIAgentKey re-catalogs the reviewed agent socket and requires the
184	// same fingerprint before planning.
185	func selectSSHTUIAgentKey(ctx context.Context, service *sshhost.Service, request sshflow.OnboardRequest) (sshhost.KeyCandidate, error) {
186		ref := sshhost.AgentSocketRef{Provider: sshhost.AgentProviderCustom, Socket: request.KeyAgentSocket}
187		for _, observation := range service.ObserveAgentProviders(runtime.GOOS) {
188			if observation.SocketPresent && observation.Socket == request.KeyAgentSocket {
189				ref.Provider = observation.Provider
190			}
191		}
192		candidate, err := selectSSHAgentKey(ctx, service, ref, request.KeyFingerprint)
193		if err != nil {
194			return candidate, fmt.Errorf("%w; list keys again: %w", err, sshhost.ErrSourceChanged)
195		}
196		return candidate, nil
197	}

199	// listSSHTUIKeys offers file-backed local keys, named and ambient agent keys,
200	// and a generated destination. The ambient socket is captured before catalog
201	// enumeration and remains an explicit reference after selection.
202	func listSSHTUIKeys(ctx context.Context, app *App, alias string) ([]tui.SSHKeyChoice, error) {
203		service, err := app.sshHosts()
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, err
206		}
207		agents := sshPickerAgents(nil, service, sshSetupOptions{})
208		ambientUnavailable := ""
209		if socket := os.Getenv("SSH_AUTH_SOCK"); socket != "" {
210			var ref sshhost.AgentSocketRef
211			err := sshhost.ValidateAgentSocketPath(socket)
212			if err == nil {
213				ref, err = service.ResolveAgentSocket(runtime.GOOS, socket)
214			}
215			if err != nil {
216				ambientUnavailable = "SSH_AUTH_SOCK is not a usable owned socket; select another agent or configure an absolute socket path, then reopen the picker."
217			} else {
218				known := false
219				for _, agent := range agents {
220					known = known || agent.Socket == ref.Socket
221				}
222				if !known {
223					agents = append(agents, ref)
224				}
225			}
226		}
227		catalog, err := localSSHKeyCatalog(ctx, service, agents...)
228		if err != nil {
229			return nil, err
230		}
231		home := service.Paths().Home
232		choices := make([]tui.SSHKeyChoice, 0, len(catalog.Candidates)+1)
233		if ambientUnavailable != "" {
234			choices = append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: "SSH_AUTH_SOCK agent (unavailable)", Description: ambientUnavailable, UnavailableReason: ambientUnavailable})
235		}
236		for _, key := range catalog.Candidates {
237			if key.Agent != nil {
238				label := sshKeyLabel(home, key)
239				if key.Comment != "" {
240					label += ": " + key.Comment
241				}
242				choices = append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: label, Description: key.Algorithm + " · " + key.Fingerprint, Fingerprint: key.Fingerprint, AgentProvider: string(key.Agent.Provider), AgentSocket: key.Agent.Socket})
243				continue
244			}
245			path := key.IdentityFile
246			if path == "" {
247				path = key.PublicPath
248			}
249			if path != "" {
250				choices = append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: sshKeyLabel(home, key), Description: key.Algorithm + " · " + sshKeySigner(key), Path: path})
251			}
252		}
253		for _, observation := range service.ObserveAgentProviders(runtime.GOOS) {
254			if observation.Provider == sshhost.AgentProviderWindowsPipe || observation.SocketPresent {
255				continue
256			}
257			hint := "The SSH agent socket was not found; " + sshhost.AgentProviderEnableHint(observation.Provider) + ", then reopen the key picker."
258			choices = append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: observation.Label + " agent (unavailable)", Description: hint, AgentProvider: string(observation.Provider), UnavailableReason: hint})
259		}
260		if sshhost.ValidateLookupAlias(alias) != nil {
261			alias = "host"
262		}
263		destination := filepath.Join(service.Paths().SSHDir, "id_ed25519_dev_"+alias)
264		return append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: "+ Generate a new key", Description: "Ed25519 at " + sshKeyLabel(home, sshhost.KeyCandidate{IdentityFile: destination}), Path: destination, Generate: true}), nil
265	}

267	func (w *sshTUIWorkflow) applyOnboarding() error {
268		plan, ok := w.request.Onboarding.(*sshTUIOnboardingPlan)
269		if !ok || plan == nil || plan.prepared == nil {
270			return errors.New("prepare and review an SSH onboarding plan first")
271		}
272		if plan.used.Swap(true) {
273			return errors.New("this SSH setup plan was already attempted; refresh and review a new plan")
274		}
275		if w.app.machineStore().Path != plan.registryPath || fleetConfigPath(&w.app) != plan.fleetPath {
276			return errors.New("SSH setup configuration changed; review a new plan")
277		}
278		service, err := w.app.sshHosts()
279		if err != nil {
280			return err
281		}
282		if service.Paths() != plan.prepared.service.Paths() {
283			return errors.New("SSH configuration root changed; review a new plan")
284		}
285		result, err := applySSHOnboardPlan(w.ctx, &w.app, plan.prepared, false)
286		w.result.Onboarding = &result
287		w.result.Status = "SSH setup: " + result.Status
288		for _, registration := range result.Registrations {
289			for _, outcome := range registration.Outcomes {
290				if outcome.Status == "applied" || outcome.Status == "unknown" {
291					w.result.MembershipChanged = true
292				}
293			}
294		}
295		return err
296	}

9	// OnboardRequest carries an exact discovery observation into a reviewed setup.
10	// Reports are provenance, never authentication or machine identity authority.
11	type OnboardRequest struct {
12		Candidate             *sshdiscovery.Candidate
13		Report                *sshdiscovery.Report
14		MachineID             string
15		Alias, HostName, User string
16		Port                  int
17		Auth                  string
18		KeyPath               string
19		KeyComment            string
20		// KeyFingerprint and KeyAgentSocket select a key held by a named agent.
21		KeyFingerprint, KeyAgentSocket                    string
22		GenerateKey                                       bool
23		To, RemoteOS, FleetName, HerdrLabel, HerdrSession string
24		// Profile installs a key for this existing alias; its connection fields
25		// are read-only and never rewritten from the request.
26		Profile *ConnectionProfile

1	// Package sshvault creates new SSH keys in explicitly selected vaults. It never
2	// imports an existing private key, writes private material to disk, or manages
3	// an agent. Planning is explicit provider execution, not passive discovery.
4	package sshvault
5	
6	import (
7		"errors"
8		"sync"
9	
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/sshcredential"
11	)
12	
13	type Provider string
14	
15	const (
16		Bitwarden     Provider = "bitwarden"
17		OnePassword   Provider = "1password"
18		PersonalVault          = "personal"
19	)
20	
21	var (
22		ErrUnsafe             = errors.New("invalid SSH vault key request")
23		ErrUnavailable        = errors.New("SSH vault provider unavailable or returned invalid metadata")
24		ErrLocked             = errors.New("SSH vault provider is locked or not authenticated; unlock it using its native tools")
25		ErrUnsupportedVersion = errors.New("SSH vault provider version is not supported")
26		ErrUnsupportedContext = errors.New("Bitwarden CLI does not disclose an exact server identity; cloud-region key creation is unsupported without verifiable destination metadata")
27		ErrExperimental       = errors.New("Bitwarden in-memory SSH key generation requires explicit experimental approval")
28		ErrStale              = errors.New("SSH vault key plan or destination changed; review a new plan")
29		ErrPlanUsed           = errors.New("SSH vault key creation was already attempted; do not retry without reconciling the vault")
30		ErrUnknown            = errors.New("SSH vault mutation outcome or destination is unknown; inspect the vault before any new creation")
31		ErrPublicKey          = errors.New("SSH vault item was created but its public key could not be verified; retain the item and reconcile it")
32	)
33	
34	// Request selects a destination, not a saved password context. OnePassword
35	// requires an exact vault ID; AccountID may select an exact account or be empty
36	// to review the current account. Bitwarden currently supports only its personal
37	// vault and requires Experimental. AccountID, when set, is its exact user ID.
38	// No unlock secret or private key belongs in this API.
39	type Request struct {
40		Provider     Provider `json:"provider"`
41		Title        string   `json:"title"`
42		AccountID    string   `json:"account_id,omitempty"`
43		VaultID      string   `json:"vault_id,omitempty"`
44		Experimental bool     `json:"experimental,omitempty"`
45	}
46	
47	// Destination is the reviewed provider identity. It does not authorize provider
48	// login, vault creation, organization selection, or native agent configuration.
49	type Destination struct {
50		Provider  Provider `json:"provider"`
51		AccountID string   `json:"account_id"`
52		ServerURL string   `json:"server_url"`
53		UserID    string   `json:"user_id"`
54		VaultID   string   `json:"vault_id"`
55		VaultName string   `json:"vault_name,omitempty"`
56	}
57	
58	type Plan struct {
59		Destination  Destination `json:"destination"`
60		Version      string      `json:"version"`
61		Title        string      `json:"title"`
62		Experimental bool        `json:"experimental,omitempty"`
63		state        *planState
64	}
65	
66	type planState struct {
67		service   *Service
68		request   Request
69		dest      Destination
70		version   string
71		operation string
72		attempted bool
73	}
74	
75	// Receipt contains only public material. Destination is the reviewed destination,
76	// not a claim that an external CLI could not change account while it ran. Consult
77	// Result.BindingStatus before relying on that association. An item ID may be
78	// known even when PublicLine and Fingerprint could not yet be obtained.
79	type Receipt struct {
80		Destination
81		ItemID      string `json:"item_id"`
82		PublicLine  string `json:"public_line,omitempty"`
83		Fingerprint string `json:"fingerprint,omitempty"`
84	}
85	
86	const (
87		StatusNotStarted = "not_started"
88		StatusCreated    = "created"
89		StatusUnknown    = "unknown"
90		BindingVerified  = "verified"
91		BindingUnknown   = "unknown"
92	)
93	
94	// Created means that a matching creation response was verified; it never means
95	// the selected SSH agent serves the key. ErrPublicKey and ErrUnknown can accompany
96	// a created result and its retained receipt. No automatic retry is permitted.
97	type Result struct {
98		Status        string   `json:"status"`
99		BindingStatus string   `json:"binding_status,omitempty"`
100		Receipt       *Receipt `json:"receipt,omitempty"`

29	func validText(value string, maxBytes int) bool {
30		if value == "" || len(value) > maxBytes || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) || strings.HasPrefix(value, "-") {
31			return false
32		}
33		for _, r := range value {
34			if !unicode.IsPrint(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
35				return false
36			}
37		}
38		return true
39	}
40	
41	func validateRequest(request Request) error {
42		if !validText(request.Title, 256) {
43			return ErrUnsafe
44		}
45		switch request.Provider {
46		case Bitwarden:
47			if !request.Experimental {
48				return ErrExperimental
49			}
50			if request.AccountID != "" && !bwIDPattern.MatchString(request.AccountID) || request.VaultID != "" && request.VaultID != PersonalVault {
51				return ErrUnsafe
52			}
53		case OnePassword:
54			if request.Experimental || !opIDPattern.MatchString(request.VaultID) || request.AccountID != "" && !opIDPattern.MatchString(request.AccountID) {
55				return ErrUnsafe
56			}
57		default:
58			return ErrUnsafe
59		}
60		return nil
61	}
62	
63	func serverURL(value string, allowBareHost bool) (string, bool) {
64		if !validText(value, 512) {
65			return "", false
66		}
67		if allowBareHost && !strings.Contains(value, "://") {
68			value = "https://" + value
69		}
70		parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
71		if err != nil || parsed.Scheme != "https" || parsed.Hostname() == "" || parsed.User != nil || parsed.RawQuery != "" || parsed.Fragment != "" || parsed.Opaque != "" {
72			return "", false
73		}
74		return strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.String(), "/"), true
75	}
76	
77	func supportedOPVersion(value string) bool {
78		parts := strings.Split(value, ".")
79		if len(parts) != 3 || parts[0] != "2" {
80			return false
81		}
82		for _, part := range parts {
83			if part == "" || len(part) > 4 {
84				return false
85			}
86			for _, c := range part {
87				if c < '0' || c > '9' {
88					return false
89				}
90			}
91		}
92		minor, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
93		return err == nil && minor >= 20
94	}
95	
96	// run never exposes a provider's stderr, raw failure, or partial output. A
97	// response can contain private fields even when only public metadata was asked
98	// for; every caller must wipe returned bytes after its bounded, typed decode.
99	func (s *Service) run(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
100		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		if s == nil || s.runner == nil {
104			return nil, ErrUnavailable
105		}
106		body, err := s.runner.Run(ctx, name, args, input)
107		if err != nil || len(body) > maxOutput {
108			sshcredential.Wipe(body)
109			return nil, ErrUnavailable
110		}
111		return body, nil
112	}
113	
114	func (s *Service) version(ctx context.Context, provider Provider) (string, error) {
115		name := "op"
116		if provider == Bitwarden {
117			name = "bw"
118		}
119		body, err := s.run(ctx, name, []string{"--version"}, nil)
120		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
121		if err != nil {
122			return "", err
123		}
124		if len(body) > 64 {
125			return "", ErrUnsupportedVersion
126		}
127		version := strings.TrimSpace(string(body))
128		if provider == Bitwarden && version != BitwardenSchemaVersion || provider == OnePassword && !supportedOPVersion(version) {
129			return "", ErrUnsupportedVersion
130		}
131		return version, nil
132	}
133	
134	func (s *Service) observe(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Destination, string, error) {
135		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
136			return Destination{}, "", err
137		}
138		version, err := s.version(ctx, request.Provider)
139		if err != nil {
140			return Destination{}, "", err
141		}
142		var destination Destination
143		switch request.Provider {
144		case Bitwarden:
145			destination, err = s.observeBitwarden(ctx, request)
146		case OnePassword:
147			destination, err = s.observeOnePassword(ctx, request)
148		default:
149			err = ErrUnsafe
150		}
151		return destination, version, err
152	}
153	
154	func (s *Service) observeBitwarden(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Destination, error) {
155		body, err := s.run(ctx, "bw", []string{"status"}, nil)
156		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
157		if err != nil {
158			return Destination{}, err
159		}
160		var status struct {
161			Status    string `json:"status"`
162			UserID    string `json:"userId"`
163			ServerURL string `json:"serverUrl"`
164		}
165		if json.Unmarshal(body, &status) != nil {
166			return Destination{}, ErrUnavailable
167		}
168		if status.Status == "locked" || status.Status == "unauthenticated" {
169			return Destination{}, ErrLocked
170		}
171		if status.Status == "unlocked" && bwIDPattern.MatchString(status.UserID) && status.ServerURL == "" {
172			// In the pinned CLI, both US and EU cloud status use a null base URL;
173			// config server also reports the same fallback for both. Neither is
174			// authority to guess a destination, and config URL flags mutate state.
175			return Destination{}, ErrUnsupportedContext
176		}
177		server, valid := serverURL(status.ServerURL, false)
178		if status.Status != "unlocked" || !bwIDPattern.MatchString(status.UserID) || !valid {
179			return Destination{}, ErrUnavailable
180		}
181		if request.AccountID != "" && status.UserID != request.AccountID {
182			return Destination{}, ErrStale
183		}
184		return Destination{Provider: Bitwarden, AccountID: status.UserID, UserID: status.UserID, ServerURL: server, VaultID: PersonalVault, VaultName: "Personal vault"}, nil
185	}
186	
187	func (s *Service) observeOnePassword(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Destination, error) {
188		args := []string{"whoami", "--format", "json"}
189		if request.AccountID != "" {
190			args = append(args, "--account", request.AccountID)
191		}
192		body, err := s.run(ctx, "op", args, nil)
193		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
194		if err != nil {
195			return Destination{}, ErrLocked
196		}
197		var identity struct {
198			AccountID string `json:"account_uuid"`
199			UserID    string `json:"user_uuid"`
200			URL       string `json:"url"`
201		}
202		if json.Unmarshal(body, &identity) != nil {
203			return Destination{}, ErrUnavailable
204		}
205		server, valid := serverURL(identity.URL, true)
206		if !opIDPattern.MatchString(identity.AccountID) || !opIDPattern.MatchString(identity.UserID) || !valid {
207			return Destination{}, ErrUnavailable
208		}
209		if request.AccountID != "" && request.AccountID != identity.AccountID {
210			return Destination{}, ErrStale
211		}
212		vaultBody, err := s.run(ctx, "op", []string{"vault", "get", request.VaultID, "--account", identity.AccountID, "--format", "json"}, nil)
213		defer sshcredential.Wipe(vaultBody)
214		if err != nil {
215			return Destination{}, err
216		}
217		var vault struct {
218			ID   string `json:"id"`
219			Name string `json:"name"`
220		}
221		if json.Unmarshal(vaultBody, &vault) != nil || vault.ID != request.VaultID || !validText(vault.Name, 256) {
222			return Destination{}, ErrUnavailable
223		}
224		return Destination{Provider: OnePassword, AccountID: identity.AccountID, UserID: identity.UserID, ServerURL: server, VaultID: vault.ID, VaultName: vault.Name}, nil
225	}
226	
227	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
228		if err := validateRequest(request); err != nil {
229			return Plan{}, err
230		}
231		destination, version, err := s.observe(ctx, request)
232		if err != nil {
233			return Plan{}, err
234		}
235		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
236			return Plan{}, err
237		}
238		var nonce [16]byte
239		if _, err = rand.Read(nonce[:]); err != nil {
240			return Plan{}, ErrUnavailable
241		}
242		request.AccountID, request.VaultID = destination.AccountID, destination.VaultID
243		return Plan{Destination: destination, Version: version, Title: request.Title, Experimental: request.Experimental, state: &planState{service: s, request: request, dest: destination, version: version, operation: hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:])}}, nil
244	}
245	
246	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan) (Result, error) {
247		result := Result{Status: StatusNotStarted}
248		if s == nil || plan.state == nil || plan.state.service != s || plan.Destination != plan.state.dest || plan.Version != plan.state.version || plan.Title != plan.state.request.Title || plan.Experimental != plan.state.request.Experimental {
249			return result, ErrStale
250		}
251		s.mu.Lock()
252		defer s.mu.Unlock()
253		state := plan.state
254		if state.attempted {
255			return result, ErrPlanUsed
256		}
257		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
258			return result, err
259		}
260		destination, version, err := s.observe(ctx, state.request)
261		if err != nil {
262			return result, err
263		}
264		if destination != state.dest || version != state.version {
265			return result, ErrStale
266		}
267		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
268			return result, err
269		}
270		// No retry can be authorized after the mutating command is attempted, even
271		// if its response is lost or the native provider reports an error.
272		if state.dest.Provider == Bitwarden {
273			result, err = s.createBitwarden(ctx, state)
274		} else {
275			state.attempted = true
276			result, err = s.createOnePassword(ctx, state)
277		}
278		if result.Status != StatusCreated {
279			return result, err
280		}
281		current, currentVersion, observationErr := s.observe(ctx, state.request)
282		if observationErr != nil || current != state.dest || currentVersion != state.version {
283			result.BindingStatus = BindingUnknown
284			return result, ErrUnknown
285		}
286		result.BindingStatus = BindingVerified
287		return result, err
288	}

28	func (field *bwResponseField) UnmarshalJSON(body []byte) error {

50	func (s *Service) createBitwarden(ctx context.Context, state *planState) (Result, error) {
51		result := Result{Status: StatusNotStarted}
52		input, publicLine, fingerprint, err := bitwardenInput(state)
53		defer sshcredential.Wipe(input)
54		if err != nil {
55			return result, err
56		}
57		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
58			return result, err
59		}
60		state.attempted = true
61		result.Status, result.BindingStatus = StatusUnknown, BindingUnknown
62		body, err := s.run(ctx, "bw", []string{"create", "item"}, input)
63		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
64		if err != nil {
65			return result, ErrUnknown
66		}
67		// The type-5 response may contain the entire private key. It stays in the
68		// bounded response buffer and is deliberately absent from this decoder.
69		var item struct {
70			ID             string            `json:"id"`
71			Type           int               `json:"type"`
72			Name           string            `json:"name"`
73			OrganizationID *string           `json:"organizationId"`
74			CollectionIDs  []string          `json:"collectionIds"`
75			Fields         []bwResponseField `json:"fields"`
76			SSHKey         struct {
77				PublicKey      string `json:"publicKey"`
78				KeyFingerprint string `json:"keyFingerprint"`
79			} `json:"sshKey"`
80		}
81		if json.Unmarshal(body, &item) != nil || !bwIDPattern.MatchString(item.ID) || item.Type != 5 || item.Name != state.request.Title || item.OrganizationID != nil && *item.OrganizationID != "" || len(item.CollectionIDs) != 0 || !ownedBitwardenFields(item.Fields, state.operation) {
82			return result, ErrUnknown
83		}
84		// A matching operation marker identifies the created item even if its
85		// public-key receipt is incomplete. Keep the exact ID for reconciliation.
86		result.Status = StatusCreated
87		result.Receipt = &Receipt{Destination: state.dest, ItemID: item.ID}
88		actualLine, actualFingerprint, err := publicIdentity(item.SSHKey.PublicKey)
89		if err != nil || actualLine != publicLine || actualFingerprint != fingerprint || item.SSHKey.KeyFingerprint != fingerprint {
90			return result, ErrPublicKey
91		}
92		result.Receipt.PublicLine, result.Receipt.Fingerprint = publicLine, fingerprint
93		return result, nil
94	}

96	func ownedBitwardenFields(fields []bwResponseField, operation string) bool {
97		if len(fields) != 2 {
98			return false
99		}
100		owner, exactOperation := false, false
101		for _, field := range fields {
102			if field.Type != 0 {
103				return false
104			}
105			switch field.Name {
106			case "dev-owner":
107				if owner || field.Value != vaultKeyOwner {
108					return false
109				}
110				owner = true
111			case "dev-operation":
112				if exactOperation || field.Value != operation {
113					return false
114				}
115				exactOperation = true
116			default:
117				return false
118			}
119		}
120		return owner && exactOperation
121	}

123	// bitwardenInput owns all directly accessible secret buffers and wipes them on
124	// return. The remaining encoded stdin is also secret and its caller must wipe it.
125	// Go/crypto/PEM implementations and the OS can retain additional copies; this is
126	// best-effort cleanup, not a no-swap, no-core-dump or complete-erasure guarantee.
127	func bitwardenInput(state *planState) ([]byte, string, string, error) {
128		public, private, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, "", "", ErrUnavailable
131		}
132		defer sshcredential.Wipe(private)
133		key, err := ssh.NewPublicKey(public)
134		if err != nil {
135			return nil, "", "", ErrUnavailable
136		}
137		block, err := ssh.MarshalPrivateKey(private, state.request.Title)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, "", "", ErrUnavailable
140		}
141		defer sshcredential.Wipe(block.Bytes)
142		privatePEM := pem.EncodeToMemory(block)
143		defer sshcredential.Wipe(privatePEM)
144		publicLine := strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(key)))
145		fingerprint := ssh.FingerprintSHA256(key)
146		metadata := struct {
147			Type           int       `json:"type"`
148			Name           string    `json:"name"`
149			Login          any       `json:"login"`
150			OrganizationID any       `json:"organizationId"`
151			CollectionIDs  []string  `json:"collectionIds"`
152			Fields         []bwField `json:"fields"`
153		}{Type: 5, Name: state.request.Title, CollectionIDs: []string{}, Fields: []bwField{{Name: "dev-owner", Value: vaultKeyOwner}, {Name: "dev-operation", Value: state.operation}}}
154		prefix, err := json.Marshal(metadata)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, "", "", ErrUnsafe
157		}
158		publicJSON, _ := json.Marshal(publicLine)
159		fingerprintJSON, _ := json.Marshal(fingerprint)
160		// Do not convert private PEM to a Go string or feed it to encoding/json's
161		// pooled buffers. Only the public metadata above uses json.Marshal.
162		body := make([]byte, 0, len(prefix)+2*len(privatePEM)+len(publicJSON)+len(fingerprintJSON)+128)
163		body = append(body, prefix[:len(prefix)-1]...)
164		body = append(body, `,"sshKey":{"privateKey":`...)
165		body = appendPEMString(body, privatePEM)
166		body = append(body, `,"publicKey":`...)
167		body = append(body, publicJSON...)
168		body = append(body, `,"keyFingerprint":`...)
169		body = append(body, fingerprintJSON...)
170		body = append(body, '}', '}')
171		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
172		encoded := make([]byte, base64.StdEncoding.EncodedLen(len(body)))
173		base64.StdEncoding.Encode(encoded, body)
174		return encoded, publicLine, fingerprint, nil
175	}
176	
177	// PEM is ASCII. Append its JSON representation directly so every secret buffer
178	// remains mutable and can receive best-effort cleanup.
179	func appendPEMString(destination, value []byte) []byte {
180		const hexDigits = "0123456789abcdef"
181		destination = append(destination, '"')
182		for _, b := range value {
183			switch b {
184			case '"', '\\':
185				destination = append(destination, '\\', b)
186			case '\n':
187				destination = append(destination, '\\', 'n')
188			case '\r':
189				destination = append(destination, '\\', 'r')
190			default:
191				if b < 0x20 {
192					destination = append(destination, '\\', 'u', '0', '0', hexDigits[b>>4], hexDigits[b&15])
193				} else {
194					destination = append(destination, b)
195				}
196			}
197		}
198		return append(destination, '"')
199	}

13	func (s *Service) createOnePassword(ctx context.Context, state *planState) (Result, error) {
14		result := Result{Status: StatusUnknown, BindingStatus: BindingUnknown}
15		args := []string{"item", "create", "--category", "ssh", "--title", state.request.Title, "--vault", state.dest.VaultID, "--account", state.dest.AccountID, "--format", "json"}
16		body, err := s.run(ctx, "op", args, nil)
17		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
18		if err != nil {
19			return result, ErrUnknown
20		}
21		// item create can return private fields. Do not decode them or retain its
22		// complete item; the public key is fetched separately by the returned ID.
23		var item struct {
24			ID       string `json:"id"`
25			Title    string `json:"title"`
26			Category string `json:"category"`
27			Vault    struct {
28				ID string `json:"id"`
29			} `json:"vault"`
30		}
31		if json.Unmarshal(body, &item) != nil || !opIDPattern.MatchString(item.ID) || item.Title != state.request.Title || item.Category != "SSH_KEY" || item.Vault.ID != state.dest.VaultID {
32			return result, ErrUnknown
33		}
34		result.Status = StatusCreated
35		result.Receipt = &Receipt{Destination: state.dest, ItemID: item.ID}
36		if ctx.Err() != nil {
37			return result, ErrPublicKey
38		}
39		publicBody, err := s.run(ctx, "op", []string{"item", "get", item.ID, "--vault", state.dest.VaultID, "--account", state.dest.AccountID, "--fields", "label=public key", "--format", "json"}, nil)
40		defer sshcredential.Wipe(publicBody)
41		if err != nil {
42			return result, ErrPublicKey
43		}
44		var field struct {
45			ID   string `json:"id"`
46			Type string `json:"type"`
47		}
48		selected := bytes.TrimSpace(publicBody)
49		if len(selected) > 0 && selected[0] == '[' {
50			// The CLI's selected-fields JSON may be a one-element array. Do not
51			// accept multiple fields or fall back to reading the whole item.
52			var fields []json.RawMessage
53			if json.Unmarshal(selected, &fields) != nil {
54				return result, ErrPublicKey
55			}
56			defer func() {
57				for _, raw := range fields {
58					sshcredential.Wipe(raw)
59				}
60			}()
61			if len(fields) != 1 {
62				return result, ErrPublicKey
63			}
64			selected = fields[0]
65		}
66		if json.Unmarshal(selected, &field) != nil || field.ID != "public_key" || field.Type != "STRING" {
67			return result, ErrPublicKey
68		}
69		var public struct {
70			Value string `json:"value"`
71		}
72		if json.Unmarshal(selected, &public) != nil {
73			return result, ErrPublicKey
74		}
75		line, fingerprint, err := publicIdentity(public.Value)
76		if err != nil {
77			return result, ErrPublicKey
78		}
79		result.Receipt.PublicLine, result.Receipt.Fingerprint = line, fingerprint
80		return result, nil
81	}
82	
83	func publicIdentity(line string) (string, string, error) {
84		if len(line) > 4096 {
85			return "", "", ErrPublicKey
86		}
87		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
88		if strings.ContainsAny(line, "\r\n\x00") {
89			return "", "", ErrPublicKey
90		}
91		key, _, options, rest, err := ssh.ParseAuthorizedKey([]byte(line + "\n"))
92		if err != nil || len(options) != 0 || len(bytes.TrimSpace(rest)) != 0 || key.Type() != ssh.KeyAlgoED25519 {
93			return "", "", ErrPublicKey
94		}
95		// Provider comments are not identity and are not needed in a public-only
96		// receipt. Return only the canonical algorithm and public blob.
97		return strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(key))), ssh.FingerprintSHA256(key), nil
98	}

```text
1	# SSH vault key creation boundary
2	
3	This package is the domain adapter, not CLI/TUI integration or an SSH agent.
4	`Plan` explicitly reads native provider metadata; `Apply` consumes a service-bound,
5	immutable, single-attempt plan. The caller reviews the destination and confirms
6	creation before Apply. Deserialized plans carry no authority.
7	
8	- **1Password:** native `op item create --category ssh` generates the default
9	  Ed25519 identity. Account/user/server/exact vault ID and CLI version are bound
10	  and revalidated. The returned item ID, title, category and vault must match;
11	  public material is fetched by that exact ID with a public-field selector.
12	  Private response fields are ignored, not returned or logged.
13	- **Bitwarden:** explicit experimental approval permits in-memory Ed25519
14	  generation and type-5 creation through base64 stdin. No private key file is
15	  written by this package. Owned buffers receive best-effort cleanup, not a
16	  promise about Go runtime copies, process dumps or OS swap. The schema is pinned
17	  to CLI `2026.3.0`, personal-vault-only, with a unique operation marker. Existing
18	  local keys are never imported or deleted.
19	- **Cloud Bitwarden is not supported by this writer yet.** Both US and EU cloud
20	  environments in the pinned CLI expose `serverUrl: null`. `bw config server`
21	  returns the same fallback for both; its API/identity/web-vault flags enter the
22	  mutation path. There is no verified read-only region query. This package
23	  returns `ErrUnsupportedContext` instead of guessing a region, modifying config,
24	  or reading private native storage. Desktop creation plus named-agent selection
25	  is the appropriate handoff for such contexts.
26	- **No live-vault verification has been performed.** Fake tests verify the
27	  implementation and failure boundaries, not native provider behavior. The
28	  experimental Bitwarden schema was inspected at the immutable upstream commit
29	  below, not exercised against a user's unlocked vault.
30	
31	`Result.Status == "created"` never asserts that a provider's SSH agent serves the
32	key. Public lookup may be incomplete (`ErrPublicKey`), or a post-write context
33	check may be uncertain (`ErrUnknown`, `BindingStatus == "unknown"`); the known
34	item receipt remains in the result. An ambiguous creation has `Status ==
35	"unknown"`. In either case, never automatically retry. There is no rollback,
36	delete, import, login/unlock, agent-configuration, or key-revocation API.
37	
38	The `Receipt.Destination` is the reviewed destination intent. Treat it as verified
39	only when `BindingStatus == "verified"`. Native tools, independent changes to
40	native configuration, and remote services remain outside dev's locks; pre/post
41	checks cannot make external provider operations transactional.
42

1374		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "SSH setup plan for %s (%s)\n", document.Alias, document.AliasClass)
1375		if document.KeyPlan != nil {
1376			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  key:       %s %s\n", document.KeyPlan.Action, document.KeyPlan.Operation)
1377			if document.KeyPlan.CreateParent != "" {
1378				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  key dir:   create %s (mode 0700)\n", document.KeyPlan.CreateParent)
1379			}
1380		}
1381		if plan := document.AgentPublicPlan; plan != nil && plan.Agent != nil {
1382			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  agent:     %s %s\n", sshhost.AgentProviderLabel(plan.Agent.Provider), plan.Agent.Socket)
1383			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  agent key: %s public key %s\n", plan.Action, config.Contract(plan.PublicPath))
1384		}
1385		if document.ManagedPlan != nil {
1386			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  config:    %s %s\n", document.ManagedPlan.Action, config.Contract(document.ManagedPlan.Path))
1387		} else if document.AliasClass == "foreign" {
1388			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  config:    preserve foreign definition")
1389		} else {
1390			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  config:    blocked")
1391		}
1392		if document.Fleet.Requested {
1393			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  fleet:     %s %s\n", document.Fleet.Action, config.Contract(document.Fleet.Path))
1394		}
1395		if document.DryRun {
1396			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  remote:    unknown (dry-run never connects to hosts or runs installers)")
1397		}
1398	}
1399	
1400	func finishSSHSetup(app *App, jsonOut bool, document sshSetupDocument, err error) error {
1401		if jsonOut {
1402			if encodeErr := writeSSHJSON(app, document); encodeErr != nil {
1403				return encodeErr
1404			}
1405		} else if document.DryRun || document.Status == "planning" || document.Status == "planned" || document.Status == "confirmation_required" || document.Status == "blocked" {
1406			renderSSHSetupPlan(app, document)
1407			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  status:    %s\n", document.Status)
1408		} else {
1409			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "SSH setup %s: %s\n", document.Status, document.Alias)
1410			if key := document.AgentPublicResult; key != nil {
1411				if key.PublicationUnknown {
1412					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  public key publication unknown: inspect %s before retrying; no rollback is implied.\n", key.Candidate.PublicPath)
1413				} else if key.Created || key.Retained {
1414					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  public key retained: %s\n", key.Candidate.PublicPath)
1415				}
1416			}
1417			if document.BootstrapResult != nil {
1418				for _, hop := range document.BootstrapResult.Hops {
1419					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %-20s %-24s %s\n", hop.Alias, hop.Status, hop.Code)
1420				}
1421			}
1422			if document.Fleet.Requested {
1423				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  fleet: %s (%s)\n", document.Fleet.Action, config.Contract(document.Fleet.Path))
1424			}
1425		}
1426		return err
1427	}
1428	
1429	func setupFailureStatus(document sshSetupDocument) string {
1430		if document.KeyResult != nil || document.AgentPublicResult != nil || document.ManagedResult != nil || document.BootstrapResult != nil {
1431			return "partial"
1432		}
1433		return "failed"
1434	}

43	func (runner *scriptedRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
44		runner.t.Helper()
45		if runner.calls >= len(runner.steps) {
46			runner.t.Fatal("unexpected provider command")
47		}
48		step := runner.steps[runner.calls]
49		runner.calls++
50		if name != step.name || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, step.args) {
51			runner.t.Fatalf("provider command metadata mismatch at step %d", runner.calls)
52		}
53		for _, arg := range args {
54			if strings.Contains(arg, privateSentinel) || strings.Contains(arg, sessionSentinel) || strings.Contains(arg, "PRIVATE KEY") {
55				runner.t.Fatal("secret in provider argv")
56			}
57		}
58		if len(input) > 0 {
59			runner.inputs = append(runner.inputs, input)
60			if name != "bw" || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, []string{"create", "item"}) {
61				runner.t.Fatal("unexpected stdin")
62			}
63		}
64		var body []byte
65		var err error
66		if step.run != nil {
67			body, err = step.run(ctx, input)
68		} else if text, ok := step.body.(string); ok {
69			body = []byte(text)
70		} else {
71			body, err = json.Marshal(step.body)
72		}
73		runner.outputs = append(runner.outputs, body)
74		return body, err
75	}
76	
77	func (runner *scriptedRunner) verify(t *testing.T) {
78		t.Helper()
79		if runner.calls != len(runner.steps) {
80			t.Fatalf("provider calls = %d, want %d", runner.calls, len(runner.steps))
81		}
82		for _, bodies := range [][][]byte{runner.outputs, runner.inputs} {
83			for _, body := range bodies {
84				for _, b := range body {
85					if b != 0 {
86						t.Fatal("provider response or secret stdin was not wiped")
87					}
88				}
89			}
90		}
91	}

16	type CommandRunner interface {
17		Run(context.Context, string, []string, []byte) ([]byte, error)
18	}
19	type NativeRunner struct{}
20	
21	func (NativeRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, stdin []byte) ([]byte, error) {
22		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
23		defer cancel()
24		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
25		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(stdin)
26		var out limitedOutput
27		out.limit = 1 << 20
28		cmd.Stdout = &out
29		cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
30		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
31			Wipe(out.data)
32			return nil, ErrUnavailable
33		}
34		if out.exceeded {
35			Wipe(out.data)
36			return nil, ErrUnavailable
37		}
38		return out.data, nil
39	}
40	
41	type limitedOutput struct {
42		data     []byte
43		limit    int
44		exceeded bool
45	}
46	
47	func (b *limitedOutput) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
48		n := len(p)
49		room := b.limit - len(b.data)
50		if len(p) > room {
51			b.exceeded = true
52			p = p[:max(0, room)]
53		}
54		b.data = append(b.data, p...)
55		return n, nil
56	}
57	
58	type Bitwarden struct{ Runner CommandRunner }

```text
### Read-only `config server`

The command returns the current base URL only when:

- The supplied URL is null or blank.
- None of `--webVault`, `--api`, `--identity`, `--icons`, `--notifications`, or `--events` is set.

The relevant condition is:

```ts
(url == null || url.trim() === "") && !options.webVault && !options.api
```

It reads `environment$` and returns `env.getUrls().base`; if no base exists, it returns `https://bitwarden.com`.

### Setting endpoint options

When changing configuration, the command passes the base URL and each endpoint override independently:

```ts
base: url,
api: options.api || null,
identity: options.identity || null,
webVault: options.webVault || null,
```

It also independently passes `icons`, `notifications`, `events`, and `keyConnector`.

### Can base URL be A while API points to B?

Yes, based on this code. `base` and `api` are separate properties in the object supplied to `setEnvironment`. Therefore, a command can provide base URL A and `--api` value B. The shown code does not validate that the endpoint overrides share the base URL or domain.
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
Relevant source:

```ts
getApiUrl() { return this.getUrl("api", "/api"); }
getIdentityUrl() { return this.getUrl("identity", "/identity"); }
```

`getUrl()` resolves each field independently:

1. An explicit `urls.api` or `urls.identity` is returned unchanged.
2. If absent, `urls.base` receives `/api` or `/identity`.
3. If neither exists, the default region URL is used.

Therefore, `urls.base` can remain one origin while `getApiUrl()` and `getIdentityUrl()` use different explicit origins. Custom configuration does not rewrite or derive `base` from those overrides. `getUrls()` reports `base` and each URL field independently.
```

117	## Existing keys and generation
118	
119	```bash
120	# Create only a local managed alias.
121	dev ssh setup lab --hostname 192.0.2.20 --user dev --config-only
122	
123	# Bootstrap with an existing identity or public file.
124	dev ssh setup lab --key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 --target-os posix
125	
126	# Generate an Ed25519 pair at the default ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_dev path.
127	dev ssh setup lab --generate-key --target-os posix
128	
129	# A fully specified noninteractive generation.
130	dev ssh setup winlab --hostname 198.51.100.30 \
131	  --generate-key --key-path ~/.ssh/id_winlab --no-passphrase \
132	  --target-os windows --yes
133	```
134	
135	`--key` accepts a validated `.pub` record, a private identity with a companion `.pub`, or a security-key stub with a companion `.pub`. If an identity lacks its public companion, dev asks before running `ssh-keygen -y`; `--yes` supplies that local confirmation for a script. Encrypted noninteractive derivation fails with `interaction_required` rather than placing a passphrase in argv or the environment.
136	
137	`--generate-key` invokes native `ssh-keygen` for Ed25519. `--key-path` may name any file under `~/.ssh`, including a subfolder; dev creates one missing folder directly under `~/.ssh` (mode `0700`, shown in the plan), while deeper missing folders must be prepared with `mkdir -m 700`. Paths outside `~/.ssh`, unsupported expansions and names ending in `.pub` are blocked with a named reason. The interactive picker's **+ Generate a new key** asks for the path (a bare name is placed in `~/.ssh`) and an optional comment. Interactive mode delegates hidden passphrase prompts to it. Noninteractive generation requires explicit `--no-passphrase`. Both halves are generated under a private staging basename, matched by fingerprint, hardened, and published with no-replace semantics; any destination collision blocks rather than overwrites. A successfully generated pair is retained after later route/bootstrap/fleet failure and is never removed by `dev ssh remove`.
138	
139	All output is content-safe: fingerprints, algorithms, paths, digests, and booleans may appear; private bytes, passphrases, passwords, complete public-key lines, agent payloads, and unredacted command-like SSH options do not.
140	
141	## ProxyJump and remote operating systems
142	
143	Dev evaluates plain `ssh -G` for the target and each discovered jump, flattens nested/comma-separated `ProxyJump` routes outermost-first, and supports alias, `user@alias`, `alias:port`, and bracketed IPv6 forms. It rejects cycles, repeated hops, unsupported URI/`ProxyCommand` routes, and ambiguous overrides instead of guessing.
144	
145	```bash
146	dev ssh setup lab --key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 --target-os posix \
147	  --hop-os bastion=posix --hop-os winjump=windows
148	```
149	
150	`--target-os` applies to the final target. Use repeatable `--hop-os` for ambiguous jumps; interactive mode asks `Remote OS for <alias> (posix/windows) [posix]` (`p`/`w` are accepted), while noninteractive mode requires every unknown hop to be specified. Each hop is probed with ordinary fresh BatchMode authentication first. A jump that already works is not modified unless `--install-on-working-jump` is explicit.
151	
152	For a POSIX hop, a constant `sh` installer validates/creates `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, applies `0700`/`0600`, and idempotently appends exactly one public record received on stdin. For Windows OpenSSH:
153	
154	- a standard account uses `%USERPROFILE%\.ssh\authorized_keys` with protected current-user + SYSTEM ACLs;
155	- an administrator-group account requires explicit `--windows-admin-authorized-keys` before dev targets `%ProgramData%\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys`, with SYSTEM + BUILTIN\Administrators ACLs;
156	- dev detects group membership, rejects reparse targets, and never automates a UAC/elevation grant. Elevation or a non-default server policy can require manual remediation.

```go
package sshhost

// KeyType selects the native SSH key algorithm. Empty requests retain Ed25519.
type KeyType string

const (
	KeyTypeEd25519   KeyType = "ed25519"
	KeyTypeEd25519SK KeyType = "ed25519-sk"
	KeyTypeECDSASK   KeyType = "ecdsa-sk"
)

// SecurityKeyOptions configure an explicit native FIDO enrollment. They never
// authorize passive hardware enumeration or an alternative authentication method.
type SecurityKeyOptions struct {
	Provider       string `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	Resident       bool   `json:"resident,omitempty"`
	VerifyRequired bool   `json:"verify_required,omitempty"`
	Application    string `json:"application,omitempty"`
}

// SecurityKeyCapability is stat-only. Unknown permits a reviewed interactive
// attempt, not a claim that a token is present or that signing will succeed.
type SecurityKeyCapability struct {
	Status        string       `json:"status"`
	CanAttempt    bool         `json:"can_attempt"`
	Provider      string       `json:"provider"`
	KeygenPath    string       `json:"keygen_path,omitempty"`
	SSHClientPath string       `json:"ssh_client_path,omitempty"`
	Diagnostics   []Diagnostic `json:"diagnostics,omitempty"`
}

// HardwareKeyEffect is separate from local-file creation. A started enrollment
// may have changed a resident authenticator even if it returned no usable stub.
// Recovery paths refer only to independently validated SK stub/public pairs.
type HardwareKeyEffect struct {
	Kind                 string `json:"kind"`
	Status               string `json:"status"`
	Resident             bool   `json:"resident,omitempty"`
	RecoveryIdentityPath string `json:"recovery_identity_path,omitempty"`
	RecoveryPublicPath   string `json:"recovery_public_path,omitempty"`
}

func (t KeyType) securityKey() bool { return t == KeyTypeEd25519SK || t == KeyTypeECDSASK }

func (t KeyType) algorithm() string {
	switch t {
	case KeyTypeEd25519SK:
		return "sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com"
	case KeyTypeECDSASK:
		return "sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com"
	default:
		return "ssh-ed25519"
	}
}

```

package cli

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/sshhost"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/tui"
)

var errSSHFleetImportHardware = errors.New("new hardware-key generation is not supported while importing connection or hop profiles FROM fleet; import configuration first, then run regular dev ssh setup <local-alias> where ownership allows. Registering a regular alias TO fleet with --to fleet|both remains supported")

func sshHardwareKeyType(value string) bool {
	return value == string(sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519SK) || value == string(sshhost.KeyTypeECDSASK)
}

func validateSSHGenerationOptions(options sshSetupOptions) error {
	keyType := options.keyType
	if keyType == "" {
		keyType = string(sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519)
	}
	if keyType != string(sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519) && !sshHardwareKeyType(keyType) {
		return errors.New("--key-type must be ed25519, ed25519-sk or ecdsa-sk")
	}
	hasSecurityOptions := options.securityKeyFlagsChanged || options.securityKey != (sshhost.SecurityKeyOptions{})
	if !options.generateKey && (options.keyGenerationFlagsChanged || keyType != string(sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519) || hasSecurityOptions) {
		return errors.New("--key-type and --sk-* options require explicit --generate-key")
	}
	if hasSecurityOptions && !sshHardwareKeyType(keyType) {
		return errors.New("--sk-* options require --key-type ed25519-sk or ecdsa-sk; ordinary Ed25519 generation is never a hardware fallback")
	}
	if !options.generateKey || !sshHardwareKeyType(keyType) {
		return nil
	}
	if options.configOnly || options.auth != "" || options.hasExistingKey() || options.identityAgent != "" || options.agentRef != nil {
		return errors.New("security-key generation cannot be combined with existing-key, agent, --auth or --config-only selection")
	}
	if options.identityFileChanged || options.identitiesOnlyChanged && !options.identitiesOnly {
		return errors.New("hardware-key generation supplies its reviewed IdentityFile and IdentitiesOnly=yes; do not override either with incompatible connection flags")
	}
	if options.fleetImportKeyPicker || strings.HasPrefix(options.from, "fleet:") || strings.HasPrefix(options.from, "fleet-ssh:") {
		return errSSHFleetImportHardware
	}
	return nil
}

func clearSSHGeneratedKeyOptions(options *sshSetupOptions) {
	options.keyType, options.comment = "", ""
	options.securityKey = sshhost.SecurityKeyOptions{}
	options.keyGenerationFlagsChanged, options.securityKeyFlagsChanged = false, false
	options.noPassphrase = false
}

func promptSSHSecurityKeyOptions(prompt *prompter, options *sshSetupOptions) error {
	var err error
	options.keyType, err = prompt.choiceOf("Security key type", string(sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519SK), []string{"ed25519-sk", "ecdsa-sk"}, map[string]string{"ed25519-sk": "ed25519-sk", "ecdsa-sk": "ecdsa-sk"})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	options.securityKey.Provider, err = prompt.line("SecurityKeyProvider (internal or absolute library path)", "internal")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	resident, err := prompt.choiceOf("Resident credential (may remain on the device after cancellation)", "no", []string{"no", "yes"}, map[string]string{"no": "no", "n": "no", "yes": "yes", "y": "yes"})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	verify, err := prompt.choiceOf("Require user verification for signing", "no", []string{"no", "yes"}, map[string]string{"no": "no", "n": "no", "yes": "yes", "y": "yes", "y": "yes"})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	options.securityKey.Resident, options.securityKey.VerifyRequired = resident == "yes", verify == "yes"
	options.securityKey.Application, err = prompt.line("Application (ssh: label; blank uses the native default)", "")
	return err
}

// sshSecurityKeyChoices uses only service-owned stat observations. It never
// probes hardware, runs a provider or claims signing capability was proved.
func sshSecurityKeyChoices(ctx context.Context, service *sshhost.Service, alias string, importPicker bool) ([]tui.SSHKeyChoice, error) {
	observation, err := service.ObserveSecurityKeyCapability(ctx, "internal")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	description := "Hardware signing key; native PIN/touch required. Capability is unverified until an explicit attempt."
	reason := ""
	if !observation.CanAttempt {
		reason = "Security-key generation is unavailable with the current OpenSSH tools."
		for _, diagnostic := range observation.Diagnostics {
			if diagnostic.Message != "" {
				reason += " " + diagnostic.Message
			}
		}
	}
	if importPicker {
		reason = errSSHFleetImportHardware.Error()
	}
	choice := tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: "+ Generate on a security key (YubiKey / FIDO2)", Description: description, Path: filepath.Join(service.Paths().SSHDir, "id_ed25519_sk_dev_"+alias), Generate: true, KeyType: sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519SK, UnavailableReason: reason}
	if reason != "" {
		choice.Description = reason
	}
	choices := []tui.SSHKeyChoice{choice}
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		reason := "Automatic Apple Secure Enclave creation is unavailable: create a key with Secretive and select its agent, or select an existing security-key stub. Dev will not run sc_auth or download resident keys during discovery."
		choices = append(choices, tui.SSHKeyChoice{Label: "Apple Secure Enclave generation (unavailable)", Description: reason, UnavailableReason: reason})
	}
	return choices, nil
}

func prepareSSHSecurityKeyConfig(ctx context.Context, service *sshhost.Service, alias, class string, options sshSetupOptions, plan sshhost.KeyPlan, definition *sshhost.ManagedDefinition) error {
	if !sshHardwareKeyType(string(plan.KeyType)) || plan.Operation != sshhost.KeyGenerate {
		return nil
	}
	if err := validateSSHGenerationOptions(options); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if class == "foreign" {
		if options.dryRun {
			return fmt.Errorf("foreign alias %s requires a fresh SecurityKeyProvider policy check before hardware generation; dry-run never evaluates its native configuration: %w", alias, sshhost.ErrManualRemediation)
		}
		if err := service.VerifySecurityKeyPolicy(ctx, alias, plan); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("foreign alias %s is not rewritten; configure its matching SecurityKeyProvider and reviewed identity before retrying: %w", alias, err)
		}
		return nil
	}
	definition.IdentityFile, definition.SecurityKeyProvider = plan.IdentityFile, plan.SecurityKeyProvider
	only := true
	definition.IdentitiesOnly = &only
	return nil
}

func sshHardwarePlanNotes(plan sshhost.KeyPlan) []string {
	if plan.Operation != sshhost.KeyGenerate || !sshHardwareKeyType(string(plan.KeyType)) {
		return nil
	}
	notes := []string{
		"Hardware key type: " + string(plan.KeyType),
		"Local key handle: " + plan.IdentityFile + " (not an exportable private signing key).",
		"Public key: " + plan.PublicPath,
		"ssh-keygen: " + plan.KeygenPath,
		"SSH client: " + plan.SSHClientPath,
		"Managed SSH v2 SecurityKeyProvider: " + plan.SecurityKeyProvider,
		fmt.Sprintf("Resident credential: %t; verification required: %t; application: %s", plan.SecurityKey.Resident, plan.SecurityKey.VerifyRequired, plan.SecurityKey.Application),
		"Native PIN/touch interaction is required; no downgrade or unattended fallback is attempted.",
		"Hardware credentials may remain after cancellation or local failure; dev never claims hardware rollback or retries creation automatically.",
	}
	if plan.CreateParent != "" {
		notes = append(notes, "Create key directory "+plan.CreateParent+" (mode 0700).")
	}
	for _, diagnostic := range plan.Diagnostics {
		if diagnostic.Message != "" {
			notes = append(notes, diagnostic.Message)
		}
	}
	return notes
}

func sshHardwareResultNotes(result sshhost.KeyResult) []string {
	if result.Hardware == nil {
		return nil
	}
	effect := result.Hardware
	notes := []string{fmt.Sprintf("Hardware key %s: %s (resident=%t); no hardware rollback is implied.", effect.Kind, effect.Status, effect.Resident)}
	if effect.RecoveryIdentityPath != "" {
		notes = append(notes, "Retained key handle: "+effect.RecoveryIdentityPath)
	}
	if effect.RecoveryPublicPath != "" {
		notes = append(notes, "Retained public key: "+effect.RecoveryPublicPath)
	}
	if effect.Status == "unknown" {
		notes = append(notes, "Inspect the device and retained paths before another creation attempt; do not retry automatically.")
	}
	return notes
}

package sshhost

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

type securityKeyFile struct {
	requested string
	resolved string
	info fs.FileInfo
}

type securityKeyState struct {
	keygen securityKeyFile
	client securityKeyFile
	provider *securityKeyFile
	options SecurityKeyOptions
	mu sync.Mutex
	attempted bool
	receipt KeyResult
}

// ObserveSecurityKeyCapability performs only path/stat checks. It never invokes
// ssh, ssh-keygen, sc_auth, a provider library, or an authenticator.
func (s *Service) ObserveSecurityKeyCapability(ctx context.Context, provider string) (SecurityKeyCapability, error) {
	observation, _, err := s.observeSecurityKeyCapability(ctx, provider)
	return observation, err
}

func (s *Service) observeSecurityKeyCapability(ctx context.Context, provider string) (SecurityKeyCapability, *securityKeyState, error) {
	if ctx == nil { ctx = context.Background() }
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return SecurityKeyCapability{}, nil, err }
	if provider == "" { provider = "internal" }
	observation := SecurityKeyCapability{Status: "unavailable", Provider: provider}
	blocked := func(code, message string) (SecurityKeyCapability, *securityKeyState, error) {
		observation.Diagnostics = []Diagnostic{{Code: code, Message: message, BlocksMutation: true}}
		return observation, nil, nil
	}
	if provider == "apple-secure-enclave" {
		observation.Status = "unsupported"
		return blocked("secure_enclave_generation_unverified", "Automatic Apple Secure Enclave enrollment is experimental and unverified; use Secretive or an existing security-key stub. dev will not run sc_auth or enumerate resident keys.")
	}
	if provider != "internal" {
		if err := ValidateAgentSocketPath(provider); err != nil {
			return blocked("security_key_provider_unsafe", "SecurityKeyProvider must be internal or a safe absolute library path.")
		}
	}
	lookup := s.securityKeyLookPath
	if lookup == nil { lookup = exec.LookPath }
	state := &securityKeyState{}
	for _, tool := range []struct{name string; target *securityKeyFile; public *string}{
		{"ssh-keygen", &state.keygen, &observation.KeygenPath},
		{"ssh", &state.client, &observation.SSHClientPath},
	} {
		path, err := lookup(tool.name)
		if err != nil { return blocked("security_key_tool_unavailable", "A safe "+tool.name+" executable is required for hardware generation and subsequent native SSH authentication.") }
		file, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(path, true)
		if err != nil { return blocked("security_key_tool_unsafe", "The selected "+tool.name+" executable failed local path/metadata checks.") }
		*tool.target, *tool.public = file, file.resolved
	}
	if provider != "internal" {
		file, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(provider, false)
		if err != nil { return blocked("security_key_provider_unsafe", "The selected security-key provider library failed local path/metadata checks.") }
		state.provider = &file
		provider, observation.Provider = file.resolved, file.resolved
	}
	goos := s.securityKeyGOOS
	if goos == "" { goos = runtime.GOOS }
	if goos == "darwin" && provider == "internal" && (state.keygen.resolved == "/usr/bin/ssh-keygen" || state.client.resolved == "/usr/bin/ssh") {
		observation.Status = "unsupported"
		return blocked("ssh_client_lacks_fido", "Apple's stock internal OpenSSH provider lacks USB FIDO support. Select compatible ssh and ssh-keygen tools together; dev does not install or switch them automatically.")
	}
	observation.Status, observation.CanAttempt = "unknown", true
	observation.Diagnostics = []Diagnostic{{Code: "security_key_support_unknown", Message: "Tool and provider files are present, but compiled FIDO support and hardware availability are unknown. An explicitly reviewed interactive attempt may create a resident hardware credential even if later validation fails."}}
	state.options.Provider = provider
	return observation, state, nil
}

func (s *Service) inspectSecurityKeyFile(path string, executable bool) (securityKeyFile, error) {
	if path == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(path) || !validUTF8NoControl(path) { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath }
	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
	if err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
	info, err := os.Lstat(resolved)
	if err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath }
	if s.securityKeyToolCheck != nil {
		if err := s.securityKeyToolCheck(resolved, info); err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
	} else {
		if runtime.GOOS == "windows" { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrManualRemediation }
		if err := platformAgentDirectory(resolved, info); err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
		if executable && info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath }
	}
	return securityKeyFile{requested: filepath.Clean(path), resolved: resolved, info: info}, nil
}

func (s *Service) revalidateSecurityKeyState(state *securityKeyState) error {
	if state == nil { return nil }
	lookup := s.securityKeyLookPath
	if lookup == nil { lookup = exec.LookPath }
	for _, tool := range []struct{name string; file securityKeyFile}{{"ssh-keygen", state.keygen}, {"ssh", state.client}} {
		path, err := lookup(tool.name)
		if err != nil || filepath.Clean(path) != tool.file.requested { return fmt.Errorf("selected %s changed: %w", tool.name, ErrSourceChanged) }
		current, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(path, true)
		if err != nil || current.resolved != tool.file.resolved || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(current.info, tool.file.info) { return fmt.Errorf("selected %s changed: %w", tool.name, ErrSourceChanged) }
	}
	if state.provider != nil {
		current, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(state.provider.requested, false)
		if err != nil || current.resolved != state.provider.resolved || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(current.info, state.provider.info) { return fmt.Errorf("selected security-key provider changed: %w", ErrSourceChanged) }
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeSecurityKeyOptions(options SecurityKeyOptions) (SecurityKeyOptions, error) {
	if options.Provider == "" { options.Provider = "internal" }
	if options.Application == "" { options.Application = "ssh:dev" }
	if !strings.HasPrefix(options.Application, "ssh:") || len(options.Application) < 5 || len(options.Application) > 68 { return options, errors.New("security-key application must be ssh: followed by 1-64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes") }
	for _, c := range options.Application[4:] {
		if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == '-') { return options, errors.New("invalid security-key application") }
	}
	return options, nil
}

// VerifySecurityKeyPolicy checks a foreign alias without changing its provider.
// The plan is service-bound and no native enrollment or login occurs here.
func (s *Service) VerifySecurityKeyPolicy(ctx context.Context, alias string, plan KeyPlan) error {
	if plan.state == nil || plan.state.serviceID != s.id || !equalKeyPlans(plan, plan.state.public) || plan.state.hardware == nil { return ErrBlocked }
	if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(plan.state.hardware); err != nil { return err }
	effective, err := s.Effective(ctx, alias)
	if err != nil { return err }
	if !securityKeyProviderMatches(effective, plan.state.hardware) { return errors.Join(ErrManualRemediation, errors.New("alias SecurityKeyProvider does not match the selected hardware generation provider")) }
	return nil
}

func securityKeyProviderMatches(effective EffectiveConfig, state *securityKeyState) bool {
	provider := firstEffectiveValue(effective, "securitykeyprovider")
	if provider == "" { provider = "internal" }
	return provider == state.options.Provider
}

```

```go
package tui

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/sshhost"
)

func sshHardwareKeyType(value string) bool {
	return value == string(sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519SK) || value == string(sshhost.KeyTypeECDSASK)
}

func sshKeyGenerationForm(parent sshDialog, choice SSHKeyChoice) sshDialog {
	path := choice.Path
	if parent.onboarding.GenerateKey && parent.onboarding.KeyPath != "" {
		path = parent.onboarding.KeyPath
	}
	keyType := choice.KeyType
	if keyType == "" {
		keyType = sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519
	}
	security := parent.onboarding.SecurityKey
	if !sshHardwareKeyType(string(keyType)) {
		security = sshhost.SecurityKeyOptions{}
	} else if security.Provider == "" {
		security.Provider = "internal"
	}
	form := sshDialog{kind: "keygen", title: "Configure the new SSH key", parent: &parent}
	form.addField("path", "New key path", path)
	form.addField("comment", "Comment", parent.onboarding.KeyComment)
	form.addField("keytype", "Key type", string(keyType))
	form.addField("skprovider", "SK provider", security.Provider)
	form.addField("skresident", "Resident", "no")
	if security.Resident {
		form.setField("skresident", "yes")
	}
	form.addField("skverify", "Verify required", "no")
	if security.VerifyRequired {
		form.setField("skverify", "yes")
	}
	form.addField("skapplication", "SK application", security.Application)
	return form
}

func (d *sshDialog) updateSSHKeyTypeFields() {
	if !sshHardwareKeyType(d.value("keytype")) {
		d.setField("skprovider", "")
		d.setField("skresident", "no")
		d.setField("skverify", "no")
		d.setField("skapplication", "")
	} else if d.value("skprovider") == "" {
		d.setField("skprovider", "internal")
	}
}

func sshHardwareResultLines(result sshhost.KeyResult) []string {
	if result.Hardware == nil {
		return nil
	}
	effect := result.Hardware
	lines := []string{fmt.Sprintf("Hardware key %s: %s (resident=%t); no hardware rollback is implied.", effect.Kind, effect.Status, effect.Resident)}
	if effect.RecoveryIdentityPath != "" {
		lines = append(lines, "Retained key handle: "+effect.RecoveryIdentityPath)
	}
	if effect.RecoveryPublicPath != "" {
		lines = append(lines, "Retained public key: "+effect.RecoveryPublicPath)
	}
	if effect.Status == "unknown" {
		lines = append(lines, "Inspect the device and retained paths before another creation attempt; do not retry automatically.")
	}
	return lines
}

Pinned Bitwarden source permits independent API/identity overrides: `base=https://display.example` can coexist with `api=https://actual.example/api`. This service can therefore display and later mark the former destination “verified” while creation uses the latter. Rejecting cloud `null` does not address this self-hosted case.
   Minimal fix: bind verified effective endpoint configuration, or return unsupported-context when that cannot be established. Do not treat the base/display URL as proof of the mutation endpoint.
   Sources: [config command](https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/blob/c20753e4dae029d6155565682dc79718f9aeb426/apps/cli/src/platform/commands/config.command.ts), [endpoint resolution](https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/blob/c20753e4dae029d6155565682dc79718f9aeb426/libs/common/src/platform/services/default-environment.service.ts). Native configuration changes require logout, but pre-existing overrides still demonstrate the binding gap.

2. Medium: A malformed public-key field discards an otherwise identifiable created item.
   `internal/sshvault/bitwarden.go:69–87`
   A valid JSON creation response containing the correct ID/type/title/operation marker but `"sshKey":{"publicKey":123}` makes the combined `json.Unmarshal` fail. The method returns `unknown` with no receipt, losing the exact item ID solely because public-key decoding failed. Missing/string-invalid public data correctly retains the receipt; wrong JSON types do not.
   Minimal fix: validate creation metadata/ownership first, retain the receipt, then decode public fields separately. Public-field decoding failures should return the retained created-item receipt with `ErrPublicKey`. Add malformed-type cases for both public fields.

3. Low: Invalid UTF-8 titles pass validation and can cause a mutation followed by an unexplained unknown result.
   `internal/sshvault/service.go:29–38`; `internal/sshvault/bitwarden.go:154,81`
   `validText(string([]byte{0xff}), 256)` passes because ranging the string produces printable U+FFFD. JSON encoding replaces the invalid byte, so Bitwarden receives a different title; the returned normalized title then fails the exact-title check after creation.
   Minimal fix: require `utf8.ValidString(value)` before provider execution and test invalid-byte titles.

Other conclusions:
- Immutable plan fields, service ownership, single-attempt locking, normal-path receipt retention, public-key canonicalization, and explicit buffer cleanup are sound on inspection.
- No direct private/session-byte path into errors, returned JSON, argv, or files was found in this package.
- 1Password’s generation command is documented, but the assumed selected-public-field response schema (`id=public_key`, `type=STRING`, object/single-element array) remains fixture-only rather than native-verified.
- Existing dependency caveat: `sshcredential.NativeRunner` has no process-group termination or `WaitDelay`; wrapper descendants retaining its pipes can outlive the nominal 15-second bound.

No files changed, tests run, or native provider/hardware operations performed.

package sshhost

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func (s *Service) planGeneratedSecurityKey(ctx context.Context, request KeyRequest) (KeyPlan, error) {
	options, err := normalizeSecurityKeyOptions(request.SecurityKey)
	if err != nil { return KeyPlan{}, err }
	observation, hardware, err := s.observeSecurityKeyCapability(ctx, options.Provider)
	if err != nil { return KeyPlan{}, err }
	plan := KeyPlan{Action: ActionBlocked, Operation: KeyGenerate, Source: KeySourceGenerated,
		KeyType: request.Type, Algorithm: request.Type.algorithm(), SecurityKey: options,
		SecurityKeyProvider: observation.Provider, KeygenPath: observation.KeygenPath,
		SSHClientPath: observation.SSHClientPath, Diagnostics: observation.Diagnostics}
	if !observation.CanAttempt { return plan, nil }
	if !request.Type.securityKey() { return KeyPlan{}, errors.New("security-key generation requires ed25519-sk or ecdsa-sk") }
	if !request.Interactive {
		plan.Diagnostics = append(plan.Diagnostics, Diagnostic{Code: "interaction_required", Message: "Security-key generation requires explicit native PIN/touch interaction.", BlocksMutation: true})
		return plan, nil
	}
	options.Provider = observation.Provider
	request.SecurityKey = options
	if request.DestinationIdentity == "" { request.DestinationIdentity = filepath.Join(s.paths.SSHDir, "id_"+strings.ReplaceAll(string(request.Type), "-", "_")+"_dev") }
	base, err := s.planGeneratedKey(request)
	if err != nil { return KeyPlan{}, err }
	base.KeyType, base.Algorithm = request.Type, request.Type.algorithm()
	base.SecurityKey, base.SecurityKeyProvider = options, options.Provider
	base.KeygenPath, base.SSHClientPath = observation.KeygenPath, observation.SSHClientPath
	base.Diagnostics = append(base.Diagnostics, observation.Diagnostics...)
	if base.state != nil {
		hardware.options = options
		base.state.hardware = hardware
		base.state.public = cloneKeyPlan(base)
	}
	return base, nil
}

func cloneHardwareReceipt(result KeyResult) KeyResult {
	result.Candidate = cloneKeyCandidate(result.Candidate)
	if result.Hardware != nil { copy := *result.Hardware; result.Hardware = &copy }
	return result
}

func (s *Service) applyGeneratedSecurityKey(ctx context.Context, plan KeyPlan) (result KeyResult, resultErr error) {
	state, hardware := plan.state, plan.state.hardware
	hardware.mu.Lock()
	defer hardware.mu.Unlock()
	if hardware.attempted {
		return cloneHardwareReceipt(hardware.receipt), fmt.Errorf("this hardware enrollment plan was already attempted; review a fresh plan before another enrollment: %w", ErrBlocked)
	}
	result = KeyResult{Action: ActionNoop, Operation: KeyGenerate}
	defer func() { if hardware.attempted { hardware.receipt = cloneHardwareReceipt(result) } }()
	if err := s.RevalidateKeySelection(ctx, plan); err != nil { return result, err }
	parent := filepath.Dir(plan.IdentityFile)
	if parent == s.paths.SSHDir || plan.CreateParent != "" {
		if err := ensurePrivateChild(s.paths.Home, ".ssh", false); err != nil { return result, err }
	}
	if plan.CreateParent != "" {
		if filepath.Dir(plan.CreateParent) != s.paths.SSHDir || !samePath(parent, plan.CreateParent) { return result, ErrUnsafePath }
		if err := ensurePrivateChild(s.paths.SSHDir, filepath.Base(parent), true); err != nil { return result, err }
	}
	if err := s.validateKeyParent(parent); err != nil { return result, err }
	base, err := allocateSecurityKeyStagingBase(parent)
	if err != nil { return result, err }
	var privateStage, publicStage *stagedFile
	validated := false
	defer func() {
		retain := false
		if resultErr != nil && validated {
			identityPath := securityKeyRecoveryPath(privateStage, base, plan.IdentityFile)
			publicPath := securityKeyRecoveryPath(publicStage, base+".pub", plan.PublicPath)
			if identityPath != "" && publicPath != "" {
				result.Hardware.RecoveryIdentityPath, result.Hardware.RecoveryPublicPath = identityPath, publicPath
				result.Retained = true
				retain = true
			}
		}
		for index, stage := range []*stagedFile{privateStage, publicStage} {
			if stage != nil {
				if retain { _ = stage.root.Close(); stage.root = nil } else { discardSecurityKeyStage(stage) }
			} else {
				path := base
				if index == 1 { path += ".pub" }
				// Only the fresh native staging namespace is cleaned. Never recurse
				// or remove a symlink/unverifiable replacement.
				if snapshot, err := readSecureFileIfExists(path, false); err == nil && snapshot.exists { _ = removeSecureFile(snapshot) }
			}
		}
	}()
	args := []string{"-q", "-t", string(plan.KeyType), "-f", base, "-w", hardware.options.Provider, "-O", "application="+hardware.options.Application}
	if hardware.options.Resident { args = append(args, "-O", "resident") }
	if hardware.options.VerifyRequired { args = append(args, "-O", "verify-required") }
	if state.request.Comment != "" { args = append(args, "-C", state.request.Comment) }
	if state.request.NoPassphrase { args = append(args, "-N", "") }
	if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(hardware); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return result, err }
	hardware.attempted = true
	started := func(time.Time) { result.Hardware = &HardwareKeyEffect{Kind: "fido", Status: "unknown", Resident: hardware.options.Resident} }
	run, runErr := s.runner.Run(ctx, RunRequest{Name: hardware.keygen.resolved, Args: args,
		Interactive: true, UnsetEnv: []string{"SSH_SK_PROVIDER"}, Display: "ssh-keygen enroll security key (native PIN/touch)", OnStarted: started})
	if runErr == nil && result.Hardware == nil { started(time.Time{}) }
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return result, err }
	if runErr != nil || run.ExitCode != 0 { return result, errors.New("native security-key enrollment did not complete; inspect hardware state before any new attempt") }
	if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(hardware); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err := s.hardenAndSyncGeneratedFile(base); err != nil { return result, errors.New("generated security-key identity failed local safety checks") }
	if err := s.hardenAndSyncGeneratedFile(base+".pub"); err != nil { return result, errors.New("generated security-key public file failed local safety checks") }
	record, publicIdentity, err := s.readPublicKeySource(base+".pub")
	if err != nil || record.metadata.Algorithm != plan.KeyType.algorithm() { return result, errors.New("native generation did not produce the requested security-key algorithm") }
	identity, err := s.inspectSelectedKeyIdentity(base)
	if err != nil { return result, err }
	derived, err := s.runner.Run(ctx, RunRequest{Name: hardware.keygen.resolved,
		Args: []string{"-y", "-f", base, "-w", hardware.options.Provider}, Interactive: true, CaptureStdout: true,
		UnsetEnv: []string{"SSH_SK_PROVIDER"}, Display: "ssh-keygen validate generated security-key stub"})
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err != nil || derived.ExitCode != 0 || derived.StdoutTruncated { return result, errors.New("native security-key stub validation did not complete") }
	derivedRecord, err := parsePublicKeyRecord(derived.Stdout)
	if err != nil || derivedRecord.metadata.Algorithm != plan.KeyType.algorithm() || derivedRecord.metadata.Fingerprint != record.metadata.Fingerprint { return result, errors.New("generated security-key stub and public key do not match") }
	if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(hardware); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err := s.revalidateSelectedKeyIdentity(identity); err != nil { return result, err }
	privateStage, err = adoptGeneratedStagedFile(base)
	if err != nil { return result, err }
	publicStage, err = adoptGeneratedStagedFile(base+".pub")
	if err != nil { return result, err }
	if !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(identity.info, privateStage.snapshot.info) || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(publicIdentity.info, publicStage.snapshot.info) { return result, ErrSourceChanged }
	validated = true
	result.Hardware.Status = "created"
	if s.beforeKeyCommit != nil { s.beforeKeyCommit() }
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(hardware); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err := s.revalidateSelectedKeyIdentity(identity); err != nil { return result, err }
	if err := publicStage.revalidate(); err != nil { return result, err }
	published, err := commitNoReplaceObserved(privateStage, plan.IdentityFile, state.expectedPrivate)
	if err != nil {
		result.PublicationUnknown = published
		return result, fmt.Errorf("publish security-key identity: %w", err)
	}
	result.Action, result.Created, result.Retained = ActionCreate, true, true
	published, err = commitNoReplaceObserved(publicStage, plan.PublicPath, state.expectedPublic)
	if err != nil { result.PublicationUnknown = published; return result, fmt.Errorf("publish security-key public file: %w", err) }
	publishedIdentity, err := s.inspectSelectedKeyIdentity(plan.IdentityFile)
	if err != nil { result.PublicationUnknown = true; return result, err }
	candidate := s.bindVerifiedKeyMaterial(KeyCandidate{Source: KeySourceGenerated, Sources: []KeySource{KeySourceGenerated},
		Algorithm: record.metadata.Algorithm, Comment: record.metadata.Comment, Fingerprint: record.metadata.Fingerprint,
		IdentityFile: plan.IdentityFile, PublicPath: plan.PublicPath, Provenance: KeyProvenance{SecurityKeyStub: true}}, record.normalized,
		&keyPairVerification{identity: publishedIdentity, publicPath: plan.PublicPath, fingerprint: record.metadata.Fingerprint})
	candidate.state.hardware = hardware
	if err := s.revalidateSelectedKeySources(ctx, candidate.state); err != nil { result.PublicationUnknown = true; return result, err }
	result.Candidate = candidate
	return result, nil
}

func allocateSecurityKeyStagingBase(parent string) (string, error) {
	for range 32 {
		path, err := allocateKeyStagingBase(parent)
		if err != nil { return "", err }
		path = filepath.Join(parent, strings.Replace(filepath.Base(path), ".dev-key-", ".dev-sk-recovery-", 1))
		_, privateErr := os.Lstat(path)
		_, publicErr := os.Lstat(path+".pub")
		if errors.Is(privateErr, fs.ErrNotExist) && errors.Is(publicErr, fs.ErrNotExist) { return path, nil }
	}
	return "", errors.New("could not allocate a security-key staging path")
}

func securityKeyRecoveryPath(stage *stagedFile, paths ...string) string {
	if stage == nil || stage.root == nil || verifyHeldDirectory(stage.dir, stage.held, true) != nil { return "" }
	for _, path := range paths {
		current, err := readSecureFile(path, false)
		if err == nil && os.SameFile(stage.snapshot.info, current.info) && current.digest == stage.snapshot.digest { return path }
	}
	return ""
}

func discardSecurityKeyStage(stage *stagedFile) {
	if stage == nil || stage.root == nil { return }
	if _, err := snapshotStillCurrentAt(stage.root, stage.name, stage.snapshot); err == nil { _ = stage.root.Remove(stage.name) }
	_ = stage.root.Close()
	stage.root = nil
}
