88	func (s *Service) inspectSecurityKeyFile(path string, executable bool) (securityKeyFile, error) {
89		if path == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(path) || !validUTF8NoControl(path) { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath }
90		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
91		if err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
92		info, err := os.Lstat(resolved)
93		if err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
94		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath }
95		if s.securityKeyToolCheck != nil {
96			if err := s.securityKeyToolCheck(resolved, info); err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
97		} else {
98			if runtime.GOOS == "windows" { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrManualRemediation }
99			if err := platformAgentDirectory(resolved, info); err != nil { return securityKeyFile{}, err }
100			if executable && info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 { return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath }
101		}
102		return securityKeyFile{requested: filepath.Clean(path), resolved: resolved, info: info}, nil
103	}

122	func normalizeSecurityKeyOptions(options SecurityKeyOptions) (SecurityKeyOptions, error) {
123		if options.Provider == "" { options.Provider = "internal" }
124		if options.Application == "" { options.Application = "ssh:dev" }
125		if !strings.HasPrefix(options.Application, "ssh:") || len(options.Application) < 5 || len(options.Application) > 68 { return options, errors.New("security-key application must be ssh: followed by 1-64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes") }
126		for _, c := range options.Application[4:] {
127			if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == '-') { return options, errors.New("invalid security-key application") }
128		}
129		return options, nil
130	}

243		return Plan{Destination: destination, Version: version, Title: request.Title, Experimental: request.Experimental, state: &planState{service: s, request: request, dest: destination, version: version, operation: hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:])}}, nil

263		}

266		}
267		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {

270		// No retry can be authorized after the mutating command is attempted, even
271		// if its response is lost or the native provider reports an error.

24	// Unknown custom fields might contain secrets. Decode only our two public

28	func (field *bwResponseField) UnmarshalJSON(body []byte) error {
29		var header struct {
30			Name string `json:"name"`
31			Type int    `json:"type"`
32		}
33		if json.Unmarshal(body, &header) != nil {
34			return ErrUnavailable
35		}
36		field.Name, field.Type = header.Name, header.Type

50	func (s *Service) createBitwarden(ctx context.Context, state *planState) (Result, error) {
51		result := Result{Status: StatusNotStarted}
52		input, publicLine, fingerprint, err := bitwardenInput(state)
53		defer sshcredential.Wipe(input)
54		if err != nil {
55			return result, err
56		}
57		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
58			return result, err
59		}
60		state.attempted = true
61		result.Status, result.BindingStatus = StatusUnknown, BindingUnknown
62		body, err := s.run(ctx, "bw", []string{"create", "item"}, input)
63		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
64		if err != nil {
65			return result, ErrUnknown
66		}
67		// The type-5 response may contain the entire private key. It stays in the
68		// bounded response buffer and is deliberately absent from this decoder.
69		var item struct {
70			ID             string            `json:"id"`
71			Type           int               `json:"type"`
72			Name           string            `json:"name"`
73			OrganizationID *string           `json:"organizationId"`
74			CollectionIDs  []string          `json:"collectionIds"`
75			Fields         []bwResponseField `json:"fields"`
76			SSHKey         struct {
77				PublicKey      string `json:"publicKey"`
78				KeyFingerprint string `json:"keyFingerprint"`

82			return result, ErrUnknown
83		}
84		// A matching operation marker identifies the created item even if its
85		// public-key receipt is incomplete. Keep the exact ID for reconciliation.
86		result.Status = StatusCreated
87		result.Receipt = &Receipt{Destination: state.dest, ItemID: item.ID}
88		actualLine, actualFingerprint, err := publicIdentity(item.SSHKey.PublicKey)
89		if err != nil || actualLine != publicLine || actualFingerprint != fingerprint || item.SSHKey.KeyFingerprint != fingerprint {
90			return result, ErrPublicKey
91		}
92		result.Receipt.PublicLine, result.Receipt.Fingerprint = publicLine, fingerprint
93		return result, nil

96	func ownedBitwardenFields(fields []bwResponseField, operation string) bool {
97		if len(fields) != 2 {
98			return false
99		}
100		owner, exactOperation := false, false
101		for _, field := range fields {
102			if field.Type != 0 {
103				return false
104			}
105			switch field.Name {
106			case "dev-owner":
107				if owner || field.Value != vaultKeyOwner {
108					return false
109				}
110				owner = true
111			case "dev-operation":
112				if exactOperation || field.Value != operation {
113					return false
114				}
115				exactOperation = true
116			default:
117				return false
118			}
119		}
120		return owner && exactOperation
121	}

123	// bitwardenInput owns all directly accessible secret buffers and wipes them on
124	// return. The remaining encoded stdin is also secret and its caller must wipe it.
125	// Go/crypto/PEM implementations and the OS can retain additional copies; this is
126	// best-effort cleanup, not a no-swap, no-core-dump or complete-erasure guarantee.
127	func bitwardenInput(state *planState) ([]byte, string, string, error) {
128		public, private, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, "", "", ErrUnavailable
131		}
132		defer sshcredential.Wipe(private)
133		key, err := ssh.NewPublicKey(public)
134		if err != nil {
135			return nil, "", "", ErrUnavailable
136		}
137		block, err := ssh.MarshalPrivateKey(private, state.request.Title)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, "", "", ErrUnavailable
140		}
141		defer sshcredential.Wipe(block.Bytes)
142		privatePEM := pem.EncodeToMemory(block)
143		defer sshcredential.Wipe(privatePEM)
144		publicLine := strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(key)))
145		fingerprint := ssh.FingerprintSHA256(key)
146		metadata := struct {
147			Type           int       `json:"type"`
148			Name           string    `json:"name"`
149			Login          any       `json:"login"`
150			OrganizationID any       `json:"organizationId"`
151			CollectionIDs  []string  `json:"collectionIds"`
152			Fields         []bwField `json:"fields"`
153		}{Type: 5, Name: state.request.Title, CollectionIDs: []string{}, Fields: []bwField{{Name: "dev-owner", Value: vaultKeyOwner}, {Name: "dev-operation", Value: state.operation}}}
154		prefix, err := json.Marshal(metadata)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, "", "", ErrUnsafe
157		}
158		publicJSON, _ := json.Marshal(publicLine)
159		fingerprintJSON, _ := json.Marshal(fingerprint)
160		// Do not convert private PEM to a Go string or feed it to encoding/json's
161		// pooled buffers. Only the public metadata above uses json.Marshal.
162		body := make([]byte, 0, len(prefix)+2*len(privatePEM)+len(publicJSON)+len(fingerprintJSON)+128)
163		body = append(body, prefix[:len(prefix)-1]...)
164		body = append(body, `,"sshKey":{"privateKey":`...)
165		body = appendPEMString(body, privatePEM)
166		body = append(body, `,"publicKey":`...)
167		body = append(body, publicJSON...)
168		body = append(body, `,"keyFingerprint":`...)
169		body = append(body, fingerprintJSON...)
170		body = append(body, '}', '}')
171		defer sshcredential.Wipe(body)
172		encoded := make([]byte, base64.StdEncoding.EncodedLen(len(body)))
173		base64.StdEncoding.Encode(encoded, body)
174		return encoded, publicLine, fingerprint, nil
175	}
176	
177	// PEM is ASCII. Append its JSON representation directly so every secret buffer
178	// remains mutable and can receive best-effort cleanup.
179	func appendPEMString(destination, value []byte) []byte {
180		const hexDigits = "0123456789abcdef"
181		destination = append(destination, '"')
182		for _, b := range value {
183			switch b {
184			case '"', '\\':
185				destination = append(destination, '\\', b)
186			case '\n':
187				destination = append(destination, '\\', 'n')
188			case '\r':
189				destination = append(destination, '\\', 'r')
190			default:
191				if b < 0x20 {
192					destination = append(destination, '\\', 'u', '0', '0', hexDigits[b>>4], hexDigits[b&15])
193				} else {
194					destination = append(destination, b)
195				}
196			}
197		}
198		return append(destination, '"')
199	}

```text
1	# SSH vault key creation boundary
2	
3	This package is the domain adapter, not CLI/TUI integration or an SSH agent.
4	`Plan` explicitly reads native provider metadata; `Apply` consumes a service-bound,
5	immutable, single-attempt plan. The caller reviews the destination and confirms
6	creation before Apply. Deserialized plans carry no authority.
7	
8	- **1Password:** native `op item create --category ssh` generates the default
9	  Ed25519 identity. Account/user/server/exact vault ID and CLI version are bound
10	  and revalidated. The returned item ID, title, category and vault must match;
11	  public material is fetched by that exact ID with a public-field selector.
12	  Private response fields are ignored, not returned or logged.
13	- **Bitwarden:** explicit experimental approval permits in-memory Ed25519
14	  generation and type-5 creation through base64 stdin. No private key file is
15	  written by this package. Owned buffers receive best-effort cleanup, not a
16	  promise about Go runtime copies, process dumps or OS swap. The schema is pinned
17	  to CLI `2026.3.0`, personal-vault-only, with a unique operation marker. Existing
18	  local keys are never imported or deleted.
19	- **Cloud Bitwarden is not supported by this writer yet.** Both US and EU cloud
20	  environments in the pinned CLI expose `serverUrl: null`. `bw config server`
21	  returns the same fallback for both; its API/identity/web-vault flags enter the
22	  mutation path. There is no verified read-only region query. This package
23	  returns `ErrUnsupportedContext` instead of guessing a region, modifying config,
24	  or reading private native storage. Desktop creation plus named-agent selection
25	  is the appropriate handoff for such contexts.
26	- **No live-vault verification has been performed.** Fake tests verify the
27	  implementation and failure boundaries, not native provider behavior. The
28	  experimental Bitwarden schema was inspected at the immutable upstream commit
29	  below, not exercised against a user's unlocked vault.
30	
31	`Result.Status == "created"` never asserts that a provider's SSH agent serves the
32	key. Public lookup may be incomplete (`ErrPublicKey`), or a post-write context
33	check may be uncertain (`ErrUnknown`, `BindingStatus == "unknown"`); the known
34	item receipt remains in the result. An ambiguous creation has `Status ==
35	"unknown"`. In either case, never automatically retry. There is no rollback,
36	delete, import, login/unlock, agent-configuration, or key-revocation API.
37	
38	The `Receipt.Destination` is the reviewed destination intent. Treat it as verified
39	only when `BindingStatus == "verified"`. Native tools, independent changes to
40	native configuration, and remote services remain outside dev's locks; pre/post
41	checks cannot make external provider operations transactional.
42	
43	## Sources

45	- [1Password CLI SSH generation](https://www.1password.dev/cli/ssh-keys/)

57		}
58		if len(input) > 0 {
59			runner.inputs = append(runner.inputs, input)
60			if name != "bw" || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, []string{"create", "item"}) {
61				runner.t.Fatal("unexpected stdin")
62			}
63		}
64		var body []byte
65		var err error
66		if step.run != nil {
67			body, err = step.run(ctx, input)
68		} else if text, ok := step.body.(string); ok {
69			body = []byte(text)
70		} else {
71			body, err = json.Marshal(step.body)
72		}
73		runner.outputs = append(runner.outputs, body)
74		return body, err
75	}

81		}
82		for _, bodies := range [][][]byte{runner.outputs, runner.inputs} {
83			for _, body := range bodies {
84				for _, b := range body {
85					if b != 0 {
86						t.Fatal("provider response or secret stdin was not wiped")
87					}
88				}
89			}
90		}
91	}

282		}
283		otherRunner := &scriptedRunner{t: t}

415		}
416		wait.Wait()
417		close(outcomes)
418		created, refused := 0, 0
419		for err := range outcomes {
420			if err == nil {

422			} else if errors.Is(err, ErrPlanUsed) {
423				refused++
424			} else {
425				t.Fatal("unexpected concurrent apply outcome")
426			}
427		}
428		if created != 1 || refused != 1 {

func TestSSHHardwareFlagsRejectIncompatibleModesBeforeOperations(t *testing.T) {
	for _, flags := range [][]string{
		{"--key-type", "ed25519"},
		{"--sk-resident=false"},
		{"--sk-provider", "internal", "--to", "fleet"},
		{"--generate-key", "--key-type", "ed25519", "--sk-verify-required=false"},
		{"--generate-key", "--key-type", "rsa-sk"},
		{"--generate-key", "--key-type", "ed25519-sk", "--auth", "existing"},
		{"--generate-key", "--key-type", "ed25519-sk", "--identity-agent", "bitwarden"},
		{"--generate-key", "--key-type", "ed25519-sk", "--identity-file", "/unused.pub"},
		{"--generate-key", "--key-type", "ecdsa-sk", "--from", "fleet:gateway/box"},
	} {
		t.Run(strings.Join(flags, "_"), func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newSSHCLIFixture(t)
			args := append([]string{"ssh", "setup", "lab", "--hostname", "lab.example", "--target-os", "posix", "--yes", "--json"}, flags...)
			if _, _, err := f.run(args...); err == nil || f.runner.callCount() != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("incompatible hardware flags reached an operation: %v %+v", err, f.runner.callSnapshot())
			}
		})
	}
	f := newSSHCLIFixture(t)
	if _, _, err := f.run("ssh", "setup", "--generate-key", "--key-type", "ed25519-sk"); err == nil || f.runner.callCount() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("no-argument wizard silently ignored an explicitly requested type")
	}
}

func TestSSHDefaultGenerationRemainsOrdinaryEd25519(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSSHCLIFixture(t)
	f.initSSH()
	path := filepath.Join(f.home, ".ssh", "regular")
	out, _, err := f.run("ssh", "setup", "lab", "--hostname", "lab.example", "--generate-key", "--key-path", path, "--no-passphrase", "--target-os", "posix", "--dry-run", "--json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plan, _ := assertOneSSHJSON(t, out)["key_plan"].(map[string]any)
	if plan["algorithm"] != "ssh-ed25519" || plan["identity_file"] != path || plan["security_key_provider"] != nil || plan["keygen_path"] != nil || plan["ssh_client_path"] != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ordinary generation acquired hardware policy: %s", out)
	}
	if f.runner.callCount() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ordinary static plan ran a command: %+v", f.runner.callSnapshot())
	}
}

func TestSSHHardwarePreviewNamesExactToolsAndRetainedEffects(t *testing.T) {
	plan := sshhost.KeyPlan{Operation: sshhost.KeyGenerate, KeyType: sshhost.KeyTypeEd25519SK, IdentityFile: "/home/u/.ssh/work/id_sk", PublicPath: "/home/u/.ssh/work/id_sk.pub", CreateParent: "/home/u/.ssh/work", KeygenPath: "/tools/ssh-keygen", SSHClientPath: "/tools/ssh", SecurityKeyProvider: "/providers/security key.dylib", SecurityKey: sshhost.SecurityKeyOptions{Provider: "/providers/security key.dylib", Resident: true, VerifyRequired: true, Application: "ssh:lab"}}
	var output bytes.Buffer
	app := &App{Out: &output, Err: &output}
	renderSSHSetupPlan(app, sshSetupDocument{Alias: "lab", AliasClass: "managed", KeyPlan: &plan})
	for _, expected := range []string{"ed25519-sk", plan.IdentityFile, plan.PublicPath, plan.KeygenPath, plan.SSHClientPath, plan.SecurityKeyProvider, "resident", "true", "ssh:lab", "PIN/touch", "not an exportable", "mode 0700", "no downgrade", "never claims hardware rollback"} {
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(output.String()), strings.ToLower(expected)) {
			t.Fatalf("review omits %q: %s", expected, output.String())
		}
	}
}

func TestSSHHardwareUnknownReceiptsRemainInBothCLIResults(t *testing.T) {
	key := sshhost.KeyResult{Operation: sshhost.KeyGenerate, Hardware: &sshhost.HardwareKeyEffect{Kind: "fido", Status: "unknown", Resident: true, RecoveryIdentityPath: "/home/u/.ssh/.recovery-sk", RecoveryPublicPath: "/home/u/.ssh/.recovery-sk.pub"}}
	var output bytes.Buffer
	app := &App{Out: &output, Err: &output}
	failed := errors.New("native enrollment interrupted")
	if err := finishSSHSetup(app, false, sshSetupDocument{Alias: "lab", Status: "partial", KeyResult: &key}, failed); !errors.Is(err, failed) {
		t.Fatal("setup lost the original failure")
	}
	if err := renderSSHOnboardResult(app, sshflow.OnboardExecutionResult{OnboardResult: sshflow.OnboardResult{Status: "partial", Outcomes: []sshflow.OnboardOutcome{{Alias: "lab", Stage: "configure", Status: "unknown"}}}, Keys: map[string]sshhost.KeyResult{"lab": key}}, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, expected := range []string{"unknown", "no hardware rollback", key.Hardware.RecoveryIdentityPath, key.Hardware.RecoveryPublicPath, "do not retry automatically"} {
		if strings.Count(output.String(), expected) < 2 {
			t.Fatalf("receipt omitted from a result renderer: %q in %s", expected, output.String())
		}
	}

//go:build unix

package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/sshflow"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/sshhost"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/tui"
)

type sshHardwareAdapterRunner struct {
	base           *sshCLIRunner
	calls          []sshhost.RunRequest
	cancelGenerate bool
	collision      string
	starts         int
}

func (r *sshHardwareAdapterRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, request sshhost.RunRequest) (sshhost.RunResult, error) {
	r.calls = append(r.calls, request)
	name := filepath.Base(request.Name)
	if name == "ssh-add" {
		return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: 1}, nil
	}
	if name == "ssh-keygen" {
		if !hasSSHArg(request.Args, "-y") {
			r.starts++
			if request.OnStarted != nil {
				request.OnStarted(time.Now())
			}
			if r.cancelGenerate {
				return sshhost.RunResult{}, context.Canceled
			}
		} else if r.collision != "" {
			if err := os.WriteFile(r.collision, []byte("unrelated destination created during native generation"), 0600); err != nil {
				return sshhost.RunResult{}, err
			}
			r.collision = ""
		}
	}
	request.Name = name
	return r.base.Run(ctx, request)
}

func sshHardwareAdapterPublicKey() []byte {
	wire := func(value []byte) []byte {
		result := make([]byte, 4+len(value))
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(result, uint32(len(value)))
		copy(result[4:], value)
		return result
	}
	algorithm := "sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com"
	blob := append(wire([]byte(algorithm)), wire(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x34}, 32))...)
	blob = append(blob, wire([]byte("ssh:adapter"))...)
	return []byte(algorithm + " " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(blob) + " adapter key")
}

func sshHardwareAdapterFixture(t *testing.T) (*App, *sshCLIFixture, *sshHardwareAdapterRunner, string) {
	t.Helper()
	app, f, _ := newSSHAgentSetupFixture(t)
	bin := filepath.Join(f.home, "tools")
	if err := os.Mkdir(bin, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"ssh", "ssh-keygen"} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(bin, name), []byte("inert test executable; must never be executed"), 0500); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	t.Setenv("PATH", bin+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
	f.runner.publicLine = sshHardwareAdapterPublicKey()
	runner := &sshHardwareAdapterRunner{base: f.runner}
	app.sshHostRunner, app.sshHostService = runner, nil
	app.interactiveCheck = func() bool { return true }
	return app, f, runner, bin
}

func runSSHHardwareAdapterCLI(t *testing.T, app *App, f *sshCLIFixture, flags ...string) (string, error) {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	app.Out, app.Err = &out, &out
	root := newRootCommand(app)
	root.SetContext(t.Context())
	root.SetArgs(append([]string{"--config", f.configPath, "--remotes", f.remotesPath, "--color", "never"}, flags...))
	err := root.Execute()
	return out.String(), err
}

func TestSSHHardwareCLIFlagsReachNativeGeneratorAndManagedV2(t *testing.T) {
	app, f, runner, bin := sshHardwareAdapterFixture(t)
	provider := filepath.Join(bin, "custom provider.so")
	if err := os.WriteFile(provider, []byte("inert provider fixture"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	identity := filepath.Join(f.home, ".ssh", "hardware")
	out, err := runSSHHardwareAdapterCLI(t, app, f, "ssh", "setup", "lab", "--hostname", "lab.example", "--user", "tester", "--generate-key", "--key-type", "ed25519-sk", "--key-path", identity, "--comment", "adapter key", "--sk-provider", provider, "--sk-resident", "--sk-verify-required", "--sk-application", "ssh:adapter", "--no-passphrase", "--target-os", "posix", "--yes")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("hardware adapter setup: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	var generated *sshhost.RunRequest
	for i := range runner.calls {
		call := &runner.calls[i]
		if filepath.Base(call.Name) == "ssh-keygen" && hasSSHArg(call.Args, "-t") {
			generated = call
		}
	}
	if generated == nil || generated.Name != filepath.Join(bin, "ssh-keygen") || !generated.Interactive || sshArgValue(generated.Args, "-t") != "ed25519-sk" || sshArgValue(generated.Args, "-w") != provider || !hasSSHArg(generated.Args, "resident") || !hasSSHArg(generated.Args, "verify-required") || !hasSSHArg(generated.Args, "application=ssh:adapter") || !hasSSHArg(generated.Args, "-N") || sshArgValue(generated.Args, "-C") != "adapter key" {
		t.Fatalf("native options lost: %+v", generated)
	}
	if runner.starts != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("hardware generation repeated: %d", runner.starts)
	}
	body, err := os.ReadFile(f.managedPath("lab"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	definition, err := sshhost.ParseManaged(body)
	if err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(string(body), sshhost.ManagedHeaderV2+"\n") || definition.SecurityKeyProvider != provider || definition.IdentityFile != identity || definition.IdentitiesOnly == nil || !*definition.IdentitiesOnly {
		t.Fatalf("hardware provider intent lost: %+v %v", definition, err)
	}
}

	app, f, runner, bin := sshHardwareAdapterFixture(t)

	}
	preview := strings.Join(plan.Preview().Notes, "\n")
	for _, value := range []string{filepath.Join(bin, "ssh-keygen"), filepath.Join(bin, "ssh"), "ed25519-sk", "internal", "ssh:adapter", "PIN/touch", "resident", "cancellation"} {
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(preview), strings.ToLower(value)) {
			t.Fatalf("hardware preview omits %q: %s", value, preview)
		}
	}
	if runner.starts != 0 {
		t.Fatal("TUI preview started hardware generation")
	}
	runner.cancelGenerate = true
	workflow := &sshTUIWorkflow{ctx: t.Context(), app: *app, request: tui.SSHWorkflowRequest{Action: "onboard", Onboarding: plan}}
	if err := workflow.Run(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("interrupted hardware generation reported success")
	}
	result := workflow.Result().Onboarding
	if result == nil || result.Status != "partial" || len(result.Outcomes) == 0 || result.Outcomes[0].Status != "unknown" || result.Keys["lab"].Hardware == nil || result.Keys["lab"].Hardware.Status != "unknown" || !result.Keys["lab"].Hardware.Resident {
		t.Fatalf("unknown hardware effect disappeared: %+v", result)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(f.managedPath("lab")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		t.Fatal("interrupted key generation installed managed configuration")
	}
	_ = workflow.Run()
	if runner.starts != 1 {
		t.Fatal("interrupted enrollment was retried")
	}
}

func newSecurityKeyFixture(t *testing.T) *securityKeyFixture {
	t.Helper()
	paths := fixturePaths(t)
	f := &securityKeyFixture{tools: map[string]string{}, line: testSecurityKeyLine(0xc1, "hardware test")}
	for _, name := range []string{"ssh", "ssh-keygen"} {

		f.requests = append(f.requests, request)
		if request.Name == f.tools["ssh"] {
			if f.proof != nil { return f.proof(request) }
			t.Fatalf("unexpected native client request: %+v", request)
		}
		if request.Name != f.tools["ssh-keygen"] { t.Fatalf("unexpected tool: %s", request.Name) }
		switch request.Args[0] {
		case "-q":
			if request.OnStarted != nil { request.OnStarted(time.Now()) }
			if f.generate != nil { return f.generate(request) }
			base := sshArgForCatalogTest(request.Args, "-f")
			writeFixture(t, base, "opaque FIDO handle; not an exportable private key")
			writeFixture(t, base+".pub", string(f.line)+"\n")
			return RunResult{}, nil
		case "-y":
			if f.derive != nil { return f.derive(request) }
			return RunResult{Stdout: append(append([]byte(nil), f.line...), '\n')}, nil
		default:
			t.Fatalf("unexpected probe or enrollment command: %+v", request)
			return RunResult{}, nil
		}
	}))
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	f.service = s
	s.securityKeyLookPath = func(name string) (string, error) { return f.tools[name], nil }
	s.securityKeyGOOS = "linux"
	s.securityKeyToolCheck = func(_ string, info fs.FileInfo) error { if !info.Mode().IsRegular() { return ErrUnsafePath }; return nil }
	return f
}

func (f *securityKeyFixture) plan(t *testing.T, keyType KeyType, options SecurityKeyOptions) KeyPlan {
	t.Helper()
	plan, err := f.service.PlanKey(t.Context(), KeyRequest{Operation: KeyGenerate, Type: keyType, SecurityKey: options,
		DestinationIdentity: filepath.Join(f.service.paths.SSHDir, "hardware-key"), Interactive: true, NoPassphrase: true, Comment: "test token"})
	if err != nil || !plan.Ready() { t.Fatalf("plan=%+v err=%v", plan, err) }
	return plan
}

func ecdsaSecurityKeyLine() []byte {
	algorithm := "sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com"
	x, y := elliptic.P256().ScalarBaseMult([]byte{1})
	blob := sshWireString([]byte(algorithm))
	blob = append(blob, sshWireString([]byte("nistp256"))...)
	blob = append(blob, sshWireString(elliptic.Marshal(elliptic.P256(), x, y))...)
	blob = append(blob, sshWireString([]byte("ssh:dev"))...)
	return []byte(algorithm+" "+base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(blob)+" hardware test")
}

func TestSecurityKeyCapabilitiesArePassiveAndUncertain(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
	observation, err := f.service.ObserveSecurityKeyCapability(t.Context(), "internal")
	if err != nil || !observation.CanAttempt || observation.Status != "unknown" || len(f.requests) != 0 { t.Fatalf("capability=%+v err=%v", observation, err) }
	if observation.KeygenPath != f.tools["ssh-keygen"] || observation.SSHClientPath != f.tools["ssh"] { t.Fatal("exact tool paths omitted") }
	observation, err = f.service.ObserveSecurityKeyCapability(t.Context(), "apple-secure-enclave")
	if err != nil || observation.CanAttempt || !hasDiagnostic(observation.Diagnostics, "secure_enclave_generation_unverified") || len(f.requests) != 0 { t.Fatalf("Secure Enclave was not blocked passively: %+v %v", observation, err) }
	f.service.securityKeyLookPath = func(string) (string, error) { return "", fs.ErrNotExist }
	observation, err = f.service.ObserveSecurityKeyCapability(t.Context(), "internal")
	if err != nil || observation.CanAttempt || !hasDiagnostic(observation.Diagnostics, "security_key_tool_unavailable") { t.Fatalf("missing tools accepted: %+v %v", observation, err) }
	for _, test := range []struct{goos, provider, keygen, client string; blocked bool}{
		{"darwin", "internal", "/usr/bin/ssh-keygen", "/custom/ssh", true},
		{"darwin", "internal", "/custom/ssh-keygen", "/usr/bin/ssh", true},
		{"darwin", "internal", "/custom/ssh-keygen", "/custom/ssh", false},
		{"darwin", "/provider.dylib", "/usr/bin/ssh-keygen", "/usr/bin/ssh", false},
		{"linux", "internal", "/usr/bin/ssh-keygen", "/usr/bin/ssh", false},
	} {
		if got := knownInternalFIDOUnsupported(test.goos, test.provider, test.keygen, test.client); got != test.blocked { t.Fatalf("classification %+v=%v", test, got) }
	}
}

func TestSecurityKeyGenerationPinsNativeArgumentsAndValidatesStub(t *testing.T) {
	for _, keyType := range []KeyType{KeyTypeEd25519SK, KeyTypeECDSASK} {
		t.Run(string(keyType), func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
			if keyType == KeyTypeECDSASK { f.line = ecdsaSecurityKeyLine() }
			t.Setenv("SSH_SK_PROVIDER", "/must-not-inherit")
			plan := f.plan(t, keyType, SecurityKeyOptions{Resident: true, VerifyRequired: true, Application: "ssh:dev-test"})
			if len(f.requests) != 0 { t.Fatal("plan invoked native tools") }
			result, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), plan)
			if err != nil || !result.Created || !result.Retained || result.Hardware == nil || result.Hardware.Status != "created" || !result.Hardware.Resident { t.Fatalf("result=%+v err=%v", result, err) }
			if result.Candidate.Provenance.Private || !result.Candidate.Provenance.SecurityKeyStub || result.Candidate.Algorithm != keyType.algorithm() { t.Fatalf("wrong provenance: %+v", result.Candidate) }
			if len(f.requests) != 2 { t.Fatalf("unexpected native operations: %+v", f.requests) }
			generation := f.requests[0]
			base := sshArgForCatalogTest(generation.Args, "-f")
			want := []string{"-q", "-t", string(keyType), "-f", base, "-w", "internal", "-O", "application=ssh:dev-test", "-O", "resident", "-O", "verify-required", "-C", "test token", "-N", ""}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(generation.Args, want) || !generation.Interactive || !reflect.DeepEqual(generation.UnsetEnv, []string{"SSH_SK_PROVIDER"}) { t.Fatalf("native args=%+v", generation) }
			if !f.requests[1].Interactive || !f.requests[1].CaptureStdout { t.Fatal("stub derivation lost native interaction") }
			if result.Hardware.RecoveryIdentityPath != "" { t.Fatal("successful publication advertised recovery") }
			usePlan, err := f.service.PlanKey(t.Context(), KeyRequest{Candidate: result.Candidate, Interactive: true})
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			used, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), usePlan)
			if err != nil || used.Candidate.state.hardware != result.Candidate.state.hardware { t.Fatalf("rebind lost hardware authority: %v", err) }
			writeFixture(t, f.tools["ssh"], "different client")
			if err := f.service.RevalidateKeySelection(t.Context(), usePlan); !errors.Is(err, ErrSourceChanged) { t.Fatalf("rebound key accepted a changed client: %v", err) }
		})
	}
}

func TestSecurityKeyPlansRejectInvalidOptionsAndMutation(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
	for _, request := range []KeyRequest{
		{Operation: KeyGenerate, Type: KeyTypeEd25519SK, NoPassphrase: true},
		{Operation: KeyGenerate, Type: KeyTypeEd25519SK, Interactive: true, SecurityKey: SecurityKeyOptions{Application: "not-ssh"}},
		{Operation: KeyGenerate, Type: KeyTypeEd25519, Interactive: true, SecurityKey: SecurityKeyOptions{Resident: true}},
	} {
		plan, err := f.service.PlanKey(t.Context(), request)
		if err == nil && plan.Ready() { t.Fatalf("invalid request ready: %+v", request) }
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*KeyPlan){
		func(plan *KeyPlan) { plan.SecurityKey.Resident = true },
		func(plan *KeyPlan) { plan.SecurityKey.Provider = "/other" },
		func(plan *KeyPlan) { plan.KeygenPath = "/other" },
		func(plan *KeyPlan) { plan.SSHClientPath = "/other" },
		func(plan *KeyPlan) { plan.KeyType = KeyTypeEd25519 },
	} {
		plan := f.plan(t, KeyTypeEd25519SK, SecurityKeyOptions{})
		mutate(&plan)
		if _, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), plan); err == nil { t.Fatal("mutated hardware plan applied") }
	}
	if len(f.requests) != 0 { t.Fatal("invalid plans touched native tools") }
}

func TestSecurityKeyToolAndProviderSubstitutionBlocksEnrollment(t *testing.T) {
	for _, selected := range []string{"ssh", "ssh-keygen", "provider"} {
		t.Run(selected, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
			provider := filepath.Join(f.service.paths.Home, "provider.so")
			writeFixture(t, provider, "inert provider")
			plan := f.plan(t, KeyTypeEd25519SK, SecurityKeyOptions{Provider: provider})
			path := provider
			if selected != "provider" { path = f.tools[selected] }
			writeFixture(t, path, "changed tool or provider")
			if _, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), plan); !errors.Is(err, ErrSourceChanged) { t.Fatalf("substitution not rejected: %v", err) }
			if len(f.requests) != 0 { t.Fatal("changed toolchain was executed") }
		})
	}
}

func TestSecurityKeyRecoveryRetainsOnlyValidatedPairs(t *testing.T) {
	for _, phase := range []string{"ordinary-output", "mismatch", "canceled-before-validation", "canceled-after-validation", "collision"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
			defer cancel()
			if phase == "ordinary-output" { f.line = testPublicLine(0xc2, "not hardware") }
			if phase == "mismatch" { f.derive = func(RunRequest) (RunResult, error) { return RunResult{Stdout: testPublicLine(0xc3, "ordinary")}, nil } }
			if phase == "canceled-before-validation" {
				f.derive = func(RunRequest) (RunResult, error) { cancel(); return RunResult{Stdout: f.line}, nil }
			}
			plan := f.plan(t, KeyTypeEd25519SK, SecurityKeyOptions{Resident: true})
			if phase == "canceled-after-validation" { f.service.beforeKeyCommit = cancel }
			if phase == "collision" { f.service.beforeKeyCommit = func() { writeFixture(t, plan.IdentityFile, "existing identity must survive") } }
			result, err := f.service.ApplyKey(ctx, plan)
			if err == nil || result.Hardware == nil { t.Fatalf("missing failed enrollment receipt: %+v %v", result, err) }
			wantRecovery := phase == "canceled-after-validation" || phase == "collision"
			if (result.Hardware.RecoveryIdentityPath != "") != wantRecovery || (result.Hardware.RecoveryPublicPath != "") != wantRecovery { t.Fatalf("unsafe/incomplete recovery: %+v", result) }
			if result.Candidate.state != nil { t.Fatal("failed generation returned an actionable key") }
			if wantRecovery {
				if result.Hardware.Status != "created" || !result.Retained { t.Fatalf("validated pair status=%+v", result) }
				assertFixturePrivateFile(t, result.Hardware.RecoveryIdentityPath)
				assertFixturePrivateFile(t, result.Hardware.RecoveryPublicPath)
			} else {
				if result.Hardware.Status != "unknown" { t.Fatalf("unvalidated hardware outcome became known: %+v", result) }
				left, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(f.service.paths.SSHDir, ".dev-sk-recovery-*"))
				if len(left) != 0 { t.Fatalf("unvalidated native output retained: %v", left) }
			}
			before := len(f.requests)
			result.Hardware.Status = "caller mutation"
			again, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), plan)
			if !errors.Is(err, ErrBlocked) || len(f.requests) != before || again.Hardware.Status == "caller mutation" { t.Fatalf("plan reenrolled or shared receipt: %+v %v", again, err) }
			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(result)
			if strings.Contains(string(encoded), "opaque FIDO handle") || strings.Contains(string(encoded), "existing identity must survive") { t.Fatal("receipt leaked identity contents") }
		})
	}
}

func TestSecurityKeyConcurrentApplyEnrollsOnlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
	plan := f.plan(t, KeyTypeEd25519SK, SecurityKeyOptions{})
	var group sync.WaitGroup
	errorsSeen := make(chan error, 2)
	for range 2 {
		group.Add(1)
		go func() { defer group.Done(); _, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), plan); errorsSeen <- err }()
	}
	group.Wait()
	close(errorsSeen)
	ready, blocked := 0, 0
	for err := range errorsSeen { if err == nil { ready++ } else if errors.Is(err, ErrBlocked) { blocked++ } else { t.Fatal(err) } }
	if ready != 1 || blocked != 1 || len(f.requests) != 2 { t.Fatalf("duplicate enrollment: ready=%d blocked=%d requests=%d", ready, blocked, len(f.requests)) }
}

func TestSecurityKeyExactProofRequiresExplicitNativeInteraction(t *testing.T) {
	for _, interactive := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false:"batch", true:"native"}[interactive], func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newSecurityKeyFixture(t)
			plan := f.plan(t, KeyTypeEd25519SK, SecurityKeyOptions{VerifyRequired: true})
			key, err := f.service.ApplyKey(t.Context(), plan)
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			f.proof = func(request RunRequest) (RunResult, error) {
				if request.Interactive != interactive { t.Fatalf("proof interaction=%v want=%v", request.Interactive, interactive) }
				data, err := os.ReadFile(sshArgForCatalogTest(request.Args, "-F"))
				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				batch := "yes"; if interactive { batch = "no" }
				for key, value := range map[string]string{"BatchMode":batch, "PasswordAuthentication":"no", "KbdInteractiveAuthentication":"no", "PreferredAuthentications":"publickey", "IdentitiesOnly":"yes", "SecurityKeyProvider":"internal"} {
					if !proofDirectiveEquals(data, key, value) { t.Fatalf("proof weakened %s: %s", key, data) }
				}
				if err := os.WriteFile(sshArgForCatalogTest(request.Args, "-E"), []byte("Authenticated to target using \"publickey\".\n"), 0o600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				return RunResult{}, nil
			}
			selector, cleanup, err := f.service.prepareKeySelector(key.Candidate.state)
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			defer cleanup()
			route := bindTestRoute(t, f.service, "target", []RouteHop{{Alias:"target", RemoteOS:RemoteOSPOSIX}})
			verified, err := f.service.runSSHProof(t.Context(), route.state.hops[0], selector, true, interactive)
			if err != nil || !verified { t.Fatalf("proof=%v err=%v", verified, err) }
		})
	}
}

1	package sshhost
2	
3	// KeyType selects the native SSH key algorithm. Empty requests retain Ed25519.
4	type KeyType string
5	
6	const (
7		KeyTypeEd25519   KeyType = "ed25519"
8		KeyTypeEd25519SK KeyType = "ed25519-sk"
9		KeyTypeECDSASK   KeyType = "ecdsa-sk"
10	)
11	
12	// SecurityKeyOptions configure an explicit native FIDO enrollment. They never
13	// authorize passive hardware enumeration or an alternative authentication method.
14	type SecurityKeyOptions struct {
15		Provider       string `json:"provider,omitempty"`
16		Resident       bool   `json:"resident,omitempty"`
17		VerifyRequired bool   `json:"verify_required,omitempty"`
18		Application    string `json:"application,omitempty"`
19	}
20	
21	// SecurityKeyCapability is stat-only. Unknown permits a reviewed interactive
22	// attempt, not a claim that a token is present or that signing will succeed.
23	type SecurityKeyCapability struct {
24		Status        string       `json:"status"`
25		CanAttempt    bool         `json:"can_attempt"`
26		Provider      string       `json:"provider"`
27		KeygenPath    string       `json:"keygen_path,omitempty"`
28		SSHClientPath string       `json:"ssh_client_path,omitempty"`
29		Diagnostics   []Diagnostic `json:"diagnostics,omitempty"`
30	}
31	
32	// HardwareKeyEffect is separate from local-file creation. A started enrollment
33	// may have changed a resident authenticator even if it returned no usable stub.
34	// Recovery paths refer only to independently validated SK stub/public pairs.
35	type HardwareKeyEffect struct {
36		Kind                 string `json:"kind"`
37		Status               string `json:"status"`
38		Resident             bool   `json:"resident,omitempty"`
39		RecoveryIdentityPath string `json:"recovery_identity_path,omitempty"`
40		RecoveryPublicPath   string `json:"recovery_public_path,omitempty"`
41	}
42	
43	func (t KeyType) securityKey() bool { return t == KeyTypeEd25519SK || t == KeyTypeECDSASK }
44	
45	func (t KeyType) algorithm() string {
46		switch t {
47		case KeyTypeEd25519SK:
48			return "sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com"
49		case KeyTypeECDSASK:
50			return "sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com"
51		default:
52			return "ssh-ed25519"
53		}
54	}
55

39	func (s *Service) observeSecurityKeyCapability(ctx context.Context, provider string) (SecurityKeyCapability, *securityKeyState, error) {
40		if ctx == nil {
41			ctx = context.Background()
42		}
43		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
44			return SecurityKeyCapability{}, nil, err
45		}
46		if provider == "" {
47			provider = "internal"
48		}
49		observation := SecurityKeyCapability{Status: "unavailable", Provider: provider}
50		blocked := func(code, message string) (SecurityKeyCapability, *securityKeyState, error) {
51			observation.Diagnostics = []Diagnostic{{Code: code, Message: message, BlocksMutation: true}}
52			return observation, nil, nil
53		}
54		if provider == "apple-secure-enclave" {
55			observation.Status = "unsupported"
56			return blocked("secure_enclave_generation_unverified", "Automatic Apple Secure Enclave enrollment is experimental and unverified; use Secretive or an existing security-key stub. dev will not run sc_auth or enumerate resident keys.")
57		}
58		if provider != "internal" {
59			if err := ValidateAgentSocketPath(provider); err != nil {
60				return blocked("security_key_provider_unsafe", "SecurityKeyProvider must be internal or a safe absolute library path.")
61			}
62		}
63		lookup := s.securityKeyLookPath
64		if lookup == nil {
65			lookup = exec.LookPath
66		}
67		state := &securityKeyState{}
68		for _, tool := range []struct {
69			name   string
70			target *securityKeyFile
71			public *string
72		}{
73			{"ssh-keygen", &state.keygen, &observation.KeygenPath},
74			{"ssh", &state.client, &observation.SSHClientPath},
75		} {
76			path, err := lookup(tool.name)
77			if err != nil {
78				return blocked("security_key_tool_unavailable", "A safe "+tool.name+" executable is required for hardware generation and subsequent native SSH authentication.")
79			}
80			file, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(path, true)
81			if err != nil {
82				return blocked("security_key_tool_unsafe", "The selected "+tool.name+" executable failed local path/metadata checks.")
83			}
84			*tool.target, *tool.public = file, file.resolved
85		}
86		if provider != "internal" {
87			file, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(provider, false)
88			if err != nil {
89				return blocked("security_key_provider_unsafe", "The selected security-key provider library failed local path/metadata checks.")
90			}
91			state.provider = &file
92			provider, observation.Provider = file.resolved, file.resolved
93		}
94		goos := s.securityKeyGOOS
95		if goos == "" {
96			goos = runtime.GOOS
97		}
98		if knownInternalFIDOUnsupported(goos, provider, state.keygen.resolved, state.client.resolved) {
99			observation.Status = "unsupported"
100			return blocked("ssh_client_lacks_fido", "Apple's stock internal OpenSSH provider lacks USB FIDO support. Select compatible ssh and ssh-keygen tools together; dev does not install or switch them automatically.")

An explicitly reviewed interactive attempt may create a resident hardware credential even if later validation fails."}}

109		return goos == "darwin" && provider == "internal" && (keygen == "/usr/bin/ssh-keygen" || client == "/usr/bin/ssh")

112	func (s *Service) inspectSecurityKeyFile(path string, executable bool) (securityKeyFile, error) {
113		if path == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(path) || !validUTF8NoControl(path) {
114			return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
115		}
116		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
117		if err != nil {
118			return securityKeyFile{}, err
119		}
120		info, err := os.Lstat(resolved)
121		if err != nil {
122			return securityKeyFile{}, err
123		}
124		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
125			return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
126		}
127		if s.securityKeyToolCheck != nil {
128			if err := s.securityKeyToolCheck(resolved, info); err != nil {
129				return securityKeyFile{}, err
130			}
131		} else {
132			if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
133				return securityKeyFile{}, ErrManualRemediation
134			}
135			if err := platformAgentDirectory(resolved, info); err != nil {
136				return securityKeyFile{}, err
137			}
138			for dir, depth := filepath.Dir(resolved), 0; ; dir, depth = filepath.Dir(dir), depth+1 {
139				if depth >= 64 {
140					return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
141				}
142				parent, err := os.Lstat(dir)
143				if err != nil || !parent.IsDir() || parent.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
144					return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
145				}
146				if err := platformAgentDirectory(dir, parent); err != nil {
147					return securityKeyFile{}, err
148				}
149				if dir == filepath.Dir(dir) || samePath(dir, s.paths.Home) {
150					break
151				}
152			}
153			if executable && info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 {
154				return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
155			}
156		}
157		return securityKeyFile{requested: filepath.Clean(path), resolved: resolved, info: info}, nil
158	}

160	func (s *Service) revalidateSecurityKeyState(state *securityKeyState) error {
161		if state == nil {
162			return nil
163		}
164		lookup := s.securityKeyLookPath
165		if lookup == nil {
166			lookup = exec.LookPath
167		}
168		for _, tool := range []struct {
169			name string
170			file securityKeyFile
171		}{{"ssh-keygen", state.keygen}, {"ssh", state.client}} {
172			path, err := lookup(tool.name)
173			if err != nil || filepath.Clean(path) != tool.file.requested {
174				return fmt.Errorf("selected %s changed: %w", tool.name, ErrSourceChanged)
175			}
176			current, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(path, true)
177			if err != nil || current.resolved != tool.file.resolved || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(current.info, tool.file.info) {
178				return fmt.Errorf("selected %s changed: %w", tool.name, ErrSourceChanged)
179			}
180		}
181		if state.provider != nil {
182			current, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(state.provider.requested, false)
183			if err != nil || current.resolved != state.provider.resolved || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(current.info, state.provider.info) {
184				return fmt.Errorf("selected security-key provider changed: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
185			}
186		}
187		return nil
188	}

190	func normalizeSecurityKeyOptions(options SecurityKeyOptions) (SecurityKeyOptions, error) {
191		if options.Provider == "" {
192			options.Provider = "internal"
193		}
194		if options.Application == "" {
195			options.Application = "ssh:dev"
196		}
197		if !strings.HasPrefix(options.Application, "ssh:") || len(options.Application) < 5 || len(options.Application) > 68 {
198			return options, errors.New("security-key application must be ssh: followed by 1-64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes")
199		}
200		for _, c := range options.Application[4:] {
201			if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == '-') {
202				return options, errors.New("invalid security-key application")
203			}
204		}
205		return options, nil
206	}

208	// VerifySecurityKeyPolicy checks a foreign alias without changing its provider.
209	// The plan is service-bound and no native enrollment or login occurs here.
210	func (s *Service) VerifySecurityKeyPolicy(ctx context.Context, alias string, plan KeyPlan) error {
211		if plan.state == nil || plan.state.serviceID != s.id || !equalKeyPlans(plan, plan.state.public) || plan.state.hardware == nil {
212			return ErrBlocked
213		}
214		if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(plan.state.hardware); err != nil {
215			return err
216		}
217		effective, err := s.Effective(ctx, alias)
218		if err != nil {
219			return err
220		}
221		if !securityKeyProviderMatches(effective, plan.state.hardware) {
222			return errors.Join(ErrManualRemediation, errors.New("alias SecurityKeyProvider does not match the selected hardware generation provider"))
223		}
224		return nil
225	}
226	
227	func selectedSSHClient(selector keySelector) string {
228		if selector.hardware != nil {
229			return selector.hardware.client.resolved
230		}
231		return "ssh"
232	}
233	
234	func securityKeyProviderMatches(effective EffectiveConfig, state *securityKeyState) bool {
235		provider := firstEffectiveValue(effective, "securitykeyprovider")
236		if provider == "" {
237			provider = "internal"
238		}
239		return provider == state.options.Provider
240	}

24			KeyType: request.Type, Algorithm: request.Type.algorithm(), SecurityKey: options,
25			SecurityKeyProvider: observation.Provider, KeygenPath: observation.KeygenPath,
26			SSHClientPath: observation.SSHClientPath, Diagnostics: observation.Diagnostics}

743	func splitEvaluatedKnownHosts(value string) ([]string, error) {
744		paths := strings.Fields(value)
745		if len(paths) == 0 {
746			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty known-hosts path list: %w", ErrUnsupportedRoute)
747		}
748		for _, path := range paths {
749			if strings.EqualFold(path, "none") {
750				if len(paths) != 1 {
751					return nil, fmt.Errorf("mixed none known-hosts path list: %w", ErrUnsupportedRoute)
752				}
753				continue
754			}
755			windowsProgramData := runtime.GOOS == "windows" && strings.HasPrefix(
756				strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(path, `\`, "/")), "__PROGRAMDATA__/",

759				return nil, fmt.Errorf("relative or whitespace-containing known-hosts paths cannot be copied safely: %w", ErrUnsupportedRoute)
760			}
761		}
762		return paths, nil

175	func (capture *boundedCapture) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
176		length := len(data)
177		limit := capture.limit
178		if limit == 0 {
179			limit = maxCapturedOutputBytes
180		}
181		remaining := limit - len(capture.data)
182		if remaining > 0 {
183			if remaining > length {
184				remaining = length
185			}
186			capture.data = append(capture.data, data[:remaining]...)
187		}
188		if remaining < length {
189			capture.truncated = true
190		}
191		return length, nil
192	}
193	
194	func (capture *boundedCapture) takeBytes() []byte {
195		if capture == nil || len(capture.data) == 0 && !capture.truncated {
196			return nil
197		}
198		result := capture.data
199		capture.data = nil
200		if capture.truncated {
201			result = append(result, outputTruncationMarker...)
202		}
203		return result
204	}

207		var result RunResult

210			result.StdoutTruncated = stdout.truncated
211		}
212		if includeStderr {
213			result.Stderr = stderr.takeBytes()
214			result.StderrTruncated = stderr.truncated
215		}
216		return result
217	}

180	func (s *Service) inspectSecureIdentity(path string) (secureFileIdentity, error) {
181		path = filepath.Clean(path)
182		if err := s.validateSSHPath(path, false); err != nil {
183			return secureFileIdentity{}, err
184		}
185		parent := filepath.Dir(path)
186		root, held, err := openHeldDirectory(parent, true)
187		if err != nil {
188			return secureFileIdentity{}, err
189		}
190		defer root.Close()
191		before, err := root.Lstat(filepath.Base(path))
192		if err != nil {
193			return secureFileIdentity{}, err
194		}
195		if before.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
196			return secureFileIdentity{}, fmt.Errorf("identity is not a direct regular file: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
197		}
198		file, err := root.Open(filepath.Base(path))
199		if err != nil {
200			return secureFileIdentity{}, err
201		}
202		opened, err := file.Stat()
203		if err == nil && !stableFileInfo(before, opened) {
204			err = ErrSourceChanged
205		}
206		if err == nil {
207			err = platformValidatePrivateFile(path, file, opened)
208		}
209		closeErr := file.Close()
210		if err == nil {
211			err = closeErr
212		}
213		if err != nil {
214			return secureFileIdentity{}, err
215		}
216		if err := verifyHeldDirectory(parent, held, true); err != nil {
217			return secureFileIdentity{}, err
218		}
219		return secureFileIdentity{path: path, info: opened}, nil
220	}

19	type NativeRunner struct{}

21	func (NativeRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, stdin []byte) ([]byte, error) {
22		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
23		defer cancel()
24		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
25		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(stdin)
26		var out limitedOutput
27		out.limit = 1 << 20
28		cmd.Stdout = &out
29		cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
30		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
31			Wipe(out.data)
32			return nil, ErrUnavailable
33		}
34		if out.exceeded {
35			Wipe(out.data)
36			return nil, ErrUnavailable
37		}
38		return out.data, nil
39	}
40	
41	type limitedOutput struct {
42		data     []byte
43		limit    int
44		exceeded bool
45	}
46	
47	func (b *limitedOutput) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
48		n := len(p)
49		room := b.limit - len(b.data)
50		if len(p) > room {
51			b.exceeded = true
52			p = p[:max(0, room)]
53		}
54		b.data = append(b.data, p...)
55		return n, nil
56	}

1	# SSH vault key creation boundary
2	
3	This package is the domain adapter, not CLI/TUI integration or an SSH agent.
4	`Plan` explicitly reads native provider metadata; `Apply` consumes a service-bound,
5	immutable, single-attempt plan. The caller reviews the destination and confirms
6	creation before Apply. Deserialized plans carry no authority.
7	
8	- **1Password:** native `op item create --category ssh` generates the default
9	  Ed25519 identity. Account/user/server/exact vault ID and CLI version are bound
10	  and revalidated. The returned item ID, title, category and vault must match;
11	  public material is fetched by that exact ID with a public-field selector.
12	  Private response fields are ignored, not returned or logged.
13	- **Bitwarden groundwork only:** private helpers and synthetic fake-runner tests
14	  cover in-memory Ed25519 generation, type-5 base64 stdin, operation ownership and
15	  partial receipts. They are intentionally unreachable through public Plan/Apply.
16	  No private key file is written. Owned buffers receive best-effort cleanup, not
17	  a promise about Go runtime copies, process dumps or OS swap. The schema is pinned
18	  to CLI `2026.3.0`, personal-vault-only. Existing local keys are never imported
19	  or deleted.
20	- **All native Bitwarden writer contexts are unsupported.** In the pinned CLI,
21	  `status.serverUrl` and read-only `config server` expose only a base/display URL,
22	  while effective API and identity endpoints may be independently overridden.
23	  A self-hosted-looking base URL therefore cannot verify the actual destination.
24	  US/EU cloud environments additionally both expose `serverUrl: null`, and
25	  `config server` returns the same fallback. URL flags enter the configuration
26	  mutation path; there is no verified read-only effective-endpoint query.
27	  `Plan` returns `ErrUnsupportedContext`, and `Apply` cannot invoke the private
28	  writer. No guessed endpoints, fake successful status schema, configuration
29	  changes, or private native-storage parsing are used. The writer remains
30	  unconnected and unreleased until trustworthy source binding exists. Desktop
31	  creation plus named-agent selection is the appropriate current handoff.
32	- **No live-vault verification has been performed.** Fake tests verify the
33	  implementation and failure boundaries, not native provider behavior. The
34	  experimental Bitwarden schema was inspected at the immutable upstream commit
35	  below, not exercised against a user's unlocked vault. The 1Password
36	  selected-public-field JSON shapes also remain fixture-only, native-unverified.
37	- **Runner limitation:** the shared `sshcredential.NativeRunner` caps captured
38	  output, discards stderr and uses a command timeout, but currently lacks
39	  `WaitDelay` and process-group termination. A descendant holding output pipes
40	  may keep `Wait` blocked; these adapters do not claim a strict whole-process-tree
41	  deadline. That shared runner is unchanged by this package.
42	
43	`Result.Status == "created"` never asserts that a provider's SSH agent serves the
44	key. Public lookup may be incomplete (`ErrPublicKey`), or a post-write context
45	check may be uncertain (`ErrUnknown`, `BindingStatus == "unknown"`); the known
46	item receipt remains in the result. An ambiguous creation has `Status ==
47	"unknown"`. In either case, never automatically retry. There is no rollback,
48	delete, import, login/unlock, agent-configuration, or key-revocation API.
49	
50	The `Receipt.Destination` is the reviewed destination intent. Treat it as verified
51	only when `BindingStatus == "verified"`. Native tools, independent changes to
52	native configuration, and remote services remain outside dev's locks; pre/post
53	checks cannot make external provider operations transactional.
54	
55	## Sources
56	
57	- [1Password CLI SSH generation](https://www.1password.dev/cli/ssh-keys/)
58	- [1Password item commands](https://www.1password.dev/cli/reference/management-commands/item/)
59	- [1Password exact vault selection](https://www.1password.dev/cli/reference/management-commands/vault/)
60	- [Bitwarden CLI 2026.3.0 status](https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/blob/c20753e4dae029d6155565682dc79718f9aeb426/apps/cli/src/commands/status.command.ts)

package sshcredential

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	providerRunnerHelperMode = "DEV_SSHCREDENTIAL_RUNNER_TEST_MODE"
	providerRunnerControl   = "DEV_SSHCREDENTIAL_RUNNER_TEST_CONTROL"
)

func TestNativeProviderRunnerBoundsInheritedPipeWait(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"exit", "cancel"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			executable, err := os.Executable()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal("locate own test executable")
			}
			listener, err := net.ListenTCP("tcp4", &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal("listen for own pipe-holder process")
			}
			t.Setenv(providerRunnerHelperMode, mode)
			t.Setenv(providerRunnerControl, listener.Addr().String())
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			type outcome struct {
				body []byte
				err  error
			}
			done := make(chan outcome, 1)
			go func() {
				body, err := (NativeRunner{}).Run(ctx, executable, []string{"-test.run=^TestNativeProviderRunnerHelperProcess$"}, nil)
				done <- outcome{body: body, err: err}
			}()
			var control net.Conn
			completed := false
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				// Release only the subprocess created for this test. No PID lookup
				// or unrelated process termination is involved.
				if control != nil {
					_ = control.Close()
				}
				_ = listener.Close()
				cancel()
				if !completed {
					select {
					case result := <-done:
						Wipe(result.body)
					case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
						t.Error("own runner did not finish after test cleanup")
					}
				}
			})
			if listener.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(10*time.Second)) != nil {
				t.Fatal("set own listener deadline")
			}
			control, err = listener.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal("own pipe-holder did not connect")
			}
			if control.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5*time.Second)) != nil {
				t.Fatal("set own helper handshake deadline")
			}
			var ready [1]byte
			if _, err := io.ReadFull(control, ready[:]); err != nil || ready[0] != 'R' {
				t.Fatal("own pipe-holder did not become ready")
			}
			if mode == "cancel" {
				cancel()
			}
			// The holder remains alive with inherited stdout/stderr open until
			// cleanup closes its control socket. Wait must not depend on that.
			select {
			case result := <-done:
				completed = true
				defer Wipe(result.body)
				if !errors.Is(result.err, ErrUnavailable) || result.err != ErrUnavailable || len(result.body) != 0 {
					t.Fatal("pipe cleanup failure exposed output or a native error")
				}
			case <-time.After(7 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("provider runner waited for descendant-held output pipes")
			}
		})
	}
}

// Only a copy of this test executable is launched. The helper never invokes a
// provider, inspects user processes, or relies on a shell utility.
func TestNativeProviderRunnerHelperProcess(t *testing.T) {
	mode := os.Getenv(providerRunnerHelperMode)
	if mode == "" {
		return
	}
	if mode == "holder" {
		control, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp4", os.Getenv(providerRunnerControl), 5*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		_ = control.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second))
		if _, err = control.Write([]byte{'R'}); err != nil {
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, control)
		_ = control.Close()
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	if mode != "exit" && mode != "cancel" {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	child := exec.Command(executable, "-test.run=^TestNativeProviderRunnerHelperProcess$")
	child.Env = append(os.Environ(), providerRunnerHelperMode+"=holder")
	child.Stdout, child.Stderr = os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	if child.Start() != nil {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	_, _ = io.WriteString(os.Stdout, "provider-output-must-be-discarded")
	if mode == "cancel" {
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Second)
	}
	os.Exit(0)
}

101		algorithm := "sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com"

103		blob := sshWireString([]byte(algorithm))

In `identity_sign()`, FIDO/SK PIN retrying occurs only for a non-agent key when signing returns `SSH_ERR_KEY_WRONG_PASSPHRASE`:

```c
if (!retried && pin == NULL && !is_agent &&
    sshkey_is_sk(sign_key) &&
    r == SSH_ERR_KEY_WRONG_PASSPHRASE) {
```

The branch then calls `read_passphrase(prompt, 0)`, retries once with the entered PIN, and records `retried = 1`.

**BatchMode behavior:** `BatchMode=yes` does **not** suppress this per-signature security-key PIN prompt. `options.batch_mode` is passed to `notify_start()` for user-presence notification, but the PIN retry branch has no BatchMode check.

This applies specifically to non-agent SK keys loaded from files. Agent-held or externally hosted keys follow different signing paths and do not use this local PIN-prompt retry. The supplied content contains no `PIN_REQUIRED` symbol.
```

P3 source review found five defects; no edits, tests, or hardware operations were performed.

1. High — failure cleanup can delete a detected replacement file.
   `internal/sshhost/security_key_generate.go:125–134,185–207`
   If the identity is replaced while `ssh-keygen -y` runs, `revalidateSelectedKeyIdentity` correctly rejects it. But before `adoptGeneratedStagedFile`, cleanup has no stage snapshot: it reads the replacement anew and immediately authorizes its deletion. The same problem applies to the public staging file.
   Minimal fix: retain pre-validation file identities for cleanup and remove only those exact objects; never acquire deletion authority from a fresh snapshot after detecting source replacement. Add replacement-during-derivation tests.

2. High — the final mandatory login gate still cannot perform native hardware interaction.
   `internal/sshhost/bootstrap.go:171,275,284–291`; `bootstrap_authentication.go:28–29,53`
   Exact SK proofs now receive `Interactive=true`, but `runOrdinaryBootstrapGate` passes an empty selector and `exact=false`, forcing interaction back off. A newly generated encrypted stub without an agent cannot pass this gate; PIN-required file-backed keys also lack the foreground native runner path. Setup can prove the selected key, then still end with `ordinary_gate_failed` or a stopped/background prompt.
   `ExecRunner` explicitly puts noninteractive children in a separate process group (`runner_process_unix.go:20–23`). OpenSSH’s [non-agent SK PIN retry](https://github.com/openssh/openssh-portable/blob/master/sshconnect2.c) uses native `read_passphrase`; BatchMode alone does not make that interaction usable.
   Minimal fix: model an explicitly authorized hardware-interactive ordinary gate separately, preserving the fresh-login requirement and selected-proof restrictions. Test full `Bootstrap`, not only `runSSHProof`.

3. Medium — the directory sticky-bit exception is applied to executable/library files.
   `internal/sshhost/security_key_capability.go:131–137`; `agent_providers_unix.go:12–19`
   `inspectSecurityKeyFile` validates a regular executable/provider using `platformAgentDirectory`. That helper allows root-owned, group/world-writable objects when the sticky bit is set. Sticky bits protect directory entries, not writable regular-file contents, so a root-owned mode-01777 executable/library is accepted as safe.
   Minimal fix: regular-file validation must reject group/world write unconditionally; retain the sticky-directory exception only for actual ancestor directories. Add production-policy metadata tests rather than using the permissive fixture seam alone.

4. Medium — matching foreign provider symlinks are rejected.
   `internal/sshhost/security_key_capability.go:86–92,234–239`
   Selecting `/path/provider.so` when it is a symlink normalizes the planned provider to its resolved target. A foreign alias already containing that exact original `/path/provider.so` then fails the string-only provider comparison, despite using the same revalidated library.
   Minimal fix: accept the captured requested path as well as its resolved path, or compare independently validated identities. Continue pinning the resolved library for the selected operation.

5. Medium — some partial publications lose all local-path information.
   `internal/sshhost/security_key_generate.go:104–115,236–261`
   After private-stub publication succeeds, a change to the public staging file can make its commit fail. Recovery requires both files to match, so both recovery fields remain empty; `Candidate` is assigned only after complete success. The final private stub remains, but the result contains no path for it.
   Minimal fix: retain content-free local publication/path observations separately from “recoverable verified pair” metadata, without granting candidate authority.

Coordinator detail: `PublicationUnknown` is not being used merely for unknown enrollment; hardware uncertainty is separate. The remaining problem is discoverability/accounting of partially published local files.

The immutable public-plan checks, mutex-protected single attempt, stat-only observation, explicit unknown-capability attempt, Windows fail-closed gate, and target publickey-only proof configuration otherwise look sound. Additional coverage is needed for two-hop interactive proofs: the current shared `interactive` value also disables BatchMode on ordinary proxy stanzas, rather than limiting new interaction to the selected hardware-key hop.

291		if stage == nil || stage.root == nil || verifyHeldDirectory(stage.dir, stage.held, true) != nil {

293		}
294		for _, path := range paths {

298			}
299		}
300		return ""
301	}

309		}
310		_ = stage.root.Close()
311		stage.root = nil

112	func (s *Service) inspectSecurityKeyFile(path string, executable bool) (securityKeyFile, error) {

117		if err != nil {
118			return securityKeyFile{}, err
119		}
120		info, err := os.Lstat(resolved)
121		if err != nil {
122			return securityKeyFile{}, err
123		}
124		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
125			return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath

127		if s.securityKeyToolCheck != nil {
128			if err := s.securityKeyToolCheck(resolved, info); err != nil {

139				if depth >= 64 {

141				}
142				parent, err := os.Lstat(dir)
143				if err != nil || !parent.IsDir() || parent.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
144					return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
145				}
146				if err := platformAgentDirectory(dir, parent); err != nil {
147					return securityKeyFile{}, err
148				}
149				if dir == filepath.Dir(dir) || samePath(dir, s.paths.Home) {
150					break
151				}
152			}
153			if executable && info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 {
154				return securityKeyFile{}, ErrUnsafePath
155			}
156		}
157		return securityKeyFile{requested: filepath.Clean(path), resolved: resolved, info: info}, nil
158	}
159	
160	func (s *Service) revalidateSecurityKeyState(state *securityKeyState) error {
161		if state == nil {
162			return nil
163		}
164		lookup := s.securityKeyLookPath
165		if lookup == nil {
166			lookup = exec.LookPath
167		}
168		for _, tool := range []struct {
169			name string
170			file securityKeyFile
171		}{{"ssh-keygen", state.keygen}, {"ssh", state.client}} {
172			path, err := lookup(tool.name)
173			if err != nil || filepath.Clean(path) != tool.file.requested {
174				return fmt.Errorf("selected %s changed: %w", tool.name, ErrSourceChanged)
175			}
176			current, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(path, true)
177			if err != nil || current.resolved != tool.file.resolved || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(current.info, tool.file.info) {
178				return fmt.Errorf("selected %s changed: %w", tool.name, ErrSourceChanged)
179			}
180		}
181		if state.provider != nil {
182			current, err := s.inspectSecurityKeyFile(state.provider.requested, false)
183			if err != nil || current.resolved != state.provider.resolved || !sameSelectedKeyFileInfo(current.info, state.provider.info) {
184				return fmt.Errorf("selected security-key provider changed: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
185			}
186		}
187		return nil
188	}
189	
190	func normalizeSecurityKeyOptions(options SecurityKeyOptions) (SecurityKeyOptions, error) {
191		if options.Provider == "" {
192			options.Provider = "internal"
193		}
194		if options.Application == "" {
195			options.Application = "ssh:dev"
196		}
197		if !strings.HasPrefix(options.Application, "ssh:") || len(options.Application) < 5 || len(options.Application) > 68 {
198			return options, errors.New("security-key application must be ssh: followed by 1-64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes")
199		}
200		for _, c := range options.Application[4:] {
201			if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == '-') {
202				return options, errors.New("invalid security-key application")
203			}
204		}
205		return options, nil
206	}
207	
208	// VerifySecurityKeyPolicy checks a foreign alias without changing its provider.
209	// The plan is service-bound and no native enrollment or login occurs here.
210	func (s *Service) VerifySecurityKeyPolicy(ctx context.Context, alias string, plan KeyPlan) error {
211		if plan.state == nil || plan.state.serviceID != s.id || !equalKeyPlans(plan, plan.state.public) || plan.state.hardware == nil {
212			return ErrBlocked
213		}
214		if err := s.revalidateSecurityKeyState(plan.state.hardware); err != nil {
215			return err
216		}
217		effective, err := s.Effective(ctx, alias)
218		if err != nil {
219			return err
220		}
221		if !securityKeyProviderMatches(effective, plan.state.hardware) {
222			return errors.Join(ErrManualRemediation, errors.New("alias SecurityKeyProvider does not match the selected hardware generation provider"))
223		}
224		return nil
225	}
226	
227	func selectedSSHClient(selector keySelector) string {
228		if selector.hardware != nil {
229			return selector.hardware.client.resolved
230		}
231		return "ssh"
232	}
233	
234	func securityKeyProviderMatches(effective EffectiveConfig, state *securityKeyState) bool {
235		provider := firstEffectiveValue(effective, "securitykeyprovider")
236		if provider == "" {
237			provider = "internal"
238		}
239		return provider == state.options.Provider
240	}

30	func (r *sshHardwareAdapterRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, request sshhost.RunRequest) (sshhost.RunResult, error) {
31		r.calls = append(r.calls, request)
32		name := filepath.Base(request.Name)
33		if name == "ssh-add" {
34			return sshhost.RunResult{ExitCode: 1}, nil
35		}
36		if name == "ssh-keygen" {
37			if !hasSSHArg(request.Args, "-y") {
38				r.starts++
39				if request.OnStarted != nil {
40					request.OnStarted(time.Now())
41				}
42				if r.cancelGenerate {
43					return sshhost.RunResult{}, context.Canceled
44				}
45			} else if r.collision != "" {
46				if err := os.WriteFile(r.collision, []byte("unrelated destination created during native generation"), 0600); err != nil {
47					return sshhost.RunResult{}, err
48				}
49				r.collision = ""
50			}
51		}
52		request.Name = name
53		return r.base.Run(ctx, request)
54	}

56	func sshHardwareAdapterPublicKey() []byte {
57		wire := func(value []byte) []byte {
58			result := make([]byte, 4+len(value))
59			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(result, uint32(len(value)))
60			copy(result[4:], value)
61			return result
62		}
63		algorithm := "sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com"
64		blob := append(wire([]byte(algorithm)), wire(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x34}, 32))...)
65		blob = append(blob, wire([]byte("ssh:adapter"))...)
66		return []byte(algorithm + " " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(blob) + " adapter key")

873	func (s *Service) detectWindowsAdministrator(ctx context.Context, hop routeHopState, interactive bool) (bool, error) {
874		result, err := s.runHopSSHWithCapture(
875			ctx, hop, !interactive, windowsAdminProbeProgram(), nil, interactive,
876			"ssh Windows administrator probe", true,
877		)
878		if err != nil {
879			return false, err
880		}
881		if result.ExitCode != 0 {
882			if !interactive {
883				return false, ErrInteractionRequired
884			}
885			return false, ErrManualRemediation
886		}
887		switch strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stdout)) {
888		case "administrator":
889			return true, nil
890		case "standard":
891			return false, nil
892		default:
893			return false, ErrManualRemediation
894		}
895	}

499	func renderAuthenticationHop(hop routeHopState, name, proxy, mode string, selector keySelector, interactive bool) ([]byte, error) {
500		if !validRouteHop(hop.safe) {
501			return nil, ErrUnsupportedRoute
502		}
503		var body strings.Builder
504		body.WriteString("# private dev-cli per-hop authentication configuration\nHost " + name + "\n")
505		writeConfigDirective(&body, "HostName", hop.safe.HostName)
506		writeConfigDirective(&body, "User", hop.safe.User)
507		writeConfigDirective(&body, "Port", strconv.Itoa(hop.safe.Port))
508		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ControlMaster", "no")
509		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ControlPath", "none")
510		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ControlPersist", "no")
511		batch := "yes"
512		if interactive || mode == "password" {
513			batch = "no"
514		}
515		writeConfigDirective(&body, "BatchMode", batch)
516		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ConnectTimeout", sshConnectTimeout)
517		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ServerAliveInterval", sshServerAliveInterval)
518		writeConfigDirective(&body, "ServerAliveCountMax", sshServerAliveCountMax)
519		if err := writeExactHostKeyPolicy(&body, hop.effective, true); err != nil {
520			return nil, err
521		}
522		for _, key := range []string{"bindaddress", "bindinterface", "compression", "tcpkeepalive"} {
523			if value := firstEffectiveValue(hop.effective, key); value != "" {
524				if !validUTF8NoControl(value) {
525					return nil, ErrUnsupportedRoute
526				}
527				writeConfigDirective(&body, key, value)
528			}
529		}
530		if value := firstEffectiveValue(hop.effective, "ipqos"); value != "" {
531			fields := strings.Fields(value)
532			if len(fields) < 1 || len(fields) > 2 {
533				return nil, ErrUnsupportedRoute
534			}
535			body.WriteString("    IPQoS")
536			for _, field := range fields {
537				if !validUTF8NoControl(field) {
538					return nil, ErrUnsupportedRoute
539				}
540				body.WriteByte(' ')
541				body.WriteString(quoteConfigValue(field))
542			}
543			body.WriteByte('\n')
544		}
545		if proxy != "" {
546			// ProxyCommand consumes the remainder verbatim; quoting the entire
547			// command would turn executable plus arguments into one shell word.
548			if !validUTF8NoControl(proxy) {
549				return nil, ErrUnsupportedRoute
550			}
551			body.WriteString("    ProxyCommand " + proxy + "\n")
552		}
553		switch mode {
554		case "selected":
555			if err := writeSelectedAuthentication(&body, hop.effective, selector, interactive); err != nil {
556				return nil, err
557			}
558		case "password", "trust":
559			writeConfigDirective(&body, "IdentityFile", "none")
560			writeConfigDirective(&body, "CertificateFile", "none")
561			writeConfigDirective(&body, "PubkeyAuthentication", "no")
562			writeConfigDirective(&body, "KbdInteractiveAuthentication", "no")
563			writeConfigDirective(&body, "GSSAPIAuthentication", "no")
564			writeConfigDirective(&body, "HostbasedAuthentication", "no")
565			if mode == "password" {
566				writeConfigDirective(&body, "PasswordAuthentication", "yes")
567				writeConfigDirective(&body, "PreferredAuthentications", "password")
568				writeConfigDirective(&body, "NumberOfPasswordPrompts", "1")
569			} else {
570				writeConfigDirective(&body, "PasswordAuthentication", "no")
571				writeConfigDirective(&body, "PreferredAuthentications", "none")
572				writeConfigDirective(&body, "NumberOfPasswordPrompts", "0")
573			}
574		case "ordinary":
575			if err := writeOrdinaryProxyAuthentication(&body, hop.effective); err != nil {
576				return nil, err
577			}
578		default:
579			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported SSH authentication mode")
580		}
581		return []byte(body.String()), nil
582	}

package sshhost

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
)

func hardwareGateAuthentication(operation *AuthenticationOperation, index int, selector keySelector, interactive bool) bootstrapAuthentication {
	gate := bootstrapAuthentication{operation: operation, index: index}
	if interactive && selector.securityKey {
		copy := selector
		copy.ordinaryHardwareGate = true
		gate.hardware = &copy
	}
	return gate
}

// A hardware ordinary gate is a fresh login with native identity selection, not
// another selected-key proof. Native interaction cannot add account-password or
// keyboard-interactive fallback merely because a hardware key needs a PIN.
func writeHardwareOrdinaryAuthentication(body *strings.Builder, effective EffectiveConfig, selector keySelector) error {
	if selector.hardware != nil {
		if !securityKeyProviderMatches(effective, selector.hardware) { return ErrManualRemediation }
		writeConfigDirective(body, "SecurityKeyProvider", selector.hardware.options.Provider)
	}
	for _, item := range []struct{name, value string}{
		{"PreferredAuthentications", "publickey"}, {"PasswordAuthentication", "no"},
		{"KbdInteractiveAuthentication", "no"}, {"ChallengeResponseAuthentication", "no"},
		{"GSSAPIAuthentication", "no"}, {"HostbasedAuthentication", "no"},
	} { writeConfigDirective(body, item.name, item.value) }
	return writeOrdinaryProxyAuthentication(body, effective)
}

func (s *Service) revalidateHardwareGateNativeConfig(ctx context.Context, hop routeHopState) error {
	route := hop.proofRoute
	if len(route) == 0 { route = []proofRouteHop{{alias: hop.safe.Alias, effective: hop.effective}} }
	for _, entry := range route {
		current, err := s.Effective(ctx, entry.alias)
		if err != nil { return err }
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(current, entry.effective) {
			return fmt.Errorf("native SSH configuration changed before the hardware ordinary gate: %w", ErrSourceChanged)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

- **What `BW_SESSION` represents:** A session key created by `bw unlock` or, for email/password login, returned by `bw login`. The page describes it as the decryption key for vault data and says commands that access decrypted data require it.
